package com.example.api

import android.util.Log

enum class AiErrorKind {
    AUTH_ERROR,
    RATE_LIMIT,
    MODEL_UNAVAILABLE,
    NETWORK_ERROR,
    EMPTY_RESPONSE,
    PARSE_ERROR,
    UNKNOWN
}

data class AiExecutionResult(
    val success: Boolean,
    val text: String,
    val provider: String,
    val model: String,
    val keyIndex: Int,
    val errorKind: AiErrorKind? = null,
    val errorMessage: String? = null,
    val actualInputTokens: Int? = null,
    val actualOutputTokens: Int? = null
) {
    fun toHumanReadableError(): String {
        val msg = errorMessage.orEmpty()
        return when {
            msg.contains("401") || msg.contains("API_KEY_INVALID") -> "API Key 無效或驗證失敗 (HTTP 401)。請檢查 API 設定。"
            msg.contains("403") -> "API 沒有權限使用此服務或 Model (HTTP 403)。"
            msg.contains("404") || errorKind == AiErrorKind.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE -> "找不到指定的 AI Model (HTTP 404)。請在設定中重新取得或更換 Model。"
            msg.contains("429") || msg.contains("quota") || msg.contains("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED") || errorKind == AiErrorKind.RATE_LIMIT -> "API 使用量或 Rate Limit 已達上限 (HTTP 429)。請稍後再試或換 Key。"
            msg.contains("500") || msg.contains("502") || msg.contains("503") -> "AI 伺服器端發生錯誤 (HTTP 5xx)。請稍後重試。"
            msg.contains("timeout") || msg.contains("Timeout") -> "AI 回應逾時。請檢查網路連線狀態。"
            msg.contains("Connect") || msg.contains("UnknownHost") || errorKind == AiErrorKind.NETWORK_ERROR -> "目前無法連線至網路或 AI 伺服器。"
            msg.isNotBlank() -> msg
            else -> "AI 連線或回應異常。"
        }
    }
}

class ApiKeyRotationManager {

    fun getTransport(providerStr: String): AiTransport {
        return when (providerStr.uppercase()) {
            "GEMINI" -> GeminiTransport
            "CLOUDFLARE" -> CloudflareTransport
            else -> GenericOpenAiCompatibleTransport
        }
    }

    suspend fun executeWithFailover(
        profiles: List<ApiProfile>,
        request: AiRequest
    ): AiExecutionResult {
        if (profiles.isEmpty()) {
            return AiExecutionResult(
                success = false,
                text = "",
                provider = "None",
                model = "None",
                keyIndex = 0,
                errorKind = AiErrorKind.AUTH_ERROR,
                errorMessage = "未配置任何啟用的 AI API 設定檔"
            )
        }

        var lastError: String? = null
        var lastErrorKind: AiErrorKind = AiErrorKind.UNKNOWN

        for (profile in profiles.filter { it.enabled }) {
            val keys = profile.allActiveKeys().ifEmpty { listOf("") }
            val transport = getTransport(profile.provider)

            for ((idx, key) in keys.withIndex()) {
                try {
                    val result = transport.execute(profile, key, request)
                    if (result.text.isNotBlank()) {
                        if (result.inputTokens != null || result.outputTokens != null) {
                            com.example.agent.TokenBudgetManager.recordActualTokens(
                                inputTokens = result.inputTokens ?: 0,
                                outputTokens = result.outputTokens ?: 0
                            )
                        } else {
                            // Estimated tokens fallback if provider didn't return actual token usage
                            val estimatedInput = com.example.agent.TokenBudgetManager.estimateTokens(request.prompt + (request.systemPrompt ?: ""))
                            val estimatedOutput = com.example.agent.TokenBudgetManager.estimateTokens(result.text)
                            com.example.agent.TokenBudgetManager.recordEstimatedTokens(
                                inputTokens = estimatedInput,
                                outputTokens = estimatedOutput
                            )
                        }
                        
                        return AiExecutionResult(
                            success = true,
                            text = result.text,
                            provider = profile.provider,
                            model = profile.model,
                            keyIndex = idx,
                            actualInputTokens = result.inputTokens,
                            actualOutputTokens = result.outputTokens
                        )
                    } else {
                        lastErrorKind = AiErrorKind.EMPTY_RESPONSE
                        lastError = "AI 回應為空白"
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    val msg = e.message.orEmpty()
                    lastError = msg
                    lastErrorKind = when {
                        msg.contains("401") || msg.contains("403") || msg.contains("API_KEY_INVALID") -> AiErrorKind.AUTH_ERROR
                        msg.contains("429") || msg.contains("quota") || msg.contains("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED") -> AiErrorKind.RATE_LIMIT
                        msg.contains("404") || msg.contains("model") -> AiErrorKind.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
                        msg.contains("timeout") || msg.contains("Connect") || msg.contains("UnknownHost") -> AiErrorKind.NETWORK_ERROR
                        else -> AiErrorKind.UNKNOWN
                    }
                    Log.w("AiRotation", "${profile.provider} key[$idx] failed: $lastErrorKind -> trying next key/provider")
                }
            }
        }

        return AiExecutionResult(
            success = false,
            text = "",
            provider = profiles.firstOrNull()?.provider ?: "Unknown",
            model = profiles.firstOrNull()?.model ?: "Unknown",
            keyIndex = 0,
            errorKind = lastErrorKind,
            errorMessage = lastError ?: "所有 API Key 與 Provider 皆呼叫失敗"
        )
    }

    suspend fun testProfile(profile: ApiProfile): ApiTestResult {
        if (profile.model.isBlank()) {
            return ApiTestResult(
                success = false,
                message = "尚未指定 Model，請點擊「取得模型」並選擇可用 Model",
                latencyMs = 0L,
                provider = profile.provider,
                model = ""
            )
        }
        val startTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val keys = profile.allActiveKeys().ifEmpty { listOf("") }
        val transport = getTransport(profile.provider)
        val req = AiRequest(
            prompt = "Hi, reply 'OK' if you can read this.",
            maxTokens = 10
        )

        for ((idx, key) in keys.withIndex()) {
            try {
                val res = transport.execute(profile, key, req)
                val latency = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime
                if (res.text.isNotBlank()) {
                    return ApiTestResult(
                        success = true,
                        message = "連線成功！(Key #${idx + 1}, 耗時: ${latency}ms)",
                        latencyMs = latency,
                        provider = profile.provider,
                        model = profile.model
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (idx == keys.lastIndex) {
                    val latency = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime
                    return ApiTestResult(
                        success = false,
                        message = "連線失敗: ${e.message}",
                        latencyMs = latency,
                        provider = profile.provider,
                        model = profile.model
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        return ApiTestResult(
            success = false,
            message = "尚未提供有效 API Key",
            latencyMs = 0L,
            provider = profile.provider,
            model = profile.model
        )
    }
}

data class ApiKeyEntry(
    val id: String = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val key: String = "",
    val name: String = "",
    val enabled: Boolean = true,
    val priority: Int = 1

data class ApiProfile(
    val id: String = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val displayName: String = "",
    val provider: String = "GEMINI",
    val model: String = "",
    val baseUrl: String? = null,
    val apiKey: String? = null,
    val apiKeys: List<ApiKeyEntry> = emptyList(),
    val accountId: String? = null, // Cloudflare
    val systemPrompt: String? = null,
    val enabled: Boolean = true,
    val priority: Int = 1
) {
    fun allActiveKeys(): List<String> {
        val pool = apiKeys.filter { it.enabled && it.key.isNotBlank() }
            .sortedBy { it.priority }
            .map { it.key }
        if (pool.isNotEmpty()) return pool
        return if (!apiKey.isNullOrBlank()) listOf(apiKey) else emptyList()
    }
}

    val model: String = ""
)

package com.example.api

import android.security.keystore.KeyGenParameterSpec
import android.security.keystore.KeyProperties
import android.util.Base64
import java.security.KeyStore
import javax.crypto.Cipher
import javax.crypto.KeyGenerator
import javax.crypto.SecretKey
import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec

object SecureKeyStoreHelper {
    private const val ANDROID_KEY_STORE = "AndroidKeyStore"
    private const val KEY_ALIAS = "PegasusSecureApiKeyStorage"
    private const val TRANSFORMATION = "AES/GCM/NoPadding"
    private const val GCM_IV_LENGTH = 12
    private const val GCM_TAG_LENGTH = 128

    private fun getOrCreateSecretKey(): SecretKey? {
        return try {
            val keyStore = KeyStore.getInstance(ANDROID_KEY_STORE)
            keyStore.load(null)
            if (keyStore.containsAlias(KEY_ALIAS)) {
                val entry = keyStore.getEntry(KEY_ALIAS, null) as? KeyStore.SecretKeyEntry
                entry?.secretKey
            } else {
                val keyGen = KeyGenerator.getInstance(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_AES, ANDROID_KEY_STORE)
                val spec = KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(
                    KEY_ALIAS,
                    KeyProperties.PURPOSE_ENCRYPT or KeyProperties.PURPOSE_DECRYPT
                )
                    .setBlockModes(KeyProperties.BLOCK_MODE_GCM)
                    .setEncryptionPaddings(KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE)
                    .setKeySize(256)
                    .build()
                keyGen.init(spec)
                keyGen.generateKey()
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun encrypt(plainText: String): String {
        if (plainText.isBlank()) return ""
        return try {
            val secretKey = getOrCreateSecretKey() ?: return plainText
            val cipher = Cipher.getInstance(TRANSFORMATION)
            cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, secretKey)
            val iv = cipher.iv
            val cipherText = cipher.doFinal(plainText.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            val combined = ByteArray(iv.size + cipherText.size)
            System.arraycopy(iv, 0, combined, 0, iv.size)
            System.arraycopy(cipherText, 0, combined, iv.size, cipherText.size)
            "enc:" + Base64.encodeToString(combined, Base64.NO_WRAP)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            plainText
        }
    }

    fun decrypt(cipherTextOrPlain: String): String {
        if (cipherTextOrPlain.isBlank()) return ""
        if (!cipherTextOrPlain.startsWith("enc:")) return cipherTextOrPlain
        return try {
            val base64Data = cipherTextOrPlain.removePrefix("enc:")
            val combined = Base64.decode(base64Data, Base64.NO_WRAP)
            if (combined.size <= GCM_IV_LENGTH) return cipherTextOrPlain
            val iv = ByteArray(GCM_IV_LENGTH)
            val cipherText = ByteArray(combined.size - GCM_IV_LENGTH)
            System.arraycopy(combined, 0, iv, 0, GCM_IV_LENGTH)
            System.arraycopy(combined, GCM_IV_LENGTH, cipherText, 0, cipherText.size)

            val secretKey = getOrCreateSecretKey() ?: return cipherTextOrPlain
            val cipher = Cipher.getInstance(TRANSFORMATION)
            val spec = GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_LENGTH, iv)
            cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, spec)
            val plainBytes = cipher.doFinal(cipherText)
            String(plainBytes, Charsets.UTF_8)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            cipherTextOrPlain
        }
    }
}

package com.example.audio

import android.content.Context
import android.media.AudioAttributes
import android.media.AudioFormat
import android.media.AudioManager
import android.media.AudioTrack
import android.media.ToneGenerator
import android.os.Build
import android.os.VibrationEffect
import android.os.Vibrator
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlin.math.sin

object SoundManager {
    private var isSfxEnabled = true
    private var isBgmEnabled = false
    private var bgmVolume = 0.35f
    
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + SupervisorJob())
    private var bgmJob: Job? = null
    private val bgmTrackRef = AtomicReference<AudioTrack?>(null)
    private var toneGenerator: ToneGenerator? = null

    private const val BGM_SAMPLE_RATE = 22050

    fun init(sfxEnabled: Boolean, bgmEnabled: Boolean, volume: Float) {
        isSfxEnabled = sfxEnabled
        isBgmEnabled = bgmEnabled
        bgmVolume = volume.coerceIn(0f, 1f)

        if (isBgmEnabled) {
            startAmbientBgm()
        }
    }

    fun setSfxEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        isSfxEnabled = enabled
    }

    fun setBgmEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        isBgmEnabled = enabled
        if (isBgmEnabled) {
            startAmbientBgm()
        } else {
            stopAmbientBgm()
        }
    }

    fun setBgmVolume(volume: Float) {
        bgmVolume = volume.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun getToneGen(): ToneGenerator? {
        if (toneGenerator == null) {
            try {
                toneGenerator = ToneGenerator(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, 50)
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                // Tone generator fallback
            }
        }
        return toneGenerator
    }

    fun playMoveSound(context: Context? = null) {
        if (!isSfxEnabled) return
        vibrate(context, 6)
        try {
            getToneGen()?.startTone(ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_BEEP, 35)
        } catch (e: Throwable) {}
    }

    fun playSelectSound(context: Context? = null) {
        if (!isSfxEnabled) return
        vibrate(context, 14)
        try {
            getToneGen()?.startTone(ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_ACK, 60)
        } catch (e: Throwable) {}
    }

    fun playBackSound(context: Context? = null) {
        if (!isSfxEnabled) return
        vibrate(context, 10)
        try {
            getToneGen()?.startTone(ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_NACK, 50)
        } catch (e: Throwable) {}
    }

    fun playLaunchSound(context: Context? = null) {
        if (!isSfxEnabled) return
        vibrate(context, 30)
        scope.launch {
            try {
                getToneGen()?.startTone(ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_BEEP, 40)
                delay(50)
                getToneGen()?.startTone(ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_PROMPT, 100)
            } catch (e: Throwable) {}
        }
    }

    private fun vibrate(context: Context?, durationMs: Long) {
        try {
            val vibrator = context?.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as? Vibrator
            if (vibrator != null && vibrator.hasVibrator()) {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                    vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createOneShot(durationMs, VibrationEffect.DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE))
                } else {
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    vibrator.vibrate(durationMs)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            // Ignore vibration errors
        }
    }

    private fun startAmbientBgm() {
        stopAmbientBgm()
        bgmJob = scope.launch {
            var ownedTrack: AudioTrack? = null
            try {
                val minBufferSize = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                    BGM_SAMPLE_RATE,
                    AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO,
                    AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
                ).coerceAtLeast(4096)

                val track = AudioTrack.Builder()
                    .setAudioAttributes(
                        AudioAttributes.Builder()
                            .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                            .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                            .build()
                    )
                    .setAudioFormat(
                        AudioFormat.Builder()
                            .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                            .setSampleRate(BGM_SAMPLE_RATE)
                            .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                            .build()
                    )
                    .setBufferSizeInBytes(minBufferSize * 2)
                    .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
                    .build()

                if (bgmTrackRef.compareAndSet(null, track)) {
                    ownedTrack = track
                    track.play()
                } else {
                    track.release()
                    return@launch
                }

                val chordNotes = listOf(
                    listOf(261.63, 329.63, 392.00, 523.25), // C Major
                    listOf(220.00, 261.63, 329.63, 440.00), // A Minor
                    listOf(174.61, 220.00, 261.63, 349.23), // F Major
                    listOf(196.00, 246.94, 293.66, 392.00)  // G Major
                )
                var chordIndex = 0

                val chunkDurationMs = 2500
                val numSamples = (BGM_SAMPLE_RATE * (chunkDurationMs / 1000.0)).toInt()
                val buffer = ShortArray(numSamples)

                while (isActive && isBgmEnabled) {
                    val currentChord = chordNotes[chordIndex % chordNotes.size]
                    chordIndex++

                    for (i in 0 until numSamples) {
                        val envelope = when {
                            i < numSamples * 0.2 -> (i / (numSamples * 0.2))
                            i > numSamples * 0.6 -> ((numSamples - i) / (numSamples * 0.4))
                            else -> 1.0
                        }
                        var waveSum = 0.0
                        for (freq in currentChord) {
                            waveSum += sin(2.0 * Math.PI * i * freq / BGM_SAMPLE_RATE)
                        }
                        waveSum /= currentChord.size
                        buffer[i] = (waveSum * Short.MAX_VALUE * bgmVolume * 0.22f * envelope).toInt()
                            .coerceIn(Short.MIN_VALUE.toInt(), Short.MAX_VALUE.toInt()).toShort()
                    }

                    val currentTrack = bgmTrackRef.get()
                    if (currentTrack != null && currentTrack.playState == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                        currentTrack.write(buffer, 0, buffer.size)
                    }
                    
                    delay((chunkDurationMs * 0.85).toLong())
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Background music error handler
            } finally {
                if (ownedTrack != null && bgmTrackRef.compareAndSet(ownedTrack, null)) {
                    try {
                        if (ownedTrack.playState == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                            ownedTrack.stop()
                        }
                        ownedTrack.release()
                    } catch (e: Exception) {}
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun stopAmbientBgm() {
        bgmJob?.cancel()
        bgmJob = null
        bgmTrackRef.getAndSet(null)?.let { track ->
            try {
                if (track.playState == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                    track.stop()
                }
                track.release()
            } catch (e: Exception) {}
        }
    }
}

package com.example.database

import android.content.Context
import androidx.room.Database
import androidx.room.Room
import androidx.room.RoomDatabase
import androidx.room.migration.Migration
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase

// v9: added indices for games (romPath, platform/title) and asset_match_records (gameId, romIdentity)
@Database(entities = [GameEntity::class, ResearchEntity::class, TaskCheckpointEntity::class, AssetMatchEntity::class], version = 9, exportSchema = false)
abstract class AppDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun gameDao(): GameDao
    abstract fun researchDao(): ResearchDao
    abstract fun taskCheckpointDao(): TaskCheckpointDao
    abstract fun assetMatchDao(): AssetMatchDao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: AppDatabase? = null

        val MIGRATION_1_2 = object : Migration(1, 2) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN customCollections TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN screenshotPath TEXT DEFAULT NULL")
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN logoPath TEXT DEFAULT NULL")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_2_3 = object : Migration(2, 3) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN playTimeMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN playStatus TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNPLAYED'")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_3_4 = object : Migration(3, 4) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN descriptionCsvSynced INTEGER DEFAULT NULL")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_4_5 = object : Migration(4, 5) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN iconPath TEXT DEFAULT NULL")
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN sourceId TEXT DEFAULT NULL")
            }
        }
        
        val MIGRATION_5_6 = object : Migration(5, 6) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `research_tasks` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `gameTitle` TEXT NOT NULL, `platform` TEXT NOT NULL, `topicId` TEXT NOT NULL, `topicTitle` TEXT NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `progress` REAL NOT NULL, `result` TEXT, `error` TEXT, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))")
                db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `task_checkpoints` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `stage` TEXT NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `completedCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `totalCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `currentItem` TEXT NOT NULL, `dryRun` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_6_7 = object : Migration(6, 7) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN file_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL")
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN file_path TEXT DEFAULT NULL")
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN ai_detected_title TEXT DEFAULT NULL")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_7_8 = object : Migration(7, 8) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `asset_match_records` (`gameId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `romIdentity` TEXT NOT NULL, `assetType` TEXT NOT NULL, `source` TEXT NOT NULL, `sourceKey` TEXT NOT NULL, `matchedAssetUri` TEXT, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `lastCheckedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`romIdentity`, `assetType`, `source`))")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_8_9 = object : Migration(8, 9) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_games_romPath` ON `games` (`romPath`)")
                db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_games_platform_title` ON `games` (`platform`, `title`)")
                db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_asset_match_records_gameId` ON `asset_match_records` (`gameId`)")
                db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_asset_match_records_romIdentity` ON `asset_match_records` (`romIdentity`)")
            }
        }

        fun getDatabase(context: Context): AppDatabase {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                val instance = Room.databaseBuilder(
                    context.applicationContext,
                    AppDatabase::class.java,
                    "pegasus_database"
                )
                .addMigrations(MIGRATION_1_2, MIGRATION_2_3, MIGRATION_3_4, MIGRATION_4_5, MIGRATION_5_6, MIGRATION_6_7, MIGRATION_7_8, MIGRATION_8_9)
                .build()
                INSTANCE = instance
                instance
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.database

import androidx.room.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

@Dao
interface AssetMatchDao {

    @Query("SELECT * FROM asset_match_records WHERE romIdentity = :romIdentity AND assetType = :assetType AND source = :source LIMIT 1")
    suspend fun getMatchRecord(romIdentity: String, assetType: String, source: String): AssetMatchEntity?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM asset_match_records WHERE romIdentity = :romIdentity")
    suspend fun getRecordsForRom(romIdentity: String): List<AssetMatchEntity>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM asset_match_records WHERE gameId = :gameId")
    suspend fun getRecordsForGame(gameId: Int): List<AssetMatchEntity>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM asset_match_records")
    fun getAllRecordsFlow(): Flow<List<AssetMatchEntity>>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertRecord(record: AssetMatchEntity)

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertRecords(records: List<AssetMatchEntity>)

    @Query("DELETE FROM asset_match_records WHERE gameId = :gameId")
    suspend fun deleteRecordsForGame(gameId: Int)

    @Query("DELETE FROM asset_match_records WHERE gameId = :gameId AND (:assetType IS NULL OR assetType = :assetType)")
    suspend fun deleteRecordForGameAsset(gameId: Int, assetType: String? = null)

    @Query("DELETE FROM asset_match_records WHERE romIdentity = :romIdentity")
    suspend fun deleteRecordsForRom(romIdentity: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM asset_match_records")
    suspend fun deleteAllRecords()

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset_match_records WHERE status = 'MATCHED'")
    suspend fun getMatchedCount(): Int
}

package com.example.database

import androidx.room.Entity
import androidx.room.Index

@Entity(
    tableName = "asset_match_records",
    primaryKeys = ["romIdentity", "assetType", "source"],
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["gameId"]),
        Index(value = ["romIdentity"])
    ]
)
data class AssetMatchEntity(
    val gameId: Int,
    val romIdentity: String,       // Stable ROM identifier e.g. clean path or "${platform}_${title}"
    val assetType: String,         // "COVER", "BACKGROUND", "LOGO", "SCREENSHOT", "ICON", "DESCRIPTION", "METADATA"
    val source: String,            // "LOCAL_DIR", "METADATA_PEGASUS", "GAMELIST_XML", "CSV_MASTER", "SCRAPER"
    val sourceKey: String,         // Matched relative path, filename, or key
    val matchedAssetUri: String?,  // Uri string or resolved file path
    val status: String,            // "MATCHED", "NOT_FOUND", "SKIPPED", "VERIFIED"
    val lastCheckedAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

package com.example.database

import androidx.room.Dao
import androidx.room.Insert
import androidx.room.OnConflictStrategy
import androidx.room.Query
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

data class DescriptionSyncStats(
    val totalCount: Int = 0,
    val syncedCount: Int = 0
)

@Dao
interface GameDao {
    @Query("SELECT * FROM games ORDER BY addedAt DESC")
    fun getAllGames(): Flow<List<GameEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN descriptionCsvSynced = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS syncedCount FROM games")
    fun getDescriptionSyncStats(): Flow<DescriptionSyncStats>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM games ORDER BY addedAt DESC")
    suspend fun getAllGamesDirect(): List<GameEntity>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM games WHERE platform = :platform ORDER BY title ASC")
    fun getGamesByPlatform(platform: String): Flow<List<GameEntity>>
    
    @Query("SELECT * FROM games WHERE title LIKE '%' || :query || '%'")
    fun searchGames(query: String): Flow<List<GameEntity>>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertGame(game: GameEntity)
    
    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertGames(games: List<GameEntity>)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM games WHERE romPath = :romPath LIMIT 1")
    suspend fun getGameByRomPath(romPath: String): GameEntity?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM games WHERE platform = :platform AND title = :title LIMIT 1")
    suspend fun getGameByPlatformAndTitle(platform: String, title: String): GameEntity?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM games WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1")
    suspend fun getGameById(id: Int): GameEntity?

    @androidx.room.Update
    suspend fun updateGames(games: List<GameEntity>)

    @androidx.room.Transaction
    suspend fun upsertScannedGamesBatch(scannedList: List<GameEntity>) {
        for (scanned in scannedList) {
            val existing = getGameByRomPath(scanned.romPath)
            if (existing == null) {
                insertGame(scanned)
            } else {
                insertGame(GameRepository.mergeScannedGame(existing, scanned))
            }
        }
    }

    @Query("SELECT * FROM games WHERE platform = :platform")
    suspend fun getGamesByPlatformDirect(platform: String): List<GameEntity>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM games WHERE sourceId = :sourceId")
    suspend fun getGamesBySourceId(sourceId: String): List<GameEntity>

    @Query("UPDATE games SET coverPath = COALESCE(:coverPath, coverPath), backgroundPath = COALESCE(:backgroundPath, backgroundPath), logoPath = COALESCE(:logoPath, logoPath), screenshotPath = COALESCE(:screenshotPath, screenshotPath), iconPath = COALESCE(:iconPath, iconPath) WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun updateAssets(id: Int, coverPath: String?, backgroundPath: String?, logoPath: String?, screenshotPath: String?, iconPath: String?)

    @Query("UPDATE games SET description = :description, descriptionCsvSynced = :synced WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun updateDescription(id: Int, description: String, synced: Boolean?)

    @Query("UPDATE games SET museumJson = :museumJson, dnaJson = :dnaJson, evolutionJson = :evolutionJson, cheatsJson = :cheatsJson WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun updateKnowledge(id: Int, museumJson: String?, dnaJson: String?, evolutionJson: String?, cheatsJson: String?)

    @Query("DELETE FROM games WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun deleteGameById(id: Int)
    
    @Query("DELETE FROM games")
    suspend fun deleteAllGames()
}

package com.example.database

import androidx.room.ColumnInfo
import androidx.room.Entity
import androidx.room.Index
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey

@Entity(
    tableName = "games",
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["romPath"], unique = false),
        Index(value = ["platform", "title"], unique = false)
    ]
)
data class GameEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Int = 0,
    val title: String,
    val platform: String,
    val romPath: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "file_name") val fileName: String? = null,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "file_path") val filePath: String? = null,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "ai_detected_title") val aiDetectedTitle: String? = null,
    val coverPath: String? = null,
    val backgroundPath: String? = null,
    val logoPath: String? = null,
    val screenshotPath: String? = null,
    val iconPath: String? = null,
    val sourceId: String? = null,
    val description: String? = null,
    // Tracks the CSV write-back state for `description` independently from the
    // Room save above: null = not attempted (no CSV root configured / not an
    // AI-generated value yet), true = written back to the platform CSV,
    // false = Room save succeeded but the CSV write failed and needs retry.
    val descriptionCsvSynced: Boolean? = null,
    val developer: String? = null,
    val publisher: String? = null,
    val genre: String? = null,
    val releaseDate: String? = null,
    val composer: String? = null,
    val rating: Float = 0f,
    val isFavorite: Boolean = false,
    val playCount: Int = 0,
    val playTimeMinutes: Long = 0L,
    val playStatus: String = "UNPLAYED", // UNPLAYED, PLAYING, COMPLETED, DROPPED, MASTERED
    val customCollections: String = "", // Comma-separated list of custom collections
    val lastPlayed: Long = 0L,
    val addedAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    // Cached JSON structures for Museum, DNA, Evolution, Cheats, and RA
    val museumJson: String? = null,
    val dnaJson: String? = null,
    val evolutionJson: String? = null,
    val cheatsJson: String? = null,
    val retroAchievementsJson: String? = null
)

package com.example.database

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

class GameRepository(
    private val gameDao: GameDao,
    private val assetMatchDao: AssetMatchDao? = null
) {
    val allGames: Flow<List<GameEntity>> = gameDao.getAllGames()
    val descriptionSyncStats: Flow<DescriptionSyncStats> = gameDao.getDescriptionSyncStats()
    
    suspend fun getAllGamesDirect(): List<GameEntity> {
        return gameDao.getAllGamesDirect()
    }

    fun getAssetMatchDao(): AssetMatchDao? = assetMatchDao

    suspend fun getAssetMatchRecord(romIdentity: String, assetType: String, source: String): AssetMatchEntity? {
        return assetMatchDao?.getMatchRecord(romIdentity, assetType, source)
    }

    suspend fun getAssetMatchRecordsForRom(romIdentity: String): List<AssetMatchEntity> {
        return assetMatchDao?.getRecordsForRom(romIdentity).orEmpty()
    }

    suspend fun saveAssetMatchRecord(record: AssetMatchEntity) {
        assetMatchDao?.insertRecord(record)
    }

    suspend fun saveAssetMatchRecords(records: List<AssetMatchEntity>) {
        assetMatchDao?.insertRecords(records)
    }

    suspend fun clearAssetMatchRecords() {
        assetMatchDao?.deleteAllRecords()
    }

    suspend fun insertGame(game: GameEntity) {
        gameDao.insertGame(game)
    }

    suspend fun updateGame(game: GameEntity) {
        gameDao.insertGame(game)
    }
    
    suspend fun insertGames(games: List<GameEntity>) {
        gameDao.insertGames(games)
    }

    suspend fun updateGames(games: List<GameEntity>) {
        gameDao.updateGames(games)
    }

    suspend fun upsertScannedGamesBatch(context: android.content.Context, scannedList: List<GameEntity>) {
        if (scannedList.isEmpty()) return
        val allExisting = gameDao.getAllGamesDirect()
        val romPathMap = allExisting.associateBy { it.romPath }.toMutableMap()
        val identityMap = mutableMapOf<String, GameEntity>()
        for (existing in allExisting) {
            val identity = com.example.p3.asset.RomIdentityUtils.getStableRomIdentity(context, existing)
            if (identity.startsWith("ROMHASH_")) {
                identityMap[identity] = existing
            }
        }

        val gamesToInsert = mutableListOf<GameEntity>()
        val gamesToUpdate = mutableListOf<GameEntity>()

        for (scanned in scannedList) {
            // Priority 1: Exact romPath match
            var matched = romPathMap[scanned.romPath]

            // Priority 2: Stable content-based ROM identity match (e.g. file moved or renamed)
            if (matched == null) {
                val scannedIdentity = com.example.p3.asset.RomIdentityUtils.getStableRomIdentity(context, scanned)
                if (scannedIdentity.startsWith("ROMHASH_")) {
                    matched = identityMap[scannedIdentity]
                }
            }

            if (matched != null) {
                val merged = mergeScannedGame(matched, scanned)
                gamesToUpdate.add(merged)
                romPathMap[merged.romPath] = merged
            } else {
                gamesToInsert.add(scanned)
                romPathMap[scanned.romPath] = scanned
                val scannedIdentity = com.example.p3.asset.RomIdentityUtils.getStableRomIdentity(context, scanned)
                if (scannedIdentity.startsWith("ROMHASH_")) {
                    identityMap[scannedIdentity] = scanned
                }
            }
        }

        if (gamesToInsert.isNotEmpty()) {
            gameDao.insertGames(gamesToInsert)
        }
        if (gamesToUpdate.isNotEmpty()) {
            gameDao.insertGames(gamesToUpdate)
        }
    }

    suspend fun upsertScannedGamesBatch(scannedList: List<GameEntity>) {
        gameDao.upsertScannedGamesBatch(scannedList)
    }

    suspend fun getGameById(id: Int): GameEntity? = gameDao.getGameById(id)

    suspend fun getGamesByPlatformDirect(platform: String): List<GameEntity> = gameDao.getGamesByPlatformDirect(platform)

    suspend fun getGamesBySourceId(sourceId: String): List<GameEntity> = gameDao.getGamesBySourceId(sourceId)

    suspend fun updateAssets(id: Int, coverPath: String?, backgroundPath: String?, logoPath: String?, screenshotPath: String?, iconPath: String?) {
        gameDao.updateAssets(id, coverPath, backgroundPath, logoPath, screenshotPath, iconPath)
    }

    suspend fun updateDescription(id: Int, description: String, synced: Boolean?) {
        gameDao.updateDescription(id, description, synced)
    }

    suspend fun updateKnowledge(id: Int, museumJson: String?, dnaJson: String?, evolutionJson: String?, cheatsJson: String?) {
        gameDao.updateKnowledge(id, museumJson, dnaJson, evolutionJson, cheatsJson)
    }

    /**
     * Merge a freshly scanned ROM record into the existing library without
     * destroying user-generated / user-owned data.
     */
    suspend fun upsertScannedGame(context: android.content.Context, scanned: GameEntity) {
        upsertScannedGamesBatch(context, listOf(scanned))
    }

    suspend fun upsertScannedGame(scanned: GameEntity) {
        val existing = gameDao.getGameByRomPath(scanned.romPath)
        if (existing == null) {
            gameDao.insertGame(scanned)
            return
        }
        gameDao.insertGame(mergeScannedGame(existing, scanned))
    }

    companion object {
        private fun safeMergeString(existing: String?, scanned: String?): String? {
            if (!existing.isNullOrBlank()) return existing
            if (!scanned.isNullOrBlank()) return scanned
            return existing
        }

        /**
         * Merge scanner/metadata fields while preserving user-owned and generated data.
         * This is intentionally pure so the rule can be regression-tested without Room.
         */
        fun mergeScannedGame(existing: GameEntity, scanned: GameEntity): GameEntity = existing.copy(
            romPath = scanned.romPath,
            fileName = scanned.fileName ?: existing.fileName,
            filePath = scanned.filePath ?: existing.filePath,
            title = safeMergeString(existing.title, scanned.title) ?: existing.title,
            platform = safeMergeString(existing.platform, scanned.platform) ?: existing.platform,
            sourceId = safeMergeString(existing.sourceId, scanned.sourceId),
            iconPath = safeMergeString(existing.iconPath, scanned.iconPath),
            coverPath = safeMergeString(existing.coverPath, scanned.coverPath),
            backgroundPath = safeMergeString(existing.backgroundPath, scanned.backgroundPath),
            logoPath = safeMergeString(existing.logoPath, scanned.logoPath),
            screenshotPath = safeMergeString(existing.screenshotPath, scanned.screenshotPath),
            description = safeMergeString(existing.description, scanned.description),
            developer = safeMergeString(existing.developer, scanned.developer),
            publisher = safeMergeString(existing.publisher, scanned.publisher),
            genre = safeMergeString(existing.genre, scanned.genre),
            releaseDate = safeMergeString(existing.releaseDate, scanned.releaseDate),
            composer = safeMergeString(existing.composer, scanned.composer),
            rating = if (existing.rating != 0f) existing.rating else scanned.rating,
            isFavorite = existing.isFavorite,
            playCount = existing.playCount,
            playTimeMinutes = existing.playTimeMinutes,
            playStatus = existing.playStatus,
            customCollections = existing.customCollections,
            lastPlayed = existing.lastPlayed,
            addedAt = existing.addedAt,
            museumJson = existing.museumJson,
            dnaJson = existing.dnaJson,
            evolutionJson = existing.evolutionJson,
            cheatsJson = existing.cheatsJson,
            retroAchievementsJson = existing.retroAchievementsJson
        )
    }

    suspend fun deleteGameById(id: Int) {
        gameDao.deleteGameById(id)
    }

    suspend fun deleteGame(game: GameEntity) {
        gameDao.deleteGameById(game.id)
    }

    suspend fun clearAll() {
        gameDao.deleteAllGames()
    }
}

================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/maintenance/MaintenanceManager.kt
================================================================================
package com.example.maintenance

import com.example.database.GameEntity
import com.example.database.GameRepository
import com.example.p3.asset.AssetKind
import com.example.scraper.ImageScraperService
import com.example.database.TaskCheckpointDao
import com.example.database.TaskCheckpointEntity
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

enum class TaskStatus {
    QUEUED,
    RUNNING,
    PAUSED,
    COMPLETED,
    FAILED,
    CANCELLED
}

enum class MaintenanceStage {
    QUEUED,
    ANALYZE,
    METADATA,
    ASSETS,
    DESCRIPTION,
    REPORT,
    COMPLETED
}

data class MaintenanceTask(
    val id: String = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val name: String = "全庫一鍵維護與整理",
    val stage: MaintenanceStage = MaintenanceStage.QUEUED,
    val status: TaskStatus = TaskStatus.QUEUED,
    val currentItem: String = "",
    val completedCount: Int = 0,
    val totalCount: Int = 0,
    val dryRun: Boolean = false,
    val progressPercent: Float = 0f,
    val error: String? = null,
    val logMessages: List<String> = emptyList()
)

class MaintenanceManager(
    private val repository: GameRepository,
    private val scraperServiceProvider: () -> ImageScraperService?,
    private val checkpointDao: TaskCheckpointDao,
    private val assetRootUriProvider: () -> android.net.Uri? = { null },
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO)
) {
    private val _currentTask = MutableStateFlow<MaintenanceTask?>(null)
    val currentTask: StateFlow<MaintenanceTask?> = _currentTask.asStateFlow()

    private var activeJob: Job? = null
    private var isPaused = false
    private var isCancelled = false

    init {
        // Load checkpoint on initialization if available
        scope.launch {
            val checkpoints = checkpointDao.getAllCheckpoints()
            if (checkpoints.isNotEmpty()) {
                val cp = checkpoints.first()
                if (cp.status == TaskStatus.PAUSED.name || cp.status == TaskStatus.RUNNING.name || cp.status == TaskStatus.QUEUED.name) {
                    val stageValue = runCatching { MaintenanceStage.valueOf(cp.stage) }.getOrDefault(MaintenanceStage.QUEUED)
                    val statusValue = if (cp.status == TaskStatus.RUNNING.name) TaskStatus.PAUSED else runCatching { TaskStatus.valueOf(cp.status) }.getOrDefault(TaskStatus.PAUSED)
                    
                    _currentTask.value = MaintenanceTask(
                        id = cp.id,
                        name = cp.name,
                        stage = stageValue,
                        status = statusValue,
                        currentItem = cp.currentItem,
                        completedCount = cp.completedCount,
                        totalCount = cp.totalCount,
                        dryRun = cp.dryRun,
                        progressPercent = if (cp.totalCount > 0) cp.completedCount.toFloat() / cp.totalCount.toFloat() else 0f,
                        logMessages = listOf("已從中斷點恢復進度：${cp.stage}")
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun saveCheckpoint(task: MaintenanceTask) {
        val entity = TaskCheckpointEntity(
            id = task.id,
            name = task.name,
            stage = task.stage.name,
            status = task.status.name,
            completedCount = task.completedCount,
            totalCount = task.totalCount,
            currentItem = task.currentItem,
            dryRun = task.dryRun,
            updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
        )
        checkpointDao.upsertCheckpoint(entity)
    }

    fun startMaintenance(
        games: List<GameEntity>, 
        dryRun: Boolean = false, 
        resumeTask: MaintenanceTask? = null,
        generateDescription: suspend (GameEntity) -> Unit = {}
    ) {
        activeJob?.cancel()
        isPaused = false
        isCancelled = false

        val resumeFrom = resumeTask?.stage ?: MaintenanceStage.ANALYZE
        val resumeCompleted = resumeTask?.completedCount ?: 0

        val initialTask = resumeTask?.copy(
            status = TaskStatus.RUNNING,
            dryRun = dryRun
        ) ?: MaintenanceTask(
            stage = MaintenanceStage.ANALYZE,
            status = TaskStatus.RUNNING,
            totalCount = games.size,
            dryRun = dryRun,
            logMessages = listOf("任務啟動 (DryRun=$dryRun) - 共有 ${games.size} 款遊戲待檢核")
        )
        _currentTask.value = initialTask

        activeJob = scope.launch {
            try {
                // Counters for report
                var normalizedPlatformsCount = 0
                var repairedAssetsCount = 0
                var generatedDescCount = 0
                var missingAssets = 0
                var missingDesc = 0

                // 1. Stage: ANALYZE
                if (MaintenanceStage.ANALYZE.ordinal >= resumeFrom.ordinal) {
                    updateStage(MaintenanceStage.ANALYZE, "正在分析全庫遊戲中繼資料與資產缺失率...")
                    delay(200)
                    for (g in games) {
                        if (g.coverPath.isNullOrBlank() || g.backgroundPath.isNullOrBlank() || g.logoPath.isNullOrBlank() || g.screenshotPath.isNullOrBlank() || g.iconPath.isNullOrBlank()) missingAssets++
                        if (g.description.isNullOrBlank()) missingDesc++
                    }
                    appendLog("【分析報告】總遊戲數: ${games.size} | 缺少資材遊戲: $missingAssets 款 | 缺少簡介遊戲: $missingDesc 款")
                }

                // 2. Stage: METADATA
                if (MaintenanceStage.METADATA.ordinal >= resumeFrom.ordinal) {
                    checkPauseAndCancel()
                    updateStage(MaintenanceStage.METADATA, "正在校驗並正規化平台與標籤...")
                    val metaResumeOffset = if (resumeFrom == MaintenanceStage.METADATA) resumeCompleted else 0
                    for ((idx, g) in games.withIndex()) {
                        if (idx < metaResumeOffset) continue
                        checkPauseAndCancel()
                        updateProgress(idx + 1, games.size, "校驗中繼資料: [${g.platform}] ${g.title}")
                        
                        val canonicalPlat = com.example.scanner.PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(g.platform)
                        if (canonicalPlat != g.platform) {
                            normalizedPlatformsCount++
                            if (!dryRun) {
                                repository.updateGame(g.copy(platform = canonicalPlat))
                                appendLog("【平台正規化】${g.title}: ${g.platform} -> $canonicalPlat")
                            }
                        }
                        delay(5)
                    }
                }

                // 3. Stage: ASSETS
                if (MaintenanceStage.ASSETS.ordinal >= resumeFrom.ordinal) {
                    checkPauseAndCancel()
                    updateStage(MaintenanceStage.ASSETS, "正在執行資產檢查與補充...")
                    val scraper = scraperServiceProvider()
                    val assetRoot = assetRootUriProvider()
                    val assetResumeOffset = if (resumeFrom == MaintenanceStage.ASSETS) resumeCompleted else 0
                    for ((idx, g) in games.withIndex()) {
                        if (idx < assetResumeOffset) continue
                        checkPauseAndCancel()
                        updateProgress(idx + 1, games.size, "檢查資產: ${g.title}")
                        if (!dryRun && scraper != null && (g.coverPath.isNullOrBlank() || g.backgroundPath.isNullOrBlank() || g.logoPath.isNullOrBlank() || g.screenshotPath.isNullOrBlank() || g.iconPath.isNullOrBlank())) {
                            try {
                                val res = scraper.scrapeGame(
                                    gameTitle = g.title,
                                    platform = g.platform,
                                    assetRootUri = assetRoot,
                                    assetKinds = setOf(AssetKind.BOX_FRONT, AssetKind.HERO, AssetKind.TITLE, AssetKind.SLIDE, AssetKind.ICON),
                                    missingOnly = true
                                )
                                if (res.successCount > 0) {
                                    repairedAssetsCount += res.successCount
                                    var newCover = g.coverPath
                                    var newHero = g.backgroundPath
                                    var newLogo = g.logoPath
                                    var newSlide = g.screenshotPath
                                    var newIcon = g.iconPath

                                    for (r in res.results) {
                                        if (r.localUri != null) {
                                            when (r.kind) {
                                                AssetKind.BOX_FRONT -> newCover = r.localUri
                                                AssetKind.HERO -> newHero = r.localUri
                                                AssetKind.TITLE -> newLogo = r.localUri
                                                AssetKind.SLIDE -> newSlide = r.localUri
                                                AssetKind.ICON -> newIcon = r.localUri
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    repository.updateAssets(g.id, newCover, newHero, newLogo, newSlide, newIcon)
                                    appendLog("【資產修復】${g.title} 成功補充 ${res.successCount} 項資產")
                                }
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                appendLog("【資產修復】${g.title} 刮削失敗: ${e.message}")
                            }
                        }
                        delay(15)
                    }
                }

                // 4. Stage: DESCRIPTION
                if (MaintenanceStage.DESCRIPTION.ordinal >= resumeFrom.ordinal) {
                    checkPauseAndCancel()
                    updateStage(MaintenanceStage.DESCRIPTION, "整理簡介與自訂分類索引...")
                    val descResumeOffset = if (resumeFrom == MaintenanceStage.DESCRIPTION) resumeCompleted else 0
                    for ((idx, g) in games.withIndex()) {
                        if (idx < descResumeOffset) continue
                        checkPauseAndCancel()
                        updateProgress(idx + 1, games.size, "生成簡介: ${g.title}")
                        if (!dryRun && g.description.isNullOrBlank()) {
                            try {
                                generateDescription(g)
                                generatedDescCount++
                                appendLog("【簡介補充】成功生成 ${g.title} 的簡介")
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                appendLog("【簡介補充】生成 ${g.title} 的簡介失敗: ${e.message}")
                            }
                        }
                        delay(10)
                    }
                }

                // 5. Stage: REPORT
                if (MaintenanceStage.REPORT.ordinal >= resumeFrom.ordinal) {
                    checkPauseAndCancel()
                    updateStage(MaintenanceStage.REPORT, "產生資料庫健康維護報告...")
                    val reportSummary = buildString {
                        append("================ 維護彙整報告 ================\n")
                        append("• 總遊戲檢核數: ${games.size}\n")
                        append("• 平台正規化修復: $normalizedPlatformsCount 款\n")
                        append("• 資產項目成功補充: $repairedAssetsCount 項\n")
                        append("• 簡介文檔成功生成: $generatedDescCount 篇\n")
                        append("• 模式: ${if (dryRun) "唯讀模擬 (DryRun)" else "實體更新"}\n")
                        append("=============================================")
                    }
                    appendLog(reportSummary)
                    delay(200)
                }

                // 6. Stage: COMPLETED
                _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(
                    stage = MaintenanceStage.COMPLETED,
                    status = TaskStatus.COMPLETED,
                    currentItem = "維護流程全部順利完成！",
                    progressPercent = 1.0f,
                    logMessages = _currentTask.value?.logMessages.orEmpty() + "維護任務順利完成"
                )
                _currentTask.value?.let { saveCheckpoint(it) }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (isCancelled) {
                    _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(
                        status = TaskStatus.CANCELLED,
                        currentItem = "任務已由使用者取消"
                    )
                } else {
                    _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(
                        status = TaskStatus.FAILED,
                        error = e.message
                    )
                }
                _currentTask.value?.let { saveCheckpoint(it) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun pause() {
        isPaused = true
        _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(status = TaskStatus.PAUSED)
        _currentTask.value?.let { task -> scope.launch { saveCheckpoint(task) } }
    }

    fun resume(
        games: List<GameEntity>? = null,
        generateDescription: (suspend (GameEntity) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        if (activeJob != null && activeJob?.isActive == true) {
            isPaused = false
            _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(status = TaskStatus.RUNNING)
            _currentTask.value?.let { task -> scope.launch { saveCheckpoint(task) } }
        } else if (games != null && generateDescription != null) {
            val current = _currentTask.value
            if (current != null) {
                // Work context was lost (e.g. app restarted), re-launch idempotent maintenance process
                startMaintenance(games, current.dryRun, resumeTask = current, generateDescription = generateDescription)
            }
        }
    }

    fun cancel() {
        isCancelled = true
        activeJob?.cancel()
        _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(
            status = TaskStatus.CANCELLED,
            currentItem = "已停止任務"
        )
        _currentTask.value?.let { task -> scope.launch { saveCheckpoint(task) } }
    }

    private suspend fun checkPauseAndCancel() {
        while (isPaused) {
            delay(200)
        }
        if (isCancelled) throw RuntimeException("任務已取消")
    }

    private suspend fun updateStage(stage: MaintenanceStage, msg: String) {
        _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(
            stage = stage,
            currentItem = msg,
            logMessages = _currentTask.value?.logMessages.orEmpty() + msg
        )
        _currentTask.value?.let { saveCheckpoint(it) }
    }

    private suspend fun updateProgress(completed: Int, total: Int, item: String) {
        val pct = if (total > 0) completed.toFloat() / total.toFloat() else 0f
        _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(
            completedCount = completed,
            totalCount = total,
            currentItem = item,
            progressPercent = pct
        )
        _currentTask.value?.let { saveCheckpoint(it) }
    }

    private fun appendLog(msg: String) {
        _currentTask.value = _currentTask.value?.copy(
            logMessages = _currentTask.value?.logMessages.orEmpty() + msg
        )
    }
}

package com.example.media

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream

object AppImageStorage {
    fun copyToPrivateStorage(context: Context, sourceUri: Uri, fileName: String): String? {
        return try {
            val destFile = File(context.filesDir, fileName)
            context.contentResolver.openInputStream(sourceUri)?.use { input ->
                FileOutputStream(destFile).use { output ->
                    input.copyTo(output)
                }
            }
            Uri.fromFile(destFile).toString()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            null
        }
    }

    fun remove(context: Context, fileName: String) {
        try {
            val file = File(context.filesDir, fileName)
            if (file.exists()) {
                file.delete()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/metadata/MetadataCsvService.kt
