package com.example.p3.asset

object GameNameNormalizer {

    // Known standard ROM region names (case-insensitive)
    val KNOWN_REGIONS = setOf(
        "usa", "europe", "japan", "world", "asia", "korea", "australia",
        "germany", "france", "spain", "italy", "sweden", "netherlands",
        "brazil", "china", "pal", "ntsc"
    )

    // Known standard ISO 639-1 / 639-2 ROM language codes (case-insensitive)
    val KNOWN_LANGUAGES = setOf(
        "en", "ja", "fr", "de", "es", "it", "nl", "pt", "sv", "no", "da", "fi", "zh", "ko",
        "el", "pl", "ru", "cs", "hu", "tr"
    )

    // Regex for version, revision, dump tags, disc/track tags, and miscellaneous standard release descriptors
    private val REVISION_OR_TAG_PATTERN = Regex(
        """^(?:Rev(?:\s*[0-9a-zA-Z]+)?|v[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9a-zA-Z]+)*|Version\s*[0-9a-zA-Z.]+|Beta(?:\s*[0-9]+)?|Proto(?:type)?(?:\s*[0-9]+)?|Sample|Demo|Alt(?:\s*[0-9]+)?|Disc\s*\d+|Disk\s*\d+|Tape\s*\d+|Side\s*[A-Z0-9]|Track\s*\d+|Unl|Hack|Headerless|Virtual\s*Console|WiiWare|PSN|XBLA|Game\s*Cube|Switch|Android|MAME|FBA|FBNeo|No-Intro|GoodROM|T-En.*|T-Chi.*|Translated.*|[0-9]{4}(?:-[0-9]{2}(?:-[0-9]{2})?)?)$""",
        RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE
    )

    private val BRACKET_CONTENT_PATTERN = Regex("""[\(\[](.*?)[\)\]]""")

    /**
     * Determines whether the inside of a bracket (parentheses or square brackets) represents valid structured ROM release metadata:
     * 1. Known single region name (e.g. "USA", "Europe", "Japan") or composite regions ("USA, Europe")
     * 2. Comma-separated language group (e.g. "En,Fr,De,Es,It", "En,Ja", "Fr,De", "En")
     * 3. Known revision, version, prototype, dump, or release tag (e.g. "Rev 1", "v1.0", "Beta", "[!]")
     */
    fun isStructuredReleaseMetadata(content: String): Boolean {
        val trimmed = content.trim()
        if (trimmed.isEmpty()) return false

        // Check single region
        if (KNOWN_REGIONS.contains(trimmed.lowercase())) return true

        // Check comma-separated language group or comma-separated regions
        val parts = trimmed.split(',').map { it.trim().lowercase() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        if (parts.size > 1) {
            val allLanguages = parts.all { KNOWN_LANGUAGES.contains(it) }
            if (allLanguages) return true

            val allRegions = parts.all { KNOWN_REGIONS.contains(it) }
            if (allRegions) return true

            val mixedRegionLanguage = parts.all { KNOWN_REGIONS.contains(it) || KNOWN_LANGUAGES.contains(it) }
            if (mixedRegionLanguage) return true
        } else if (parts.size == 1) {
            if (KNOWN_LANGUAGES.contains(parts[0])) return true
        }

        // Check revision, version, disk, or release tag pattern
        if (REVISION_OR_TAG_PATTERN.matches(trimmed)) return true

        // Check GoodTools bracket tags (e.g. !, b1, a1, h1, o, etc.)
        if (trimmed.matches(Regex("""^(?:!|b[0-9]*|a[0-9]*|f[0-9]*|h[0-9]*|p[0-9]*|t[0-9]*|o[0-9]*|v[0-9]*|m[0-9]*|u[0-9]*|x[0-9]*|cr[0-9]*|tr[0-9]*|T[+-][a-zA-Z0-9]+|OEM|Promo|Unl|Hack|M[0-9]+|C[0-9]+|S[0-9]+|F[0-9]+|P[0-9]+)$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE))) {
            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    fun normalize(name: String): String {
        return normalizeArticles(name).lowercase()
            .replace(Regex("[_\\-]"), " ")
            .replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
            .trim()
    }

    fun normalizeArticles(s: String): String {
        var result = s.trim()
        result = result.replace(Regex("""^([^,]+),\s*(the|a|an)\b(.*)$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)) { match ->
            val main = match.groupValues[1].trim()
            val article = match.groupValues[2].trim()
            val rest = match.groupValues[3].trim()
            if (rest.isNotBlank()) "$article $main $rest" else "$article $main"
        }
        return result
    }

    /**
     * Canonicalizes a title or folder name into its Core Title:
     * 1. Strips file extensions if present
     * 2. Reliably identifies and strips structured ROM release metadata blocks (regions, language groups, versions, revisions, dump tags)
     * 3. Normalizes articles (e.g. "Legend of Zelda, The" -> "The Legend of Zelda")
     * 4. Normalizes whitespace, underscores, dashes, and standardizes Unicode quotes/dashes
     * 5. Lowercases for deterministic comparison
     */
    fun canonicalCoreTitle(rawName: String): String {
        val withoutExt = rawName.trim().substringBeforeLast('.')

        // Replace only structured release metadata brackets
        val strippedMetadata = BRACKET_CONTENT_PATTERN.replace(withoutExt) { matchResult ->
            val insideBracket = matchResult.groupValues[1]
            if (isStructuredReleaseMetadata(insideBracket)) {
                " "
            } else {
                matchResult.value // Preserve valid bracketed title parts (e.g. (The), (Adventure), etc.)
            }
        }

        val articleNormalized = normalizeArticles(strippedMetadata)
        return articleNormalized.lowercase()
            .replace('\'', '\'')
            .replace('"', '"')
            .replace('`', '\'')
            .replace(Regex("[_\\-–—:.]"), " ")
            .replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
            .trim()
    }

    fun variants(title: String): List<String> {
        val trimmed = title.trim()
        val normalized = normalize(trimmed)
        val articleNormalized = normalizeArticles(trimmed)
        val withoutBracket = trimmed.replace(Regex("\\(.*?\\)|\\[.*?\\]"), "").trim()
        val result = mutableListOf(trimmed)
        
        if (articleNormalized.isNotBlank() && articleNormalized != trimmed) {
            result.add(articleNormalized)
        }
        if (withoutBracket.isNotBlank() && withoutBracket != trimmed) {
            result.add(withoutBracket)
        }
        val core = canonicalCoreTitle(trimmed)
        if (core.isNotBlank() && core != trimmed && core != normalized) {
            result.add(core)
        }
        if (normalized.isNotBlank() && normalized != trimmed && normalized != withoutBracket) {
            result.add(normalized)
        }
        
        return result.distinct()
    }
}

package com.example.p3.asset

import android.content.Context
import com.example.scanner.PlatformRegistry
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL
import java.net.URLEncoder

interface ImageProvider {
    val id: String
    val name: String
    suspend fun search(query: String, platform: String, kind: AssetKind, apiKey: String): String?
}

data class ProviderStat(val providerId: String, val platform: String, val total: Int = 0, val success: Int = 0) {
    val successRate: Float get() = if (total > 0) success.toFloat() / total.toFloat() else 0.5f
}

class ImageProviderRegistry(private val context: Context) {
    private val providerList = mutableListOf<ImageProvider>()
    private val statsMap = mutableMapOf<String, ProviderStat>()
    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("provider_stats", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    init {
        register(SteamGridDbProvider())
        register(LibretroThumbnailsProvider())
        register(WikimediaImageProvider())
        loadStats()
    }

    private fun loadStats() {
        val jsonStr = prefs.getString("stats", null) ?: return
        try {
            val json = org.json.JSONObject(jsonStr)
            json.keys().forEach { key ->
                val obj = json.getJSONObject(key)
                statsMap[key] = ProviderStat(
                    providerId = obj.getString("providerId"),
                    platform = obj.getString("platform"),
                    total = obj.getInt("total"),
                    success = obj.getInt("success")
                )
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun saveStats() {
        try {
            val json = org.json.JSONObject()
            statsMap.forEach { (k, v) ->
                val obj = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
                    put("providerId", v.providerId)
                    put("platform", v.platform)
                    put("total", v.total)
                    put("success", v.success)
                }
                json.put(k, obj)
            }
            prefs.edit().putString("stats", json.toString()).apply()
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    fun providers(): List<ImageProvider> = providerList

    fun register(provider: ImageProvider) {
        if (providerList.none { it.id == provider.id }) {
            providerList.add(provider)
        }
    }

    fun ordered(platform: String): List<ImageProvider> {
        val canonicalPlat = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform)
        return providerList.sortedByDescending { provider ->
            val stat = statsMap["${provider.id}_$canonicalPlat"]
            stat?.successRate ?: 0.5f
        }
    }

    fun stat(providerId: String, platform: String): ProviderStat {
        val canonicalPlat = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform)
        return statsMap["${providerId}_$canonicalPlat"] ?: ProviderStat(providerId, canonicalPlat)
    }

    fun record(providerId: String, platform: String, success: Boolean) {
        val canonicalPlat = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform)
        val key = "${providerId}_$canonicalPlat"
        val current = statsMap[key] ?: ProviderStat(providerId, canonicalPlat, 0, 0)
        statsMap[key] = current.copy(
            total = current.total + 1,
            success = if (success) current.success + 1 else current.success
        )
        saveStats()
    }
}

class SteamGridDbProvider : ImageProvider {
    override val id: String = "steamgriddb"
    override val name: String = "SteamGridDB"

    override suspend fun search(query: String, platform: String, kind: AssetKind, apiKey: String): String? {
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) return null
        return try {
            val authHeader = "Bearer ${apiKey.trim()}"
            val searchRes = com.example.network.NetworkModule.steamGridDbApi.searchGame(query, authHeader)
            if (!searchRes.success || searchRes.data.isEmpty()) return null
            
            val matchedCandidate = AssetMatcher.findBestMatchCandidate(
                candidates = searchRes.data,
                getName = { it.name },
                gameTitle = query
            ) ?: return null

            val gameId = matchedCandidate.id
            val imgRes = when (kind) {
                AssetKind.HERO -> com.example.network.NetworkModule.steamGridDbApi.getHeroes(gameId, authHeader)
                AssetKind.TITLE -> com.example.network.NetworkModule.steamGridDbApi.getLogos(gameId, authHeader)
                else -> com.example.network.NetworkModule.steamGridDbApi.getGrids(gameId, authHeader)
            }
            if (imgRes.success) imgRes.data.firstOrNull()?.url else null
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
}

class LibretroThumbnailsProvider : ImageProvider {
    override val id: String = "libretro"
    override val name: String = "Libretro Thumbnails"

    private val platformRepoMap = mapOf(
        "GBA" to "Nintendo - Game Boy Advance",
        "GBC" to "Nintendo - Game Boy Color",
        "GB" to "Nintendo - Game Boy",
        "NES" to "Nintendo - Nintendo Entertainment System",
        "SNES" to "Nintendo - Super Nintendo Entertainment System",
        "N64" to "Nintendo - Nintendo 64",
        "NDS" to "Nintendo - Nintendo DS",
        "3DS" to "Nintendo - Nintendo 3DS",
        "GameCube" to "Nintendo - GameCube",
        "Wii" to "Nintendo - Wii",
        "PS1" to "Sony - PlayStation",
        "PS2" to "Sony - PlayStation 2",
        "PSP" to "Sony - PlayStation Portable",
        "Genesis" to "Sega - Mega Drive - Genesis",
        "Saturn" to "Sega - Saturn",
        "Dreamcast" to "Sega - Dreamcast",
        "MasterSystem" to "Sega - Master System - Mark III",
        "GameGear" to "Sega - Game Gear",
        "PCEngine" to "NEC - PC Engine - TurboGrafx 16",
        "Arcade" to "MAME"
    )

    override suspend fun search(query: String, platform: String, kind: AssetKind, apiKey: String): String? {
        val canonical = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform)
        val repoPlatform = platformRepoMap[canonical] ?: return null
        val folder = when (kind) {
            AssetKind.BOX_FRONT -> "Named_Boxarts"
            AssetKind.SLIDE -> "Named_Snaps"
            AssetKind.TITLE -> "Named_Titles"
            else -> "Named_Boxarts"
        }

        val cleanedQuery = query.replace('&', '_').replace('/', '_').replace('\\', '_')
        val encodedPlatform = URLEncoder.encode(repoPlatform, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20")
        val encodedFolder = URLEncoder.encode(folder, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20")
        val encodedName = URLEncoder.encode("$cleanedQuery.png", "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20")

        val targetUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libretro-thumbnails/$encodedPlatform/master/$encodedFolder/$encodedName"

        return try {
            val connection = URL(targetUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            connection.requestMethod = "HEAD"
            connection.connectTimeout = 4000
            connection.readTimeout = 4000
            connection.instanceFollowRedirects = true
            val code = connection.responseCode
            if (code in 200..299) targetUrl else null
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
}

class GenericJsonImageProvider(
    override val id: String,
    val baseUrl: String,
    val resultField: String = "url"
) : ImageProvider {
    override val name: String = id

    override suspend fun search(query: String, platform: String, kind: AssetKind, apiKey: String): String? {
        if (baseUrl.isBlank()) return null
        val encodedQuery = java.net.URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8")
        val encodedPlatform = java.net.URLEncoder.encode(platform, "UTF-8")
        val targetUrl = baseUrl.replace("{query}", encodedQuery).replace("{platform}", encodedPlatform)
        
        return try {
            val connection = java.net.URL(targetUrl).openConnection() as java.net.HttpURLConnection
            connection.requestMethod = "GET"
            if (apiKey.isNotBlank()) {
                connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
            }
            connection.connectTimeout = 5000
            connection.readTimeout = 5000
            
            val response = connection.inputStream.bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
            val json = org.json.JSONObject(response)
            
            if (json.has(resultField)) {
                json.getString(resultField)
            } else {
                null
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
}

class WikimediaImageProvider : ImageProvider {
    override val id: String = "wikimedia"
    override val name: String = "Wikimedia Commons"

    override suspend fun search(query: String, platform: String, kind: AssetKind, apiKey: String): String? {
        val searchPhrase = java.net.URLEncoder.encode("$query game", "UTF-8")
        val targetUrl = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=pageimages&format=json&piprop=original&titles=$searchPhrase"
        
        return try {
            val connection = java.net.URL(targetUrl).openConnection() as java.net.HttpURLConnection
            connection.requestMethod = "GET"
            connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "AIStudioApplet/1.0")
            connection.connectTimeout = 5000
            connection.readTimeout = 5000
            
            val response = connection.inputStream.bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
            val json = org.json.JSONObject(response)
            val pages = json.getJSONObject("query").getJSONObject("pages")
            val firstKey = pages.keys().next()
            if (firstKey == "-1") return null
            
            val page = pages.getJSONObject(firstKey)
            if (page.has("original")) {
                page.getJSONObject("original").getString("source")
            } else {
                null
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
}

package com.example.p3.asset

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.OpenableColumns
import android.util.Log
import com.example.database.GameEntity
import com.example.scanner.PlatformRegistry
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.zip.CRC32

object RomIdentityUtils {
    private const val TAG = "RomIdentityUtils"
    private val hashCache = ConcurrentHashMap<String, String>()

    fun getStableRomIdentity(context: Context, game: GameEntity): String {
        return getStableRomIdentity(context, game.romPath, game.platform, game.aiDetectedTitle ?: game.title)
    }

    private fun safeSkip(stream: java.io.InputStream, target: Long): Boolean {
        var rem = target
        while (rem > 0) {
            val s = stream.skip(rem)
            if (s <= 0) return false
            rem -= s
        }
        return true
    }

    fun getStableRomIdentity(
        context: Context,
        romPath: String,
        platform: String,
        title: String
    ): String {
        val normPlatform = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform)
        val normTitle = title.lowercase().trim().replace("\\s+".toRegex(), "_")
        val pathHash = if (romPath.isNotBlank()) romPath.hashCode().toUInt().toString(16) else "0"

        if (romPath.isBlank()) {
            return "STABLE_${normPlatform}_$normTitle"
        }

        val uri = Uri.parse(romPath)
        var fileSize: Long = -1L

        if (romPath.startsWith("content://")) {
            try {
                context.contentResolver.query(uri, arrayOf(OpenableColumns.SIZE), null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
                    if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                        val sizeIndex = cursor.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.SIZE)
                        if (sizeIndex != -1) fileSize = cursor.getLong(sizeIndex)
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.d(TAG, "Could not query size for content URI $romPath: ${e.message}")
            }
        }

        if (fileSize <= 0) {
            val file = File(uri.path ?: "")
            if (file.exists()) fileSize = file.length()
        }

        val cacheKey = "$normPlatform::$romPath::$fileSize"
        hashCache[cacheKey]?.let { return it }

        val hash = try {
            var crc32Value: Long = -1L
            try {
                context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { stream ->
                    val crc = CRC32()
                    val headBuffer = ByteArray(65536)
                    val bytesRead = stream.read(headBuffer, 0, headBuffer.size)
                    if (bytesRead > 0) {
                        crc.update(headBuffer, 0, bytesRead)

                        // Tiered multi-region sampling for files larger than 128KB (head + mid + tail)
                        if (fileSize > 131072L) {
                            try {
                                val skipBytes = (fileSize / 2) - bytesRead
                                if (skipBytes > 0 && safeSkip(stream, skipBytes)) {
                                    val sampleBuffer = ByteArray(65536)
                                    val sampleRead = stream.read(sampleBuffer, 0, sampleBuffer.size)
                                    if (sampleRead > 0) {
                                        crc.update(sampleBuffer, 0, sampleRead)
                                    }
                                }
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                Log.d(TAG, "Multi-region sample skip failed for $romPath: ${e.message}")
                            }

                            // Tail 64KB sample
                            try {
                                context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { tailStream ->
                                    val targetSkip = fileSize - 65536L
                                    if (targetSkip > 0 && safeSkip(tailStream, targetSkip)) {
                                        val tailBuffer = ByteArray(65536)
                                        val tailRead = tailStream.read(tailBuffer, 0, tailBuffer.size)
                                        if (tailRead > 0) {
                                            crc.update(tailBuffer, 0, tailRead)
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                Log.d(TAG, "Tail sample read failed for $romPath: ${e.message}")
                            }
                        }
                        crc32Value = crc.value
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.d(TAG, "InputStream read failed for $romPath: ${e.message}")
            }

            if (fileSize > 0 && crc32Value >= 0) {
                "ROMHASH_${normPlatform}_${fileSize}_${crc32Value.toString(16)}"
            } else if (fileSize > 0) {
                "ROMSIZE_${normPlatform}_${fileSize}_$pathHash"
            } else {
                "STABLE_${normPlatform}_${normTitle}_$pathHash"
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Error generating identity for $romPath, using fallback: ${e.message}")
            "STABLE_${normPlatform}_${normTitle}_$pathHash"
        }

        hashCache[cacheKey] = hash
        return hash
    }
}

package com.example.research

import android.content.Context
import android.util.Log
import com.example.agent.AICuratorAgent
import com.example.api.AiFeature
import com.example.api.ApiKeyRotationManager
import com.example.api.ApiProfile
import com.example.api.AiProviderResolver
import com.example.api.AiRequest
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File

data class ResearchResult(
    val gameTitle: String,
    val platform: String,
    val answerText: String,
    val sources: List<ResearchSource>,
    val usedWebSearch: Boolean,
    val searchReason: String? = null,
    val providerUsed: String = "",
    val modelUsed: String = "",
    val timestampMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

class ResearchEngine(
    private val context: Context,
    private val profilesProvider: () -> List<ApiProfile>,
    private val rotationManager: ApiKeyRotationManager = ApiKeyRotationManager(),
    private val resolver: AiProviderResolver = AiProviderResolver(),
    private val searchService: WebSearchService = DefaultWebSearchService
) {
    private val TAG = "ResearchEngine"

    /**
     * Evaluates whether Web Search is needed given a user query, search mode, and local data status.
     */
    suspend fun evaluateNeedWebSearch(
        userPrompt: String,
        searchMode: String,
        localDataAvailable: Boolean = false
    ): Pair<Boolean, String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        when (searchMode.uppercase()) {
            "SEARCH_OFF" -> return@withContext Pair(false, "使用者設定停用 Web Search")
            "ALWAYS_SEARCH" -> return@withContext Pair(true, "使用者設定一律使用 Web Search")
            else -> { // SMART_SEARCH
                // 1. Explicit search / verify triggers
                val explicitSearchKeywords = listOf(
                    "搜尋", "查證", "網路查", "網路上", "verify", "search", "google", "查一下", "找一下"
                )
                if (explicitSearchKeywords.any { userPrompt.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }) {
                    return@withContext Pair(true, "使用者明確要求網路檢索與查證")
                }

                // 2. Time-sensitive, current info, price, version, Steam queries
                val timeKeywords = listOf(
                    "目前", "最新", "現在", "今天", "最近", "近況", "2025", "2026",
                    "發售", "更新", "版本", "價格", "Steam", "折扣", "特價", "支援", "是否還有",
                    "latest", "current", "recent", "today", "release", "update", "version", "price"
                )
                if (timeKeywords.any { userPrompt.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }) {
                    return@withContext Pair(true, "詢問即時最新動態、版本或價格特價資訊")
                }

                // 3. Basic history / common knowledge questions without time sensitivity
                val commonKnowledgePatterns = listOf(
                    "什麼是", "簡介", "介紹", "玩法", "主角是誰", "世界觀", "創作理念", "歷史地位"
                )
                val isBasicOverview = commonKnowledgePatterns.any { userPrompt.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }
                if (isBasicOverview && localDataAvailable) {
                    return@withContext Pair(false, "本機館藏資料庫已有完整紀錄與基礎知識")
                }

                // 4. Smart AI Decision Prompt
                val systemPrompt = """
                    你是一個電玩館藏檢索決策器。請評估使用者詢問的內容是否需要發起網際網路搜尋。
                    需要搜尋 (needWebSearch = true)：
                    1. 詢問最新動態、目前版本的發售或更新狀態、Steam 特價、最新模擬器現況
                    2. 詢問具爭議性或冷門的確切價格、特定發售年月日、跨平台移植狀態
                    3. 需要外部權威網站查證的多來源資料
                    不需要搜尋 (needWebSearch = false)：
                    1. 經典遊戲的歷史常識、特色介紹、開發者故事或著名經典主題
                    2. 基礎遊戲玩法、控制方式與風格美學討論
                    
                    請嚴格僅回覆 JSON 格式，勿加 markdown 標記：
                    {"needWebSearch": true, "reason": "說明原因"}
                """.trimIndent()

                val request = AiRequest(
                    prompt = userPrompt,
                    systemPrompt = systemPrompt,
                    temperature = 0.1f,
                    maxTokens = com.example.agent.TokenBudgetManager.resolveOutputBudget("SEARCH_DECISION")
                )

                val targetProfiles = resolver.resolve(AiFeature.RESEARCH, profilesProvider())
                val exec = rotationManager.executeWithFailover(targetProfiles, request)

                if (exec.success && exec.text.isNotBlank()) {
                    try {
                        val jsonText = exec.text.replace("```json", "").replace("```", "").trim()
                        val obj = JSONObject(jsonText)
                        val need = obj.optBoolean("needWebSearch", false)
                        val reason = obj.optString("reason", "Smart Search 智能判定")
                        return@withContext Pair(need, reason)
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                        Log.w(TAG, "Failed to parse Smart Search decision JSON: ${exec.text}")
                    }
                }

                return@withContext Pair(false, "無即時關鍵字，預設使用 AI 館長現有知識")
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Performs research with Smart / Always / Off search mode.
     */
    suspend fun researchCandidateData(
        game: com.example.database.GameEntity,
        missingFields: List<String>,
        searchMode: String,
        searchProvider: String,
        searchApiKey: String?,
        searchCustomEndpoint: String?
    ): Pair<com.example.database.GameEntity, String>? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (missingFields.isEmpty()) return@withContext null

        val userQuery = "請考據《${game.title}》(${game.platform}) 的以下缺失資訊：${missingFields.joinToString()}。"
        val researchRes = performResearch(
            gameTitle = game.title,
            platform = game.platform,
            userQuery = userQuery,
            searchMode = searchMode,
            searchProvider = searchProvider,
            searchApiKey = searchApiKey,
            searchCustomEndpoint = searchCustomEndpoint,
            localDescription = null
        )

        val systemPrompt = """
            你是一個資料解析與驗證器。請根據以下 Research 報告，提取出遊戲的 metadata。
            為了確保資料可信度，請為每個欄位提供 value、source 與 confidence (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)。
            必須只輸出合法的 JSON，不要加上 markdown 標記。
            範例格式：
            {
              "description": { "value": "文字介紹...", "source": "Wikipedia", "confidence": "HIGH" },
              "developer": { "value": "Nintendo", "source": "IGN", "confidence": "HIGH" },
              "publisher": { "value": "Nintendo", "source": "Official", "confidence": "HIGH" },
              "releaseDate": { "value": "1990-11-21", "source": "GameSpot", "confidence": "HIGH" },
              "genre": { "value": "Platformer", "source": "Wiki", "confidence": "HIGH" }
            }
            如果報告中找不到該欄位，請將該欄位填入 null。
        """.trimIndent()

        val request = AiRequest(
            prompt = "Research 報告與來源：\n${researchRes.answerText}\n來源：${researchRes.sources.map { it.url }}",
            systemPrompt = systemPrompt,
            temperature = 0.1f,
            maxTokens = com.example.agent.TokenBudgetManager.resolveOutputBudget("RESEARCH_CANDIDATE")
        )

        val targetProfiles = resolver.resolve(AiFeature.RESEARCH, profilesProvider())
        val exec = rotationManager.executeWithFailover(targetProfiles, request)

        if (exec.success && exec.text.isNotBlank()) {
            try {
                val cleanJson = exec.text.replace("```json", "").replace("```", "").trim()
                val json = org.json.JSONObject(cleanJson)
                
                // Helper to extract value only if confidence is HIGH and source is verified
                val knownSourceUrls = researchRes.sources.map { it.url.lowercase() }
                val knownSourceTitles = researchRes.sources.map { it.title.lowercase() }

                fun extractValidatedField(key: String): String? {
                    if (!json.has(key) || json.isNull(key)) return null
                    val fieldObj = json.optJSONObject(key) ?: return null
                    val conf = fieldObj.optString("confidence", "LOW").uppercase()
                    if (conf != "HIGH") return null
                    val value = fieldObj.optString("value", "").trim()
                    if (value.isBlank()) return null
                    
                    val source = fieldObj.optString("source", "").trim().lowercase()
                    // Strict validation: candidate source must match actual ResearchResult sources
                    val sourceValid = if (researchRes.sources.isNotEmpty()) {
                        source.isNotBlank() && (
                            knownSourceUrls.any { it.contains(source) || source.contains(it) } ||
                            knownSourceTitles.any { it.contains(source) || source.contains(it) }
                        )
                    } else {
                        // If Web Search was not used or yielded 0 sources, reject candidate external claims
                        false
                    }

                    return if (sourceValid) value else null
                }

                val candidateEntity = com.example.database.GameEntity(
                    id = game.id,
                    title = game.title,
                    platform = game.platform,
                    romPath = game.romPath,
                    description = extractValidatedField("description"),
                    developer = extractValidatedField("developer"),
                    publisher = extractValidatedField("publisher"),
                    releaseDate = extractValidatedField("releaseDate"),
                    genre = extractValidatedField("genre")
                )
                
                // Save provenance JSON to permanent app filesDir for persistent auditing
                try {
                    val provenanceDir = java.io.File(context.filesDir, "provenance")
                    if (!provenanceDir.exists()) provenanceDir.mkdirs()
                    val provenanceFile = java.io.File(provenanceDir, "provenance_${game.id}.json")
                    provenanceFile.writeText(cleanJson)
                } catch (e: Exception) { e.printStackTrace() }

                return@withContext Pair(candidateEntity, cleanJson)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
        }
        return@withContext null
    }

    suspend fun performResearch(
        gameTitle: String,
        platform: String,
        userQuery: String,
        searchMode: String = "SMART_SEARCH",
        searchProvider: String = "DUCKDUCKGO",
        searchApiKey: String? = null,
        searchCustomEndpoint: String? = null,
        localDescription: String? = null,
        appContext: com.example.agent.CuratorContext? = null
    ): ResearchResult = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val overallResult = kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull(30000L) {
            val (needSearch, decisionReason) = evaluateNeedWebSearch(userQuery, searchMode, !localDescription.isNullOrBlank())
            var sources = emptyList<ResearchSource>()
            var searchFailedNotice: String? = null
            val pageContents = mutableListOf<String>()

            if (needSearch) {
                // Build exact name & region search query (Section 16)
                val cleanTitle = gameTitle.substringBefore("(").trim()
                val regionTag = if (gameTitle.contains("(")) gameTitle.substringAfter("(").substringBefore(")").trim() else ""
                val exactSearchTarget = buildString {
                    if (cleanTitle.isNotBlank()) {
                        append("\"$cleanTitle\" ")
                        if (regionTag.isNotBlank()) append("\"$regionTag\" ")
                        if (platform.isNotBlank()) append("$platform ")
                    }
                    append(userQuery)
                }.trim()

                val searchRes = searchService.search(exactSearchTarget, searchProvider, searchApiKey, searchCustomEndpoint)

                if (searchRes.sources.isNotEmpty()) {
                    // Rank sources by Credibility Tier (Tier 1 official > Tier 2 database > Tier 3 forum > Tier 4)
                    sources = searchRes.sources.sortedBy { it.tier }
                    
                    // Fetch top 3 sources' main page text with a strict timeout limit per page (Staged Budgeting)
                    var accumulatedTextLength = 0
                    val maxTotalPageLength = 3500
                    for (src in sources.take(3)) {
                        if (accumulatedTextLength >= maxTotalPageLength) break
                        try {
                            val pageText = kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull(4000L) {
                                WebPageFetcher.fetchMainText(src.url)
                            }
                            if (!pageText.isNullOrBlank()) {
                                val budgetRemaining = maxTotalPageLength - accumulatedTextLength
                                val trimmedPageText = pageText.take(budgetRemaining)
                                accumulatedTextLength += trimmedPageText.length
                                pageContents.add("【網頁內容: ${src.title} (${src.domain} / Tier ${src.tier})】\n$trimmedPageText")
                            }
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            Log.w(TAG, "WebPageFetcher error on ${src.url}: ${e.message}")
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    searchFailedNotice = searchRes.error ?: "未檢索到網路相關資料"
                }
            }

            // Build prompt for AI synthesis (Section 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 15)
            val promptBuilder = StringBuilder()
            if (gameTitle.isNotBlank()) promptBuilder.append("【主題作品】: $gameTitle ($platform)\n")
            if (!localDescription.isNullOrBlank()) {
                promptBuilder.append("【本機館藏說明 (CSV / 官方紀錄)】: $localDescription\n")
            }
            if (appContext != null) {
                if (!appContext.currentScreen.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    promptBuilder.append("【使用者目前情境】: ${appContext.currentScreen}")
                    if (!appContext.currentMuseumTab.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        promptBuilder.append(" (分頁: ${appContext.currentMuseumTab})")
                    }
                    if (!appContext.lastAction.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        promptBuilder.append("，最近操作: ${appContext.lastAction} (目標: ${appContext.lastActionTarget ?: "無"})")
                    }
                    promptBuilder.append("\n")
                }
            }
            promptBuilder.append("【使用者問題】: $userQuery\n\n")

            if (sources.isNotEmpty()) {
                promptBuilder.append("【即時 Web 檢索參考資料 (已按可信度分級排序)】:\n")
                sources.forEachIndexed { idx, src ->
                    promptBuilder.append("[${idx + 1}] ${src.title} (${src.domain} / 可信度分級 Tier ${src.tier})\nURL: ${src.url}\n摘要: ${src.snippet}\n\n")
                }
                if (pageContents.isNotEmpty()) {
                    promptBuilder.append("【高排名來源網頁內文】:\n")
                    pageContents.forEach { promptBuilder.append(it).append("\n\n") }
                }
                
                promptBuilder.append("""
                    【解答與引用原則】：
                    1. 請綜合以上 Web 搜尋資料進行分析歸納，整理成結構清晰、人類易讀的解答。
                    2. 多來源交叉比對：若不同來源的發售日、版本或資料存在衝突，請明確告知玩家（例如：「目前找到的資料有些許差異，較可靠的來源顯示……」）。
                    3. 可信度優先：優先採用 Tier 1 (官方網站/商店) 與 Tier 2 (維基/權威遊戲資料庫) 的資訊。
                    4. 嚴禁捏造任何網址！末尾必須根據實際檢索到的 sources 列出 3 至 5 個最重要的參考來源。格式如下：
                       🌐 參考資料
                       1. 標題
                          URL
                       2. 標題
                          URL
                """.trimIndent())
            } else {
                if (needSearch) {
                    if (searchMode.equals("SEARCH_OFF", ignoreCase = true)) {
                        promptBuilder.append("【系統提示】: 目前已關閉網路搜尋，請依現有 AI 知識解答，並於解答開頭親切說明「（目前已關閉網路搜尋，以下為 AI 現有知識回答）」。\n")
                    } else {
                        promptBuilder.append("【系統提示】: 網路搜尋暫時無法取得結果 ($searchFailedNotice)。請根據現有知識解答，並於解答開頭說明「⚠ 目前網路搜尋暫時無法連線，以下回答為根據 AI 現有知識產出。」\n")
                    }
                } else {
                    promptBuilder.append("【系統提示】: 本題不需發起網路搜尋。請根據 AI 館長專業知識與本機館藏說明解答。切勿附帶任何網路參考資料連結。\n")
                }
            }

            val request = AiRequest(
                prompt = promptBuilder.toString(),
                systemPrompt = "你是一位極其專業、客觀考據的電玩博覽館長與遊戲研究員。請以繁體中文客觀詳細解答。",
                temperature = 0.6f,
                maxTokens = com.example.agent.TokenBudgetManager.resolveOutputBudget("RESEARCH")
            )

            val targetProfiles = resolver.resolve(AiFeature.RESEARCH, profilesProvider())
            val exec = rotationManager.executeWithFailover(targetProfiles, request)

            var answerText = if (exec.success && exec.text.isNotBlank()) {
                exec.text.trim()
            } else {
                "⚠ 目前無法完成 Research 檢索 (${exec.toHumanReadableError()})"
            }

            // Post-process: ensure non-searched responses do not contain fake URLs
            if (sources.isEmpty()) {
                answerText = answerText.replace(Regex("🌐 參考資料[\\s\\S]*"), "").trim()
            }

            val result = ResearchResult(
                gameTitle = gameTitle,
                platform = platform,
                answerText = answerText,
                sources = sources,
                usedWebSearch = sources.isNotEmpty(),
                searchReason = decisionReason,
                providerUsed = exec.provider,
                modelUsed = exec.model
            )

            if (gameTitle.isNotBlank() && platform.isNotBlank()) {
                saveResearchToFile(platform, gameTitle, result)
            }

            result
        }

        overallResult ?: ResearchResult(
            gameTitle = gameTitle,
            platform = platform,
            answerText = "⚠ 考據研究請求逾時（超過 30 秒），已中止以保護系統資源。",
            sources = emptyList(),
            usedWebSearch = false,
            searchReason = "OVERALL_TIMEOUT"
        )
    }

    private fun saveResearchToFile(platform: String, gameTitle: String, result: ResearchResult) {
        try {
            val safePlatform = platform.trim().replace(Regex("[/\\\\:*?\"<>|]"), "_").ifBlank { "unknown_platform" }
            val safeGame = gameTitle.trim().replace(Regex("[/\\\\:*?\"<>|]"), "_").ifBlank { "unknown_game" }
            val dir = File(context.filesDir, "research/$safePlatform")
            if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs()

            val file = File(dir, "$safeGame.json")
            val obj = JSONObject().apply {
                put("gameTitle", result.gameTitle)
                put("platform", result.platform)
                put("answerText", result.answerText)
                put("usedWebSearch", result.usedWebSearch)
                put("searchReason", result.searchReason)
                put("providerUsed", result.providerUsed)
                put("modelUsed", result.modelUsed)
                put("timestampMs", result.timestampMs)

                val srcArr = JSONArray()
                result.sources.forEach { s ->
                    val sObj = JSONObject().apply {
                        put("title", s.title)
                        put("url", s.url)
                        put("snippet", s.snippet)
                        put("domain", s.domain)
                        put("tier", s.tier)
                        s.publishedAt?.let { put("publishedAt", it) }
                    }
                    srcArr.put(sObj)
                }
                put("sources", srcArr)
            }

            file.writeText(obj.toString(2), Charsets.UTF_8)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to save research citations JSON: ${e.message}")
        }
    }
}

package com.example.research

import com.example.agent.GameKnowledgeService
import com.example.database.GameEntity
import com.example.database.ResearchDao
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

data class ResearchTopic(
    val id: String,
    val title: String,
    val description: String,
    val promptTemplate: String
)

data class ResearchItem(
    val id: String = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val gameTitle: String,
    val platform: String,
    val topicTitle: String,
    val status: String = "PENDING", // PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED
    val progress: Float = 0f,
    val result: String? = null,
    val timestamp: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

class ResearchManager(
    private val knowledgeService: GameKnowledgeService,
    private val researchDao: ResearchDao,
    private val researchEngineProvider: (() -> ResearchEngine?)? = null,
    private val settingsRepositoryProvider: (() -> com.example.settings.SettingsRepository?)? = null,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO)
) {
    val defaultTopics = listOf(
        ResearchTopic(
            id = "historical_impact",
            title = "歷史地位與產業深遠影響",
            description = "深入研究該遊戲對電玩產業、後續系列作及遊戲類型發展的歷史地位。",
            promptTemplate = "分析該作品在當代電玩產業的地位、銷售與口碑影響，以及對後續同類作品的啟發。"
        ),
        ResearchTopic(
            id = "technical_breakthrough",
            title = "硬體極限與技術突破",
            description = "探討開發團隊如何突破當代卡帶與主機晶片限制，實現驚人的畫面或音效演算法。",
            promptTemplate = "詳細分析該遊戲在主機硬體限制下的程式架構、圖像渲染或音效合成技術突破。"
        ),
        ResearchTopic(
            id = "lore_and_secrets",
            title = "世界觀隱藏考據與未解之謎",
            description = "挖掘劇情中的隱藏線索、刪減內容 (Cut Content) 與彩蛋彩蛋歷史。",
            promptTemplate = "梳理遊戲設定集中的暗線、未解之謎、Beta 版本廢案與深層世界觀哲學。"
        )
    )

    private val _researchItems = MutableStateFlow<List<ResearchItem>>(emptyList())
    val researchItems: StateFlow<List<ResearchItem>> = _researchItems.asStateFlow()

    init {
        scope.launch {
            researchDao.getAllResearch().collect { entities ->
                _researchItems.value = entities.map { e ->
                    ResearchItem(
                        id = e.id,
                        gameTitle = e.gameTitle,
                        platform = e.platform,
                        topicTitle = e.topicTitle,
                        status = e.status,
                        progress = e.progress,
                        result = e.result,
                        timestamp = e.updatedAt
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun saveItem(item: ResearchItem, topicId: String) {
        val entity = com.example.database.ResearchEntity(
            id = item.id,
            gameTitle = item.gameTitle,
            platform = item.platform,
            topicId = topicId,
            topicTitle = item.topicTitle,
            status = item.status,
            progress = item.progress,
            result = item.result,
            error = if (item.status == "FAILED") item.result else null,
            updatedAt = item.timestamp
        )
        researchDao.upsertResearch(entity)
    }

    fun runResearch(game: GameEntity, topic: ResearchTopic) {
        val newItem = ResearchItem(
            gameTitle = game.title,
            platform = game.platform,
            topicTitle = topic.title,
            status = "RUNNING",
            progress = 0.2f
        )
        
        scope.launch {
            saveItem(newItem, topic.id)
            try {
                val engine = researchEngineProvider?.invoke()
                val repo = settingsRepositoryProvider?.invoke()

                val resultText = if (engine != null && repo != null) {
                    val res = engine.performResearch(
                        gameTitle = game.title,
                        platform = game.platform,
                        userQuery = "${topic.title}: ${topic.promptTemplate}",
                        searchMode = repo.getWebSearchMode(),
                        searchProvider = repo.getWebSearchProvider(),
                        searchApiKey = repo.getWebSearchApiKey(),
                        searchCustomEndpoint = repo.getWebSearchCustomEndpoint(),
                        localDescription = game.description
                    )
                    res.answerText
                } else {
                    knowledgeService.generateResearch(
                        gameTitle = game.title,
                        platform = game.platform,
                        topicName = topic.title,
                        topicPrompt = topic.promptTemplate
                    )
                }
                
                val isSuccess = !resultText.isNullOrBlank() && 
                        !resultText.startsWith("⚠") && 
                        !resultText.contains("無法完成") && 
                        !resultText.startsWith("研究執行失敗")

                val completedItem = newItem.copy(
                    status = if (isSuccess) "COMPLETED" else "FAILED",
                    progress = 1.0f,
                    result = resultText ?: "研究結果產出為空或無相關可靠資訊",
                    timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis()
                )
                saveItem(completedItem, topic.id)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                val failedItem = newItem.copy(
                    status = "FAILED", 
                    progress = 1.0f, 
                    result = "研究執行失敗: ${e.message}",
                    timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis()
                )
                saveItem(failedItem, topic.id)
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.research

import android.util.Log
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL
import java.net.URLEncoder

import java.io.OutputStreamWriter

data class ResearchSource(
    val title: String,
    val url: String,
    val snippet: String,
    val domain: String,
    val publishedAt: String? = null,
    val tier: Int = calculateTier(domain, url)
) {
    companion object {
        fun calculateTier(domain: String, url: String): Int {
            val d = domain.lowercase()
            val u = url.lowercase()

            // Tier 1: Official sites, GitHub official repos, store official pages
            if (u.contains("nintendo.com") || u.contains("playstation.com") || u.contains("xbox.com") ||
                u.contains("steampowered.com") || u.contains("steamcommunity.com") ||
                u.contains("sega.com") || u.contains("capcom.com") || u.contains("konami.com") ||
                u.contains("square-enix.com") || u.contains("bandainamco.com") ||
                d.endsWith(".gov") || d.endsWith(".edu") ||
                (d.contains("github.com") && !u.contains("/issues/"))
            ) {
                return 1
            }

            // Tier 2: Wikipedia, trusted game databases & major gaming media
            if (d.contains("wikipedia.org") || d.contains("wikidata.org") ||
                d.contains("mobygames.com") || d.contains("igdb.com") ||
                d.contains("gamefaqs") || d.contains("fandom.com") || d.contains("wikia.com") ||
                d.contains("ign.com") || d.contains("gamespot.com") || d.contains("eurogamer") ||
                d.contains("gamer.com.tw") || d.contains("4gamers.com.tw") || d.contains("famitsu.com") ||
                d.contains("polygon.com") || d.contains("kotaku.com") || d.contains("gematsu.com") ||
                d.contains("destructoid.com") || d.contains("archive.org")
            ) {
                return 2
            }

            // Tier 3: Forums, Reddit, community blogs
            if (d.contains("reddit.com") || d.contains("tieba.baidu.com") ||
                d.contains("forum") || d.contains("medium.com") || d.contains("wordpress.com") ||
                d.contains("blogspot.com") || d.contains("resetera.com")
            ) {
                return 3
            }

            // Tier 4: Unknown / general web
            return 4
        }
    }
}

data class SearchResult(
    val query: String,
    val sources: List<ResearchSource>,
    val provider: String,
    val error: String? = null
)

interface WebSearchService {
    suspend fun search(
        query: String,
        provider: String,
        apiKey: String? = null,
        customEndpoint: String? = null
    ): SearchResult
}

object DefaultWebSearchService : WebSearchService {
    private const val TAG = "WebSearchService"

    override suspend fun search(
        query: String,
        provider: String,
        apiKey: String?,
        customEndpoint: String?
    ): SearchResult = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (query.isBlank()) {
            return@withContext SearchResult(query, emptyList(), provider, "搜尋關鍵字為空白")
        }

        val provUpper = provider.uppercase()
        try {
            when (provUpper) {
                "BRAVE" -> searchBrave(query, apiKey.orEmpty())
                "BING" -> searchBing(query, apiKey.orEmpty())
                "GOOGLE_CUSTOM" -> searchGoogleCustom(query, apiKey.orEmpty(), customEndpoint)
                "CUSTOM" -> searchCustom(query, apiKey.orEmpty(), customEndpoint)
                "DUCKDUCKGO" -> searchDuckDuckGoHtml(query)
                else -> searchDuckDuckGoHtml(query)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Search error ($provUpper): ${e.message}", e)
            SearchResult(query, emptyList(), provUpper, e.message ?: "搜尋發送失敗")
        }
    }

    /**
     * DuckDuckGo HTML / Lite / API Fallback
     */
    private fun searchDuckDuckGoHtml(query: String): SearchResult {
        val encodedQuery = URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8")
        val sources = mutableListOf<ResearchSource>()

        try {
            val endpoint = "https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=$encodedQuery"
            val conn = URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            conn.requestMethod = "GET"
            conn.connectTimeout = 8000
            conn.readTimeout = 10000
            conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36")

            if (conn.responseCode in 200..299) {
                val html = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.inputStream, Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
                val regex = Regex("""<a class="result__url" href="([^"]+)".*?>(.*?)</a>.*?<a class="result__snippet".*?>(.*?)</a>""", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
                val matches = regex.findAll(html)

                for (m in matches) {
                    val rawUrl = m.groupValues[1].replace("&amp;", "&")
                    val titleClean = m.groupValues[2].replace(Regex("<[^>]*>"), "").trim()
                    val snippetClean = m.groupValues[3].replace(Regex("<[^>]*>"), "").trim()

                    val actualUrl = if (rawUrl.contains("uddg=")) {
                        try {
                            val target = rawUrl.substringAfter("uddg=").substringBefore("&")
                            java.net.URLDecoder.decode(target, "UTF-8")
                        } catch (_: Exception) { rawUrl }
                    } else rawUrl

                    val domain = try { URL(actualUrl).host.removePrefix("www.") } catch (_: Exception) { "web" }

                    if (actualUrl.startsWith("http") && titleClean.isNotBlank()) {
                        sources.add(ResearchSource(title = titleClean, url = actualUrl, snippet = snippetClean, domain = domain))
                    }
                    if (sources.size >= 6) break
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.w(TAG, "DDG HTML search exception: ${e.message}")
        }

        if (sources.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                val liteEndpoint = "https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/"
                val conn = URL(liteEndpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
                conn.requestMethod = "POST"
                conn.connectTimeout = 8000
                conn.readTimeout = 10000
                conn.doOutput = true
                conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)")
                conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")

                OutputStreamWriter(conn.outputStream, Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.write("q=$encodedQuery") }

                if (conn.responseCode in 200..299) {
                    val html = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.inputStream, Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
                    val regexLite = Regex("""<a class="result-link" href="([^"]+)">(.*?)</a>.*?<td class="result-snippet">(.*?)</td>""", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
                    val matchesLite = regexLite.findAll(html)

                    for (m in matchesLite) {
                        val rawUrl = m.groupValues[1].replace("&amp;", "&")
                        val titleClean = m.groupValues[2].replace(Regex("<[^>]*>"), "").trim()
                        val snippetClean = m.groupValues[3].replace(Regex("<[^>]*>"), "").trim()

                        val actualUrl = if (rawUrl.contains("uddg=")) {
                            try {
                                val target = rawUrl.substringAfter("uddg=").substringBefore("&")
                                java.net.URLDecoder.decode(target, "UTF-8")
                            } catch (_: Exception) { rawUrl }
                        } else rawUrl

                        val domain = try { URL(actualUrl).host.removePrefix("www.") } catch (_: Exception) { "web" }

                        if (actualUrl.startsWith("http") && titleClean.isNotBlank()) {
                            sources.add(ResearchSource(title = titleClean, url = actualUrl, snippet = snippetClean, domain = domain))
                        }
                        if (sources.size >= 6) break
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.w(TAG, "DDG Lite search exception: ${e.message}")
            }
        }

        val sortedSources = sources.sortedBy { it.tier }
        return SearchResult(query, sortedSources, "DUCKDUCKGO")
    }

    /**
     * Brave Web Search API: GET https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search?q={query}
     * Header: X-Subscription-Token: API_KEY
     */
    private fun searchBrave(query: String, apiKey: String): SearchResult {
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) throw IllegalArgumentException("Brave Search 需要 API Key")
        val encoded = URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8")
        val endpoint = "https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search?q=$encoded&count=5"
        val conn = URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        conn.requestMethod = "GET"
        conn.connectTimeout = 10000
        conn.readTimeout = 15000
        conn.setRequestProperty("X-Subscription-Token", apiKey)
        conn.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")

        val jsonStr = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.inputStream, Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
        val root = JSONObject(jsonStr)
        val webResults = root.optJSONObject("web")?.optJSONArray("results") ?: JSONArray()
        val sources = mutableListOf<ResearchSource>()

        for (i in 0 until webResults.length()) {
            val item = webResults.getJSONObject(i)
            val title = item.optString("title", "")
            val url = item.optString("url", "")
            val description = item.optString("description", "")
            val domain = try { URL(url).host.removePrefix("www.") } catch (_: Exception) { "brave" }

            if (url.isNotBlank() && title.isNotBlank()) {
                sources.add(ResearchSource(title, url, description, domain))
            }
        }
        return SearchResult(query, sources, "BRAVE")
    }

    /**
     * Bing Web Search API: GET https://api.bing.microsoft.com/v7.0/search?q={query}
     * Header: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key: API_KEY
     */
    private fun searchBing(query: String, apiKey: String): SearchResult {
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) throw IllegalArgumentException("Bing Search 需要 API Key")
        val encoded = URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8")
        val endpoint = "https://api.bing.microsoft.com/v7.0/search?q=$encoded&count=5"
        val conn = URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        conn.requestMethod = "GET"
        conn.connectTimeout = 10000
        conn.readTimeout = 15000
        conn.setRequestProperty("Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key", apiKey)

        val jsonStr = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.inputStream, Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
        val root = JSONObject(jsonStr)
        val webPages = root.optJSONObject("webPages")?.optJSONArray("value") ?: JSONArray()
        val sources = mutableListOf<ResearchSource>()

        for (i in 0 until webPages.length()) {
            val item = webPages.getJSONObject(i)
            val title = item.optString("name", "")
            val url = item.optString("url", "")
            val snippet = item.optString("snippet", "")
            val domain = try { URL(url).host.removePrefix("www.") } catch (_: Exception) { "bing" }

            if (url.isNotBlank()) {
                sources.add(ResearchSource(title, url, snippet, domain))
            }
        }
        return SearchResult(query, sources, "BING")
    }

    /**
     * Google Custom Search: GET https://www.googleapis.com/customsearch/v1?key={API_KEY}&cx={CX}&q={query}
     */
    private fun searchGoogleCustom(query: String, apiKey: String, cx: String?): SearchResult {
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) throw IllegalArgumentException("Google Custom Search 需要 API Key")
        val cleanCx = cx?.trim()?.ifBlank { null } ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Google Custom Search 需要提供 Engine ID (CX)")
        val encoded = URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8")
        val endpoint = "https://www.googleapis.com/customsearch/v1?key=$apiKey&cx=$cleanCx&q=$encoded"

        val conn = URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        conn.requestMethod = "GET"
        conn.connectTimeout = 10000
        conn.readTimeout = 15000

        val jsonStr = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.inputStream, Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
        val root = JSONObject(jsonStr)
        val items = root.optJSONArray("items") ?: JSONArray()
        val sources = mutableListOf<ResearchSource>()

        for (i in 0 until items.length()) {
            val item = items.getJSONObject(i)
            val title = item.optString("title", "")
            val url = item.optString("link", "")
            val snippet = item.optString("snippet", "")
            val domain = try { URL(url).host.removePrefix("www.") } catch (_: Exception) { "google" }

            if (url.isNotBlank()) {
                sources.add(ResearchSource(title, url, snippet, domain))
            }
        }
        return SearchResult(query, sources, "GOOGLE_CUSTOM")
    }

    private fun searchCustom(query: String, apiKey: String, endpoint: String?): SearchResult {
        val rootUrl = endpoint?.trim()?.ifBlank { null } ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Custom Search 需要 Endpoint URL")
        val encoded = URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8")
        val fullUrl = if (rootUrl.contains("{query}")) rootUrl.replace("{query}", encoded) else "$rootUrl?q=$encoded"

        val conn = URL(fullUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        conn.requestMethod = "GET"
        conn.connectTimeout = 10000
        conn.readTimeout = 15000
        if (apiKey.isNotBlank()) {
            conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
        }

        val jsonStr = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.inputStream, Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
        val sources = mutableListOf<ResearchSource>()

        try {
            val root = JSONObject(jsonStr)
            val results = root.optJSONArray("results") ?: root.optJSONArray("data") ?: JSONArray()
            for (i in 0 until results.length()) {
                val item = results.getJSONObject(i)
                val title = item.optString("title", "")
                val url = item.optString("url", item.optString("link", ""))
                val snippet = item.optString("snippet", item.optString("description", ""))
                val domain = try { URL(url).host.removePrefix("www.") } catch (_: Exception) { "custom" }

                if (url.isNotBlank()) {
                    sources.add(ResearchSource(title, url, snippet, domain))
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}

        return SearchResult(query, sources, "CUSTOM")
    }
}

object WebPageFetcher {
    suspend fun fetchMainText(urlStr: String): String = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val conn = URL(urlStr).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            conn.requestMethod = "GET"
            conn.connectTimeout = 8000
            conn.readTimeout = 10000
            conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36")

            val html = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.inputStream, Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
            val clean = html
                .replace(Regex("<script[\\s\\S]*?</script>", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), "")
                .replace(Regex("<style[\\s\\S]*?</style>", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), "")
                .replace(Regex("<[^>]*>"), " ")
                .replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
                .trim()
            clean.take(2000)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            ""
        }
    }
}

package com.example.scanner

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import androidx.documentfile.provider.DocumentFile
import com.example.database.GameEntity
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

object PlatformRegistry {
    // Mapping from lowercase keywords to canonical platform IDs
    val canonicalMap = mapOf(

    // Non-ROM companion/metadata/system file extensions that should NEVER be scanned as games
    val nonRomExtensions: Set<String> = setOf(
        "txt", "nfo", "log", "json", "xml", "ini", "db", "tmp", "cache", "dat",
        "doc", "docx", "pdf", "rtf", "url", "desktop", "html", "htm", "css", "js",
        "jpg", "jpeg", "webp", "gif", "bmp", "ico", "svg", "mp3", "flac", "ogg", "wav",
        "srm", "sav", "state", "cht", "chtz", "bps", "ips", "ups", "diff", "patch"
    )

    fun isRomExtensionAllowed(canonicalPlatform: String, ext: String): Boolean {
        val lowerExt = ext.lowercase().trim().removePrefix(".")
        if (lowerExt.isBlank()) return false
        val canonicalUpper = canonicalPlatform.uppercase()
        val allowed = platformExtensions[canonicalUpper] ?: platformExtensions[canonicalPlatform]
        if (allowed != null && allowed.contains(lowerExt)) {
            return true
        }
        if (nonRomExtensions.contains(lowerExt)) return false
        return allowed == null
    }

    fun normalizePlatform(folderOrPlatform: String): String {
        val clean = folderOrPlatform.trim().lowercase()
        // Exact match
        canonicalMap[clean]?.let { return it }

        // Fuzzy match: check if any key is contained as a distinct token
        val tokens = clean.split(Regex("[^a-z0-9]+"))
        for (token in tokens) {
            canonicalMap[token]?.let { return it }
        }

        // Substring check for composite names like "Nintendo - Game Boy Advance"
        for ((key, value) in canonicalMap) {
            if (clean.contains(key)) {
                return value
            }
        }
        return folderOrPlatform.trim()
    }

    fun getAllowedExtensions(platform: String): Set<String> {
        val canonical = normalizePlatform(platform)
        return platformExtensions[canonical.uppercase()] ?: platformExtensions[canonical] ?: setOf(
            "gba", "gbc", "gb", "nds", "3ds", "cia", "nes", "sfc", "smc", "n64", "z64",
            "nsp", "xci", "iso", "chd", "cso", "pbp", "rvz", "wbfs", "vpk", "md", "smd",
            "gen", "sms", "gg", "pce", "ws", "wsc", "a26", "zip", "7z", "cue", "bin", "rom"
        )
    }

    fun guessPlatformFromExtensionAndPath(ext: String, parentFolderNames: List<String>): String {
        val cleanExt = ext.lowercase().trim().removePrefix(".")

        // Early reject: Non-ROM companion / metadata / image / document extensions should NEVER be guessed as game platforms
        if (cleanExt.isBlank() || nonRomExtensions.contains(cleanExt)) {
            val isPico8Folder = parentFolderNames.any { 
                val norm = normalizePlatform(it)
                norm.equals("PICO8", ignoreCase = true)
            }
            if (cleanExt == "png" && isPico8Folder) {
                return "PICO8"
            }
            return "General"
        }

        // 1. Path hierarchy check FIRST: test folder names from immediate parent upwards
        for (folder in parentFolderNames.reversed()) {
            val trimmedFolder = folder.trim()
            val norm = normalizePlatform(trimmedFolder)
            val isKnown = canonicalMap.containsKey(trimmedFolder.lowercase()) ||
                          canonicalMap.values.any { it.equals(norm, ignoreCase = true) }
            if (isKnown) {
                if (isRomExtensionAllowed(norm, cleanExt)) {
                    return norm
                }
                // General container / multiplatform extensions inside a named platform folder
                if (cleanExt in setOf("zip", "7z", "bin", "iso", "cue", "chd", "img", "cso", "pbp", "m3u", "rom")) {
                    return norm
                }
                // Disallowed or non-matching extensions in this folder do NOT get matched to norm
            }
        }

        // 2. Unambiguous unique extension check (e.g. gba, nds, sfc, z64, nsp, xci, p8, vpk, etc.)
        extensionToPlatform[cleanExt]?.let { return it }

        // 3. Fallbacks by extension when no folder was matched
        return when (cleanExt) {
            "rvz", "gcm", "gcz" -> "GAMECUBE"
            "wbfs" -> "WII"
            "wux", "rpx", "wud" -> "WIIU"
            "cso" -> "PSP"
            "pbp" -> "PS1"
            "vpk" -> "PSVITA"
            "cdi" -> "CDI"
            "gdi" -> "DREAMCAST"
            "chd", "cue", "bin", "iso" -> "PS1"
            "zip", "7z" -> "ARCADE"
            else -> "General"
        }
    }
}

class RomScanner(private val context: Context) {

    /**
     * Discover platform subfolders within a ROM source root.
     */
    suspend fun discoverPlatforms(source: RomSource): List<String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val uri = Uri.parse(source.treeUri)
        val rootDoc = try {
            DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, uri)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        } ?: return@withContext emptyList()

        val platforms = mutableSetOf<String>()
        val children = rootDoc.listFiles()

        for (child in children) {
            val name = child.name ?: continue
            if (name.startsWith(".")) continue

            if (child.isDirectory) {
                platforms.add(PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(name))
            } else {
                // If files are directly in root, check their extensions
                val ext = name.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase()
                val isPico8Png = name.lowercase().endsWith(".p8.png") || (ext == "png" && rootDoc.name?.contains("pico", ignoreCase = true) == true)
                if (ext.isNotBlank() && (!PlatformRegistry.nonRomExtensions.contains(ext) || isPico8Png)) {
                    val effectiveExt = if (isPico8Png) "p8" else ext
                    val plat = PlatformRegistry.guessPlatformFromExtensionAndPath(effectiveExt, listOf(rootDoc.name.orEmpty()))
                    if (PlatformRegistry.isRomExtensionAllowed(plat, effectiveExt)) {
                        platforms.add(plat)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        platforms.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.sorted()
    }

    /**
     * Scan a ROM Source recursively (up to 4 levels deep), with intelligent platform deduction and duplicate track filtering.
     */
    suspend fun scanSource(
        source: RomSource,
        platformFilter: String? = null,
        onProgress: (current: Int, total: Int, item: String) -> Unit = { _, _, _ -> }
    ): List<GameEntity> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val uri = Uri.parse(source.treeUri)
        val rootDoc = try {
            DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, uri)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        } ?: return@withContext emptyList()

        val discoveredFiles = mutableListOf<ScannedFileItem>()
        val rootFolderName = rootDoc.name ?: "ROMs"

        // Recursively traverse directory tree up to 4 levels deep
        traverseDirectory(rootDoc, listOf(rootFolderName), 0, 4, discoveredFiles)

        val results = mutableListOf<GameEntity>()
        val total = discoveredFiles.size

        // Group files by parent directory to de-duplicate CUE/BIN pairs and CD audio tracks
        val seenSignatures = mutableSetOf<String>()

        for ((index, item) in discoveredFiles.withIndex()) {
            val file = item.docFile
            val filename = file.name ?: continue
            val ext = filename.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase()
            val isPico8Png = filename.lowercase().endsWith(".p8.png") || (ext == "png" && item.pathSegments.any { it.contains("pico", ignoreCase = true) })

            // Skip hidden files, companion files, non-ROM extensions (allowing PICO-8 cartridges)
            if (filename.startsWith(".") || (PlatformRegistry.nonRomExtensions.contains(ext) && !isPico8Png) || ext.isBlank()) {
                continue
            }

            // Skip CD audio tracks (e.g. "Game (Track 2).bin", "Game_track02.bin") if cue/chd exists
            if (isAudioTrack(filename)) {
                continue
            }

            // Deduce platform
            val guessedPlat = if (isPico8Png) "PICO8" else PlatformRegistry.guessPlatformFromExtensionAndPath(ext, item.pathSegments)
            val canonicalPlatform = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(guessedPlat)

            // Strict Platform-specific ROM extension whitelist verification
            if (!isPico8Png && !PlatformRegistry.isRomExtensionAllowed(canonicalPlatform, ext)) {
                continue
            }

            // If platform filter is active, filter accordingly
            if (platformFilter != null) {
                val matchesFilter = canonicalPlatform.equals(platformFilter, ignoreCase = true) ||
                        item.pathSegments.any { it.equals(platformFilter, ignoreCase = true) }
                if (!matchesFilter) continue
            }

            val originalTitle = filename.substringBeforeLast('.')
            val cleanTitle = cleanGameTitle(filename)
            val dedupeKey = "$canonicalPlatform::$originalTitle"

            if (seenSignatures.contains(dedupeKey)) {
                // If duplicate title in same platform (e.g. game.cue and game.bin), prefer .cue or .chd or .iso
                if (ext == "cue" || ext == "chd" || ext == "m3u" || ext == "rvz") {
                    results.removeAll { it.platform == canonicalPlatform && it.title.equals(originalTitle, ignoreCase = true) }
                } else {
                    continue
                }
            }
            seenSignatures.add(dedupeKey)

            onProgress(index + 1, total, originalTitle)

            results.add(
                GameEntity(
                    title = originalTitle,
                    platform = canonicalPlatform,
                    romPath = file.uri.toString(),
                    fileName = file.name,
                    filePath = file.uri.path,
                    aiDetectedTitle = cleanTitle,
                    sourceId = source.id
                )
            )
        }

        results
    }

    private fun traverseDirectory(
        directory: DocumentFile,
        currentPath: List<String>,
        currentDepth: Int,
        maxDepth: Int,
        outList: MutableList<ScannedFileItem>
    ) {
        if (currentDepth > maxDepth) return
        val children = try {
            directory.listFiles()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            emptyArray()
        }

        for (child in children) {
            val name = child.name ?: continue
            if (name.startsWith(".")) continue

            if (child.isDirectory) {
                traverseDirectory(child, currentPath + name, currentDepth + 1, maxDepth, outList)
            } else {
                outList.add(ScannedFileItem(child, currentPath))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun isAudioTrack(filename: String): Boolean {
        val lower = filename.lowercase()
        return lower.contains(Regex("""\(track\s*[2-9]\d*\)""")) ||
                lower.contains(Regex("""\[track\s*[2-9]\d*\]""")) ||
                lower.contains(Regex("""_track\s*[2-9]\d*""")) ||
                lower.contains(Regex("""\s+track\s+[2-9]\d*"""))
    }

    private fun cleanGameTitle(filename: String): String {
        val nameWithoutExt = filename.substringBeforeLast('.')
        // Remove standard release tags: (USA), [!], (v1.0), (Disc 1), (En,Ja), (Japan), (Beta), etc.
        val cleaned = nameWithoutExt
            .replace(Regex("\\(.*?\\)"), "")
            .replace(Regex("\\[.*?\\]"), "")
            .replace('_', ' ')
            .replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
            .trim()
        return if (cleaned.isNotBlank()) cleaned else nameWithoutExt
    }

    data class ScannedFileItem(
        val docFile: DocumentFile,
        val pathSegments: List<String>
    )
}

package com.example.scanner

import org.json.JSONObject
import java.util.UUID

data class RomSource(
    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val name: String,
    val treeUri: String,
    val enabled: Boolean = true
) {
    fun toJson(): JSONObject = JSONObject().apply {
        put("id", id)
        put("name", name)
        put("treeUri", treeUri)
        put("enabled", enabled)
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: JSONObject): RomSource = RomSource(
            id = json.optString("id", UUID.randomUUID().toString()),
            name = json.optString("name", "ROM Folder"),
            treeUri = json.optString("treeUri", ""),
            enabled = json.optBoolean("enabled", true)
        )
    }
}
