package com.example.scraper

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import androidx.documentfile.provider.DocumentFile
import com.example.p3.asset.AssetKind
import com.example.p3.asset.AssetMatcher
import com.example.p3.asset.GameNameNormalizer
import com.example.p3.asset.ImageProvider
import com.example.p3.asset.ImageProviderRegistry
import com.example.p3.asset.SteamGridDbProvider
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.OutputStream
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

/**
 * P3 image scraper. Scanner, local lookup and scrape use the same platform/game
 * naming contract. Existing files win; only requested/missing kinds are fetched.
 *
 * IMPORTANT: production callers should use [scrapeGame]. It resolves the same
 * assetRoot/platform/game directory shape used by RomScanner and returns local
 * content URIs. Remote provider URLs are never written into GameEntity.
 */
class ImageScraperService(private val context: Context, private val sgdbApiKey: String) {
    private val registry = ImageProviderRegistry(context)

    init {
        // Registry owns the default provider. Keeping registration here explicit
        // also leaves the door open for Settings/API profiles to add providers.
        if (registry.providers().none { it.id == "steamgriddb" }) registry.register(SteamGridDbProvider())
    }

    data class Selection(
        val platform: String,
        val assetKinds: Set<AssetKind> = AssetKind.values().toSet(),
        val missingOnly: Boolean = true
    )

    data class ItemResult(
        val gameTitle: String,
        val kind: AssetKind,
        val provider: String?,
        val success: Boolean,
        val localUri: String? = null,
        val error: String? = null
    )

    data class ScrapeReport(val results: List<ItemResult>) {
        val successCount get() = results.count { it.success }
        val failureCount get() = results.count { !it.success && it.error != "SKIPPED" }
        val skippedCount get() = results.count { it.error == "SKIPPED" }
    }

    /** Production entry point: resolve/create canonical platform/game asset directory. */
    suspend fun scrapeGame(
        gameTitle: String,
        platform: String,
        assetRootUri: Uri?,
        assetKinds: Set<AssetKind> = AssetKind.values().toSet(),
        missingOnly: Boolean = true
    ): ScrapeReport = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (assetRootUri != null) {
            val root = DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, assetRootUri)
            if (root != null) {
                val platformDir = findOrCreateDirectory(root, platform)
                if (platformDir != null) {
                    val gameDir = findOrCreateGameDirectory(platformDir, gameTitle)
                    if (gameDir != null) {
                        return@withContext scrapeIntoDirectory(gameTitle, platform, gameDir, Selection(platform, assetKinds, missingOnly))
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Fallback: scrape directly into app internal storage directory
        val canonicalPlat = com.example.scanner.PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform)
        val safeGameDirName = sanitizeFileName(gameTitle).ifBlank { "game_asset" }
        val targetInternalDir = java.io.File(context.filesDir, "assets/$canonicalPlat/$safeGameDirName").apply { mkdirs() }
        scrapeIntoInternalDirectory(gameTitle, platform, targetInternalDir, Selection(platform, assetKinds, missingOnly))
    }

    private suspend fun scrapeIntoInternalDirectory(
        gameTitle: String,
        platform: String,
        targetDir: java.io.File,
        selection: Selection
    ): ScrapeReport {
        val results = mutableListOf<ItemResult>()
        for (kind in selection.assetKinds) {
            val filename = fileNameFor(kind)
            val existingFile = java.io.File(targetDir, filename)
            if (selection.missingOnly && existingFile.exists() && existingFile.length() > 0) {
                results += ItemResult(gameTitle, kind, null, false, Uri.fromFile(existingFile).toString(), "SKIPPED")
                continue
            }

            var saved = false
            var providerUsed: String? = null
            var localUri: String? = null
            var lastError: String? = null

            for (provider in registry.ordered(platform)) {
                val urls = buildList {
                    for (variant in GameNameNormalizer.variants(gameTitle)) {
                        try {
                            provider.search(variant, platform, kind, sgdbApiKey)?.let { if (it.isNotBlank()) add(it) }
                        } catch (_: Exception) {}
                    }
                }.distinct()

                var providerSucceeded = false
                for (url in urls) {
                    val downloaded = downloadImageToInternalFile(url, targetDir, filename)
                    if (downloaded != null) {
                        providerSucceeded = true
                        providerUsed = provider.id
                        localUri = downloaded
                        saved = true
                        break
                    }
                }
                registry.record(provider.id, platform, providerSucceeded)
                if (saved) break
                lastError = if (urls.isEmpty()) "provider returned no result" else "download failed"
            }
            results += ItemResult(gameTitle, kind, providerUsed, saved, localUri, if (saved) null else lastError ?: "not found")
        }
        return ScrapeReport(results)
    }

    private fun downloadImageToInternalFile(url: String, targetDir: java.io.File, filename: String): String? {
        return try {
            val connection = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            connection.connectTimeout = 10000
            connection.readTimeout = 15000
            connection.useCaches = false
            connection.requestMethod = "GET"
            connection.instanceFollowRedirects = true
            if (connection.responseCode !in 200..299) return null
            val contentType = connection.contentType?.lowercase().orEmpty()
            if (contentType.isNotBlank() && !contentType.startsWith("image/")) return null

            val partFile = java.io.File(targetDir, ".${filename}.part")
            if (partFile.exists()) partFile.delete()

            connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                java.io.FileOutputStream(partFile).use { out ->
                    input.copyTo(out)
                }
            }

            val destFile = java.io.File(targetDir, filename)
            if (destFile.exists()) destFile.delete()
            val renamed = partFile.renameTo(destFile)
            if (renamed && destFile.exists()) {
                Uri.fromFile(destFile).toString()
            } else {
                null
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    /** Compatibility entry point for callers that already resolved a target directory. */
    suspend fun scrapeAssetsForGame(gameTitle: String, targetDirUri: Uri): Boolean {
        val report = scrapeAssetsForGame(gameTitle, targetDirUri, Selection(""))
        return report.successCount > 0
    }

    suspend fun scrapeAssetsForGame(
        gameTitle: String,
        targetDirUri: Uri,
        selection: Selection
    ): ScrapeReport = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val targetDir = DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, targetDirUri)
            ?: return@withContext ScrapeReport(emptyList())
        scrapeIntoDirectory(gameTitle, selection.platform, targetDir, selection)
    }

    fun providerStats(platform: String) = registry.providers().map { registry.stat(it.id, platform) }
    fun registerProvider(provider: ImageProvider) = registry.register(provider)
    fun registerJsonProvider(id: String, baseUrl: String, resultField: String = "url") =
        registry.register(com.example.p3.asset.GenericJsonImageProvider(id, baseUrl, resultField))

    private suspend fun scrapeIntoDirectory(
        gameTitle: String,
        platform: String,
        targetDir: DocumentFile,
        selection: Selection
    ): ScrapeReport {
        val results = mutableListOf<ItemResult>()
        for (kind in selection.assetKinds) {
            val existing = findExisting(targetDir, kind)
            if (selection.missingOnly && existing != null) {
                results += ItemResult(gameTitle, kind, null, false, existing.uri.toString(), "SKIPPED")
                continue
            }

            var saved = false
            var providerUsed: String? = null
            var localUri: String? = null
            var lastError: String? = null
            for (provider in registry.ordered(platform)) {
                // Try conservative title variants before declaring a provider a failure.
                // This preserves platform + title matching without falling back to fabricated
                // substring artwork.
                val urls = buildList {
                    for (variant in GameNameNormalizer.variants(gameTitle)) {
                        try {
                            provider.search(variant, platform, kind, sgdbApiKey)?.let { if (it.isNotBlank()) add(it) }
                        } catch (_: Exception) {
                            // One provider/query failure must not abort the remaining variants.
                        }
                    }
                }.distinct()
                var providerSucceeded = false
                for (url in urls) {
                    val downloaded = downloadImage(url, targetDir, fileNameFor(kind), refresh = !selection.missingOnly)
                    if (downloaded != null) {
                        providerSucceeded = true
                        providerUsed = provider.id
                        localUri = downloaded
                        saved = true
                        break
                    }
                }
                registry.record(provider.id, platform, providerSucceeded)
                if (saved) break
                lastError = if (urls.none()) "provider returned no result" else "download failed"
            }
            results += ItemResult(gameTitle, kind, providerUsed, saved, localUri, if (saved) null else lastError ?: "not found")
        }
        return ScrapeReport(results)
    }

    private fun findOrCreateDirectory(parent: DocumentFile, name: String): DocumentFile? {
        val wanted = name.trim().ifBlank { "RETRO" }
        return parent.listFiles().firstOrNull { it.isDirectory && it.name.equals(wanted, true) }
            ?: parent.createDirectory(wanted)
    }

    private fun sanitizeFileName(name: String): String {
        return name.trim().replace(Regex("[/\\\\:*?\"<>|]"), "_")
    }

    private fun findOrCreateGameDirectory(platformDir: DocumentFile, title: String): DocumentFile? {
        val variants = GameNameNormalizer.variants(title)
        val normalizedVariants = variants.map { GameNameNormalizer.normalize(it) }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.toSet()
        val existing = platformDir.listFiles().firstOrNull { dir ->
            if (!dir.isDirectory) return@firstOrNull false
            val name = dir.name.orEmpty()
            name.equals(title.trim(), ignoreCase = true) ||
                variants.any { it.equals(name, ignoreCase = true) } ||
                GameNameNormalizer.normalize(name) in normalizedVariants
        }
        val safeName = sanitizeFileName(title).ifBlank { "game_asset" }
        return existing ?: platformDir.createDirectory(safeName)
    }

    private fun findExisting(dir: DocumentFile, kind: AssetKind): DocumentFile? = dir.listFiles().firstOrNull { file ->
        file.isFile && file.name?.let { name -> com.example.p3.asset.AssetMatcher.isMatch(name, kind) } == true
    }

    private fun fileNameFor(kind: AssetKind): String = when (kind) {
        AssetKind.ICON -> "icon.png"
        AssetKind.TITLE -> "title.png"
        AssetKind.HERO -> "hero_1.png"
        AssetKind.SLIDE -> "slide_1.png"
        AssetKind.BOX_FRONT -> "boxfront.png"
    }

    /** Returns the local content URI on success, never the remote URL. */
    private fun downloadImage(url: String, targetDir: DocumentFile, filename: String, refresh: Boolean): String? {
        return try {
            val connection = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            connection.connectTimeout = 10000
            connection.readTimeout = 15000
            connection.useCaches = false
            connection.requestMethod = "GET"
            connection.instanceFollowRedirects = true
            if (connection.responseCode !in 200..299) return null
            val contentType = connection.contentType?.lowercase().orEmpty()
            if (contentType.isNotBlank() && !contentType.startsWith("image/")) return null

            val existing = targetDir.findFile(filename)
            if (!refresh && existing != null) return existing.uri.toString()
            val tempName = ".${filename}.part"
            targetDir.findFile(tempName)?.delete()
            val temp = targetDir.createFile("application/octet-stream", tempName) ?: return null
            try {
                val outputStream: OutputStream = context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(temp.uri) ?: return null
                val inputStream: InputStream = connection.inputStream
                inputStream.use { input -> outputStream.use { out -> input.copyTo(out) } }

                // SAF has no portable atomic rename. First complete the temporary download;
                // only after it succeeds do we replace the requested kind's old files.
                if (refresh) {
                    targetDir.listFiles()
                        .filter { it.isFile && AssetMatcher.isMatch(it.name ?: "", assetKindFromFilename(filename)) }
                        .forEach { runCatching { it.delete() } }
                }
                val destination = targetDir.findFile(filename) ?: targetDir.createFile(contentType.ifBlank { "image/png" }, filename) ?: return null
                context.contentResolver.openInputStream(temp.uri)?.use { input ->
                    context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(destination.uri, "wt")?.use { out -> input.copyTo(out) }
                        ?: return null
                } ?: return null
                destination.uri.toString()
            } finally {
                runCatching { temp.delete() }
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) { null }
    }

    private fun assetKindFromFilename(filename: String): AssetKind = when {
        filename.startsWith("icon") -> AssetKind.ICON
        filename.startsWith("title") -> AssetKind.TITLE
        filename.startsWith("hero") -> AssetKind.HERO
        filename.startsWith("slide") -> AssetKind.SLIDE
        else -> AssetKind.BOX_FRONT
    }
}

package com.example.settings

class SettingsRepository(context: Context) {
    private val prefs: SharedPreferences = context.getSharedPreferences("sylphora_settings_v1", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    // --- ROM Sources ---
    fun getRomSources(): List<RomSource> {
        val jsonStr = prefs.getString("rom_sources", null) ?: return emptyList()
        return try {
            val array = JSONArray(jsonStr)
            val list = mutableListOf<RomSource>()
            for (i in 0 until array.length()) {
                list.add(RomSource.fromJson(array.getJSONObject(i)))
            }
            list
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    fun saveRomSources(sources: List<RomSource>) {
        val array = JSONArray()
        sources.forEach { array.put(it.toJson()) }
        prefs.edit().putString("rom_sources", array.toString()).apply()
    }

    fun addRomSource(source: RomSource) {
        val current = getRomSources().toMutableList()
        current.removeAll { it.id == source.id || it.treeUri == source.treeUri }
        current.add(source)
        saveRomSources(current)
    }

    fun removeRomSource(sourceId: String) {
        val current = getRomSources().filterNot { it.id == sourceId }
        saveRomSources(current)
    }

    fun toggleRomSource(sourceId: String, enabled: Boolean) {
        val current = getRomSources().map {
            if (it.id == sourceId) it.copy(enabled = enabled) else it
        }
        saveRomSources(current)
    }

    // --- API Profiles ---
    fun getApiProfiles(): List<ApiProfile> {
        val jsonStr = prefs.getString("api_profiles", null)
        if (jsonStr == null) {
            return listOf(
                ApiProfile(id = "default_gemini", displayName = "Gemini (預設)", provider = "GEMINI", model = "")
            )
        }
        return try {
            val array = JSONArray(jsonStr)
            val list = mutableListOf<ApiProfile>()
            for (i in 0 until array.length()) {
                val obj = array.getJSONObject(i)
                val keyList = mutableListOf<ApiKeyEntry>()
                val keysArr = obj.optJSONArray("apiKeys")
                if (keysArr != null) {
                    for (k in 0 until keysArr.length()) {
                        val kObj = keysArr.getJSONObject(k)
                        val rawKey = kObj.optString("key", "")
                        keyList.add(
                            ApiKeyEntry(
                                id = kObj.optString("id", java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString()),
                                key = com.example.api.SecureKeyStoreHelper.decrypt(rawKey),
                                name = kObj.optString("name", "Key #${k + 1}"),
                                enabled = kObj.optBoolean("enabled", true),
                                priority = kObj.optInt("priority", 1)
                            )
                        )
                    }
                }
                val rawSingleKey = if (obj.has("apiKey") && !obj.isNull("apiKey")) obj.getString("apiKey") else null
                list.add(
                    ApiProfile(
                        id = obj.optString("id", java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString()),
                        provider = obj.optString("provider", "GEMINI"),
                        displayName = obj.optString("displayName", "AI Profile"),
                        model = obj.optString("model", ""),
                        baseUrl = if (obj.has("baseUrl") && !obj.isNull("baseUrl")) obj.getString("baseUrl") else null,
                        apiKey = rawSingleKey?.let { com.example.api.SecureKeyStoreHelper.decrypt(it) },
                        apiKeys = keyList,
                        accountId = if (obj.has("accountId") && !obj.isNull("accountId")) obj.getString("accountId") else null,
                        systemPrompt = if (obj.has("systemPrompt") && !obj.isNull("systemPrompt")) obj.getString("systemPrompt") else null,
                        enabled = obj.optBoolean("enabled", true),
                        priority = obj.optInt("priority", 1)
                    )
                )
            }
            if (list.isEmpty()) {
                listOf(ApiProfile(id = "default_gemini", displayName = "Gemini (預設)", provider = "GEMINI", model = ""))
            } else list
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            listOf(ApiProfile(id = "default_gemini", displayName = "Gemini (預設)", provider = "GEMINI", model = ""))
        }
    }

    fun saveApiProfiles(profiles: List<ApiProfile>) {
        val array = JSONArray()
        profiles.forEach { p ->
            val obj = JSONObject().apply {
                put("id", p.id)
                put("provider", p.provider)
                put("displayName", p.displayName)
                put("model", p.model)
                put("enabled", p.enabled)
                put("priority", p.priority)
                p.baseUrl?.let { put("baseUrl", it) }
                p.apiKey?.let { put("apiKey", com.example.api.SecureKeyStoreHelper.encrypt(it)) }
                p.accountId?.let { put("accountId", it) }
                p.systemPrompt?.let { put("systemPrompt", it) }

                if (p.apiKeys.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val kArr = JSONArray()
                    p.apiKeys.forEach { k ->
                        val kObj = JSONObject().apply {
                            put("id", k.id)
                            put("key", com.example.api.SecureKeyStoreHelper.encrypt(k.key))
                            put("name", k.name)
                            put("enabled", k.enabled)
                            put("priority", k.priority)
                        }
                        kArr.put(kObj)
                    }
                    put("apiKeys", kArr)
                }
            }
            array.put(obj)
        }
        prefs.edit().putString("api_profiles", array.toString()).apply()
    }

package com.example.ui.screens

import android.widget.Toast

import com.example.AppInfo

import com.example.ui.theme.LocalPegasusTheme
import com.google.accompanist.drawablepainter.rememberDrawablePainter
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collectLatest

@Composable
fun AppsScreen(
    apps: List<AppInfo>,
    onLaunchApp: (String) -> Unit,
    viewModel: GameViewModel? = null,
    fontScale: Float = 1f
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var selectedTab by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var searchQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var debouncedQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        snapshotFlow { searchQuery }
            .collectLatest { q ->
                delay(250)
                debouncedQuery = q
            }
    }
    val tabs = listOf("全部應用", "模擬器", "遊戲與工具")

    val allGames by viewModel?.allGames?.collectAsState() ?: remember { mutableStateOf(emptyList()) }
    val addedPackages = remember(allGames) {
        allGames.mapNotNull {
            if (it.romPath.startsWith("app://")) it.romPath.removePrefix("app://") else null
        }.toSet()
    }

    val filteredApps = remember(apps, selectedTab, debouncedQuery) {
        apps.filter { app ->
            val matchesTab = when (selectedTab) {
                1 -> app.isEmulator
                2 -> !app.isEmulator
                else -> true
            }
            val matchesSearch = debouncedQuery.isBlank() || 
                app.name.contains(debouncedQuery, ignoreCase = true) || 
                app.packageName.contains(debouncedQuery, ignoreCase = true)
            matchesTab && matchesSearch
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(selectedTab) {
        viewModel?.updateCuratorNavigation("APPS", tabs.getOrNull(selectedTab))
    }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
    ) {
        // Top Search & Filter Bar
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(vertical = 8.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            // Tabs
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .height(42.dp)
                    .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f), RoundedCornerShape(21.dp))
                    .border(1.dp, theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f), RoundedCornerShape(21.dp))
                    .padding(4.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                tabs.forEachIndexed { index, title ->
                    val isSelected = index == selectedTab
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(17.dp))
                            .background(if (isSelected) theme.accent else Color.Transparent)
                            .clickable {
                                SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                selectedTab = index
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 18.dp),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = title,
                            color = if (isSelected) theme.background else theme.textSecondary,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            fontSize = 13.sp * fontScale
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            // Search Bar
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = searchQuery,
                onValueChange = { searchQuery = it },
                placeholder = { Text("搜尋應用程式...", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp * fontScale) },
                leadingIcon = { Icon(Icons.Filled.Search, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent) },
                singleLine = true,
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
                colors = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
                    focusedBorderColor = theme.accent,
                    unfocusedBorderColor = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f),
                    focusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                    unfocusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                    focusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
                    unfocusedTextColor = theme.textMain
                ),
                modifier = Modifier
                    .width(260.dp)
                    .height(46.dp)
            )
        }

        // Apps Grid
        if (filteredApps.isEmpty()) {
            Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Text("找不到符合條件的應用程式", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 14.sp * fontScale)
            }
        } else {
            LazyVerticalGrid(
                columns = GridCells.Fixed(3),
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .weight(1f),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = 8.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
            ) {
                items(filteredApps, key = { it.packageName }) { appInfo ->
                    val isAlreadyAdded = addedPackages.contains(appInfo.packageName)
                    AppGridCard(
                        appInfo = appInfo,
                        isAdded = isAlreadyAdded,
                        onClick = {
                            SoundManager.playLaunchSound(context)
                            onLaunchApp(appInfo.packageName)
                        },
                            onAddToLibrary = {
                                if (viewModel != null && !isAlreadyAdded) {
                                    viewModel.addAndroidAppAsGame(appInfo)
                                    SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                    Toast.makeText(context, "已將《${appInfo.name}》加入遊戲庫！", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                }
                            },
                            fontScale = fontScale
                        )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun AppGridCard(
    appInfo: AppInfo,
    isAdded: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    onAddToLibrary: () -> Unit,
    fontScale: Float = 1f
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(84.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
            .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(12.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        Image(
            painter = rememberDrawablePainter(drawable = appInfo.icon),
            contentDescription = appInfo.name,
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(56.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
        )
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = appInfo.name,
                    color = theme.textMain,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 15.sp * fontScale,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false)
                )
                if (appInfo.isEmulator) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                            .background(theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.2f))
                            .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text("模擬器", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 9.sp * fontScale, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }
            }
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(3.dp))
            Text(
                text = appInfo.packageName,
                color = theme.textSecondary,
                fontSize = 11.sp * fontScale,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
            )
        }

        // Add to launcher button
        SylphoraIconButton(
            onClick = onAddToLibrary,
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(36.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(if (isAdded) theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.2f) else theme.surface)
        ) {
            Icon(
                imageVector = if (isAdded) Icons.Filled.Check else Icons.Filled.Add,
                contentDescription = if (isAdded) "已在遊戲庫" else "加入遊戲庫",
                tint = if (isAdded) theme.accent else theme.textSecondary,
                modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun CuratorScreen(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
    var activeSubTab by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    val tabs = listOf("遊戲顧問", "隨機推薦", "情境推薦", "收藏庫統計")

    LaunchedEffect(activeSubTab) {
        viewModel.updateCuratorNavigation("CURATOR", tabs.getOrNull(activeSubTab))
    }

    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        ThemeCuratorHeader(
            theme = theme,
            themeIndex = viewModel.currentThemeFamilyIndex.collectAsState().value
        )

        // Sub Navigation Capsules
        LazyRow(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 24.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
        ) {
            items(tabs.size, key = { "tab_${it}_${tabs[it]}" }) { index ->
                val isSelected = index == activeSubTab
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                        .background(if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                        .border(1.dp, if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f), RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                        .clickable { activeSubTab = index }
                        .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = tabs[index],
                        color = if (isSelected) theme.background else theme.textMain,
                        fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium,
                        fontSize = 14.sp
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Active View
        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f)) {
            when (activeSubTab) {
                0 -> CuratorChatView(viewModel = viewModel)
                1 -> FateDrawView(viewModel = viewModel)
                2 -> MoodRecommendationView(viewModel = viewModel)
                3 -> ArchaeologyHealthView(viewModel = viewModel)
            }
        }
    }
}


enum class CuratorState {
    IDLE,
    THINKING,
    SPEAKING,
    ERROR
}

@Composable
fun SilphyetteAvatar(
    state: CuratorState,
    theme: com.example.ui.theme.PegasusTheme,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    isWhiteHair: Boolean = true
) {
    val infiniteTransition = androidx.compose.animation.core.rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "silphyette")
    val breathScale by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 1f,
        targetValue = 1.04f,
        animationSpec = androidx.compose.animation.core.infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = androidx.compose.animation.core.tween(1200, easing = androidx.compose.animation.core.FastOutLinearInEasing),
            repeatMode = androidx.compose.animation.core.RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "silphyette_breath"
    )
    val blink by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 1f,
        targetValue = 0f,
        animationSpec = androidx.compose.animation.core.infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = androidx.compose.animation.core.keyframes {
                durationMillis = 2500
                1f at 0
                1f at 2250
                0f at 2350
                1f at 2450
            }
        ),
        label = "silphyette_blink"
    )
    val mouthOpen by androidx.compose.animation.core.animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (state == CuratorState.SPEAKING) 1f else 0f,
        animationSpec = androidx.compose.animation.core.tween(200, easing = androidx.compose.animation.core.FastOutLinearInEasing),
        label = "silphyette_mouth"
    )
    val thinkingLook by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = -1f,
        targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = androidx.compose.animation.core.infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = androidx.compose.animation.core.tween(800, easing = androidx.compose.animation.core.FastOutLinearInEasing),
            repeatMode = androidx.compose.animation.core.RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "silphyette_thinking_look"
    )

    Canvas(modifier = modifier.size(80.dp).scale(breathScale)) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val cx = w / 2f
        val cy = h / 2f
        val face = w * 0.55f
        val hair = if (isWhiteHair) Color(0xFFF0F4F8) else Color(0xFF8BA88A)
        val eye = Color(0xFFE63E2E)
        drawCircle(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.35f), radius = w / 2f)
        drawCircle(
            color = when (state) {
                CuratorState.THINKING -> theme.tertiary
                CuratorState.ERROR -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
                else -> theme.accent
            },
            radius = w / 2f - 1.dp.toPx(),
            style = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke(width = 2.dp.toPx())
        )
        drawRoundRect(
            color = Color(0xFFFFE0BD),
            topLeft = Offset(cx - face / 2f, cy - face / 2f * 0.9f),
            size = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(face, face * 0.85f),
            cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(face * 0.3f)
        )
        val ear = face * 0.2f
        drawRoundRect(Color(0xFFFFDAB9), Offset(cx - face * 0.6f, cy - face * 0.2f), androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(ear, ear * 1.8f), androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(ear * 0.5f))
        drawRoundRect(Color(0xFFFFDAB9), Offset(cx + face * 0.4f, cy - face * 0.2f), androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(ear, ear * 1.8f), androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(ear * 0.5f))
        val hairPath = Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx - face * 0.6f, cy - face * 0.3f)
            cubicTo(cx - face * 0.4f, cy - face * 0.9f, cx + face * 0.4f, cy - face * 0.9f, cx + face * 0.6f, cy - face * 0.3f)
            lineTo(cx + face * 0.5f, cy - face * 0.05f)
            lineTo(cx - face * 0.5f, cy - face * 0.05f)
            close()
        }
        drawPath(hairPath, hair)
        drawLine(hair, Offset(cx, cy - face * 0.45f), Offset(cx + face * 0.15f, cy - face * 0.7f), strokeWidth = 4f)
        val eyeY = cy - face * 0.05f + if (state == CuratorState.THINKING) thinkingLook * face * 0.04f else 0f
        val spacing = face * 0.25f
        val eyeSize = face * 0.12f
        if (blink > 0.5f) {
            listOf(-spacing, spacing).forEach { dx ->
                drawCircle(Color.White, eyeSize, Offset(cx + dx, eyeY))
                drawCircle(eye, eyeSize * 0.5f, Offset(cx + dx, eyeY))
                drawCircle(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.7f), eyeSize * 0.15f, Offset(cx + dx - eyeSize * 0.2f, eyeY - eyeSize * 0.2f))
            }
        } else {
            listOf(-spacing, spacing).forEach { dx -> drawLine(eye, Offset(cx + dx - eyeSize, eyeY), Offset(cx + dx + eyeSize, eyeY), strokeWidth = 2.5f) }
        }
        val mouthY = cy + face * 0.2f
        val mouthWidth = face * 0.2f
        if (mouthOpen > 0.1f) {
            drawOval(Color(0xFFD4735E), Offset(cx - mouthWidth / 2f, mouthY - mouthWidth * 0.3f * mouthOpen), androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(mouthWidth, mouthWidth * 0.6f * mouthOpen))
        } else {
            drawArc(Color(0xFFD4735E), 180f, 180f, false, Offset(cx - mouthWidth / 2f, mouthY - mouthWidth * 0.1f), androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(mouthWidth, mouthWidth * 0.3f), style = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke(width = 2f))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun CuratorChatView(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val fontScale by viewModel.fontSize.collectAsState()
    val chatMessages by viewModel.chatMessages.collectAsState()
    val isAgentTyping by viewModel.isAgentTyping.collectAsState()
    var curatorState by remember { mutableStateOf(CuratorState.IDLE) }
    var inputMessage by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val listState = rememberLazyListState()
    val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val imeBottom = with(density) { WindowInsets.ime.getBottom(this).toDp() }
    val isImeVisible = WindowInsets.ime.isImeVisible

    LaunchedEffect(chatMessages.size, isAgentTyping) {
        curatorState = if (isAgentTyping) CuratorState.THINKING else if (chatMessages.lastOrNull()?.sender == "curator") CuratorState.SPEAKING else CuratorState.IDLE
        if (!isAgentTyping && chatMessages.lastOrNull()?.sender == "curator") {
            delay(600)
            curatorState = CuratorState.IDLE
        }
        if (chatMessages.isNotEmpty()) {
            listState.animateScrollToItem(chatMessages.lastIndex)
        }
    }

    val lastCuratorMessage = chatMessages.lastOrNull { it.sender == "curator" }?.content ?: ""
    val isAskingToFill = lastCuratorMessage.contains("需要我為您考據") || lastCuratorMessage.contains("需要我為您補充")
    
    val quickPrompts = if (isAskingToFill) {
        listOf("✅ 開始考據", "❌ 先不要")
    } else {
        listOf(
            "📊 分析我目前的遊戲庫健康度",
            "☕ 推薦一款 20 分鐘能通關/暢玩的遊戲",
            "🎮 今晚適合玩什麼？幫我挑一款經典！",
            "🔍 幫我列出缺少簡介的遊戲清單"
        )
    }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(horizontal = 24.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
            .padding(bottom = if (isImeVisible) imeBottom else 0.dp)
    ) {
        // Chat History
        LazyColumn(
            state = listState,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 12.dp)
        ) {
            items(chatMessages, key = { "${it.sender}_${it.timestamp}_${it.content.hashCode()}" }) { msg ->
                val isUser = msg.sender == "user"
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = if (isUser) Arrangement.End else Arrangement.Start
                ) {
                    if (!isUser) {
                        val avatarSize = if (LocalConfiguration.current.screenWidthDp > 600) 100.dp else 80.dp
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier.size(avatarSize),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            SilphyetteAvatar(
                                state = curatorState,
                                theme = theme,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(80.dp).then(
                                    if (LocalConfiguration.current.screenWidthDp > 600) Modifier.size(100.dp) else Modifier
                                )
                            )
                        }
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    }

                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .widthIn(max = 720.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                            .background(if (isUser) theme.accent else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.7f))
                            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                            .padding(18.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = msg.content,
                            color = if (isUser) theme.background else theme.textMain,
                            fontSize = 16.sp * fontScale.scale,
                            lineHeight = 24.sp * fontScale.scale
                        )
                    }

                    if (isUser) {
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(10.dp))
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(36.dp)
                                .clip(CircleShape)
                                .background(theme.surface),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.Person, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.textMain, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (isAgentTyping) {
                item {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        CircularProgressIndicator(color = theme.accent, modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp))
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(10.dp))
                        Text("正在思考...", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp * fontScale.scale)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Quick Suggestion Chips
        LazyRow(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 8.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
        ) {
            items(quickPrompts, key = { it }) { prompt ->
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
                        .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                        .clickable {
                            viewModel.sendCuratorChat(prompt)
                            coroutineScope.launch {
                                listState.animateScrollToItem(chatMessages.size)
                            }
                        }
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(prompt, color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }
        }

        // Input Box
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(bottom = 8.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
        ) {
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = inputMessage,
                onValueChange = { inputMessage = it },
                placeholder = { Text("搜尋或詢問任何遊戲相關內容...", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 14.sp * fontScale.scale) },
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp),
                colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
                    focusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
                    unfocusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
                    focusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                    unfocusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                    focusedIndicatorColor = theme.accent,
                    unfocusedIndicatorColor = Color.Transparent
                ),
                singleLine = true
            )

            SylphoraIconButton(
                onClick = {
                    if (inputMessage.isNotBlank()) {
                        val txt = inputMessage
                        inputMessage = ""
                        viewModel.sendCuratorChat(txt)
                        coroutineScope.launch {
                            listState.animateScrollToItem(chatMessages.size)
                        }
                    }
                },
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(48.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(theme.accent)
            ) {
                Icon(Icons.Filled.Send, contentDescription = "發送", tint = theme.background)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun FateDrawView(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val fateGame by viewModel.fateGame.collectAsState()

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Column(
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
            modifier = Modifier
                .widthIn(max = 500.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(28.dp))
                .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(theme.surface, theme.background)))
                .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(28.dp))
                .padding(32.dp)
        ) {
            Text("隨機推薦 · 今晚玩什麼", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
            Text("隨機為你挑選今晚推薦遊玩的經典作品", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

            val currentFate = fateGame
            if (currentFate != null) {
                val game = currentFate
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                        .background(theme.cardStart)
                        .padding(20.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                        Text("🎮", fontSize = 48.sp)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
                        Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 22.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                .background(theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.2f))
                                .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(game.platform, color = theme.accent, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        }
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = game.description ?: "經典之選，立刻開啟你的冒險！",
                            color = theme.textSecondary,
                            fontSize = 13.sp,
                            maxLines = 3
                        )
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
                        SylphoraButton(
                            onClick = { viewModel.recordGameLaunch(game, context) },
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                            shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.PlayArrow, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.background)
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                            Text("立刻啟動遊戲", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(180.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text("點擊下方按鈕開始抽取推薦遊戲", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 15.sp)
                }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

            SylphoraButton(
                onClick = { viewModel.drawFate() },
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(50.dp),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(25.dp)
            ) {
                Icon(Icons.Filled.Shuffle, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.background)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                Text(if (fateGame == null) "隨機推薦一款遊戲" else "再抽一次", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun MoodRecommendationView(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var selectedMood by remember { mutableStateOf("relax") }
    val moods = listOf(
        "relax" to "☕ 輕鬆休閒",
        "action" to "🔥 熱血動作",
        "story" to "📖 深度劇情",
        "arcade" to "🕹️ 經典街機"
    )

    val recommendedGames = remember(selectedMood, viewModel.allGames.collectAsState().value) {
        viewModel.recommendByMood(selectedMood)
    }

    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp)) {
        Text("依心情與情境推薦", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            moods.forEach { (key, label) ->
                val isSelected = key == selectedMood
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                        .background(if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.surface)
                        .clickable { selectedMood = key }
                        .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = label,
                        color = if (isSelected) theme.background else theme.textMain,
                        fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                        fontSize = 14.sp
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(20.dp))

        LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            items(recommendedGames, key = { "${it.id}_${it.romPath}" }) { game ->
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                        .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                        .padding(16.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("🎮", fontSize = 28.sp)
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                        Text("平台: ${game.platform}", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = { viewModel.recordGameLaunch(game, context) },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text("玩這款", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    .padding(24.dp)
            ) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .size(90.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.2f))
                            .border(3.dp, theme.accent, CircleShape),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text("${health.score.toInt()}%", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(24.dp))
                    Column {
                        Text("遊戲庫健康度指數", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                        Text("總計收錄 ${health.totalGames} 款遊戲，缺少簡介: ${health.missingDesc} 款", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        item {
            Text("📊 各平台遊戲庫存分佈", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                health.platformCounts.forEach { (platform, count) ->
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                            .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                    ) {
                        Text(platform, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                        Text("$count 款", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ui.screens
