@Composable
fun GameDnaLineageView(
    viewModel: GameViewModel,
    onLaunchGame: (GameEntity) -> Unit
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val allGames by viewModel.allGames.collectAsState()
    var selectedGameIndex by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val activeGame = allGames.getOrNull(selectedGameIndex)

    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Card(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.7f)),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Text("🧬 遊戲 DNA 與演化譜系分析", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                    Text("選取遊戲以解構其玩法基因、時代脈絡、同世代關聯作品與啟發關係。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)

                    if (allGames.isNotEmpty()) {
                        Text("選擇遊戲：", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                            itemsIndexed(allGames, key = { _, g -> "${g.id}_${g.romPath}" }) { idx, g ->
                                val isSel = idx == selectedGameIndex
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                        .background(if (isSel) theme.accent else theme.surface)
                                        .clickable { selectedGameIndex = idx }
                                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = g.title,
                                        color = if (isSel) theme.background else theme.textMain,
                                        fontWeight = if (isSel) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                                        maxLines = 1
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (activeGame != null) {
            item {
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f)),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
                ) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Column {
                                Text(activeGame.title, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                                Text("平台：${activeGame.platform} · 發行：${activeGame.publisher?.ifBlank { "未知" } ?: "未知"}", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                            }
                            SylphoraButton(
                                onClick = { onLaunchGame(activeGame) },
                                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                                modifier = Modifier.height(36.dp)
                            ) {
                                Icon(Icons.Filled.PlayArrow, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp), tint = theme.background)
                                Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                Text("啟動遊戲", color = theme.background, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                            }
                        }

                        HorizontalDivider(color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))

                        Text("🧩 遊戲基因特徵標籤", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 13.sp)
                        val tags = listOf(
                            "🕹️ 平台：${activeGame.platform}",
                            "🎨 像素美學",
                            "🎯 街機靈魂",
                            "⚡ 高節奏操作",
                            "🏆 經典里程碑"
                        )
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                            tags.forEach { tag ->
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                        .background(theme.surface)
                                        .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                        .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                                ) {
                                    Text(tag, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 11.sp)
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                        Text("📜 歷史譜系與遊戲背景", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 13.sp)
                        Text(
                            text = if (!activeGame.description.isNullOrBlank()) activeGame.description else "此遊戲尚無歷史描述，可在研究中心觸發考據進行自動補充。",
                            color = theme.textSecondary,
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            lineHeight = 18.sp
                        )

                        // Similar lineage games in library
                        val samePlatformGames = allGames.filter { it.platform == activeGame.platform && it.id != activeGame.id }.take(5)
                        if (samePlatformGames.isNotEmpty()) {
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                            Text("🔗 同平台譜系關聯作品", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 13.sp)
                            LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                                items(samePlatformGames, key = { it.id }) { simGame ->
                                    Box(
                                        modifier = Modifier
                                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                            .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f))
                                            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                            .clickable {
                                                val targetIdx = allGames.indexOfFirst { it.id == simGame.id }
                                                if (targetIdx >= 0) selectedGameIndex = targetIdx
                                            }
                                            .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
                                    ) {
                                        Text("🎮 ${simGame.title}", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 12.sp)
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ResearchArchiveView(
    viewModel: GameViewModel
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val clipboardManager = LocalClipboardManager.current
    val researchItems by viewModel.researchManager.researchItems.collectAsState()

    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Card(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.7f)),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Text("📚 考據報告庫 (Research Archive)", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                    Text("瀏覽本機歷史考據產生的研究報告、結構化知識與 Web Research 引用來源。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    Text("目前收錄報告：${researchItems.size} 篇", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }

        if (researchItems.isEmpty()) {
            item {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
                        .padding(32.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.HistoryEdu, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.textSecondary, modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp))
                        Text("尚未有任何考據報告", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp)
                        Text("請至「歷史研究」分頁選擇遊戲並點擊「開始深度研究」", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            items(researchItems, key = { it.id }) { item ->
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f)),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
                ) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Column {
                                Text(item.topicTitle, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                                Text("狀態：${item.status} · 遊戲：${item.gameTitle.ifBlank { "全庫分析" }}", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
                            }
                            SylphoraIconButton(onClick = {
                                clipboardManager.setText(AnnotatedString(item.result ?: ""))
                                Toast.makeText(context, "已複製報告內容至剪貼簿", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }) {
                                Icon(Icons.Filled.ContentCopy, contentDescription = "複製", tint = theme.accent, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                            }
                        }

                        if (!item.result.isNullOrBlank()) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                    .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
                                    .padding(12.dp)
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = item.result,
                                    color = theme.textMain,
                                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                                    lineHeight = 18.sp,
                                    maxLines = 8,
                                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextOverflow
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.example.audio.SoundManager
import com.example.GameViewModel
import com.example.ui.screens.settings.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collectLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import com.example.ui.theme.LocalPegasusTheme
import com.example.ui.theme.SylphoraCosmicStarfield

data class SettingsTabItem(
    val id: Int,
    val title: String,
    val subtitle: String,
    val group: String,
    val keywords: String,
    val icon: ImageVector
)

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun SettingsScreen(viewModel: GameViewModel, onClose: () -> Unit = {}) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val glassOpacity by viewModel.glassOpacity.collectAsState()
    val fontScale by viewModel.fontSize.collectAsState()

    var activeTab by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var searchQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var debouncedQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        snapshotFlow { searchQuery }
            .collectLatest { q ->
                delay(250)
                debouncedQuery = q
            }
    }
    var pendingTargetAnchor by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    
    val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val anchorRequesters = remember { mutableMapOf<String, androidx.compose.foundation.relocation.BringIntoViewRequester>() }

    LaunchedEffect(activeTab, pendingTargetAnchor) {
        val anchor = pendingTargetAnchor ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(180)
        anchorRequesters[anchor]?.bringIntoView()
        pendingTargetAnchor = null
    }

    val tabs = listOf(
        SettingsTabItem(0, "外觀與主題", "主題風格、桌布與成就", "常用設定", "theme appearance wallpaper achievement ui visual", Icons.Filled.Palette),
        SettingsTabItem(1, "遊戲體驗", "音效、BGM 與玩家檔案", "常用設定", "sound audio bgm profile player sfx music", Icons.Filled.SportsEsports),
        SettingsTabItem(2, "遊戲庫與資材", "ROM 來源、Asset 與 CSV", "常用設定", "rom asset csv artwork boxart scrape folder cover", Icons.Filled.FolderSpecial),
        SettingsTabItem(3, "模擬器與核心", "RetroArch / 獨立核心管理", "核心與任務", "emulator core retroarch mapping libretro launch", Icons.Filled.Memory),
        SettingsTabItem(4, "AI 模型與顧問", "金鑰輪替、多 Provider 與 Feature Binding", "常用設定", "ai curator gemini openrouter deepseek token profile binding provider key", Icons.Filled.SmartToy),
        SettingsTabItem(5, "考據與檢索", "Web Research 與搜尋模式", "常用設定", "research smart search duckduckgo tavily web query", Icons.Filled.TravelExplore),
        SettingsTabItem(6, "任務中心", "背景任務看板與一鍵維護", "核心與任務", "task background job maintenance sync queue", Icons.Filled.Checklist),
        SettingsTabItem(7, "進階維護", "Token 診斷、快取、Pegasus 匯出與重設", "進階與資訊", "advanced pegasus export backup reset db database cache token diagnostics", Icons.Filled.SettingsSuggest),
        SettingsTabItem(8, "關於", "版本、架構與致謝", "進階與資訊", "about version license architecture author credits", Icons.Filled.Info)
    )

    val itemSearchResults = remember(debouncedQuery) {
        if (debouncedQuery.isBlank()) emptyList()
        else SettingsSearchIndex.search(debouncedQuery)
    }

    val filteredTabs = remember(debouncedQuery) {
        if (debouncedQuery.isBlank()) tabs
        else {
            val q = debouncedQuery.trim().lowercase()
            tabs.filter { 
                it.title.lowercase().contains(q) || 
                it.subtitle.lowercase().contains(q) || 
                it.group.lowercase().contains(q) ||
                it.keywords.lowercase().contains(q)
            }
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        viewModel.updateCuratorNavigation("SETTINGS", null)
    }

    BoxWithConstraints(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(theme.background)
    ) {
        val screenWidth = maxWidth
        val screenHeight = maxHeight
        val isCompact = maxWidth < 720.dp || maxHeight < 520.dp

        if (theme.id.contains("sylphora") || theme.id.contains("iisu")) {
            SylphoraCosmicStarfield(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), isDark = theme.isDark)
        }

        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            if (isCompact) {
                // Compact Screen Layout: Top Scrollable Tabs + Content Below
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .padding(top = 68.dp, start = 12.dp, end = 12.dp, bottom = 12.dp)
                ) {
                    if (searchQuery.isBlank()) {
                        androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyRow(
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(bottom = 12.dp)
                        ) {
                            items(tabs.size, key = { tabs[it].id }) { idx ->
                                val item = tabs[idx]
                                val isSelected = activeTab == item.id
                                Surface(
                                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                                    color = if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (isSelected) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f)),
                                    modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                        activeTab = item.id
                                    }
                                ) {
                                    Row(
                                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                        modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
                                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                                    ) {
                                        Icon(
                                            item.icon,
                                            contentDescription = item.title,
                                            tint = if (isSelected) theme.background else theme.accent,
                                            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                                        )
                                        Text(
                                            item.title,
                                            color = if (isSelected) theme.background else theme.textMain,
                                            fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium,
                                            fontSize = 12.sp * fontScale.scale
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Content or Item-level Search Results
                    if (searchQuery.isNotBlank()) {
                        SearchResultsPanel(
                            results = itemSearchResults,
                            theme = theme,
                            onSelectEntry = { entry ->
                                SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                activeTab = entry.targetTabId
                                searchQuery = ""
                                pendingTargetAnchor = entry.anchorId
                            }
                        )
                    } else {
                        CompositionLocalProvider(LocalSettingsRequesters provides anchorRequesters) {
                            LazyColumn(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
                                contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 32.dp)
                            ) {
                                item {
                                    when (activeTab) {
                                        0 -> SettingsAppearanceSection(viewModel)
                                        1 -> SettingsGameplaySection(viewModel)
                                        2 -> SettingsLibrarySection(viewModel)
                                        3 -> SettingsEmulatorsSection(viewModel)
                                        4 -> SettingsAiSection(viewModel)
                                        5 -> SettingsResearchSection(viewModel)
                                        6 -> SettingsTasksSection(viewModel)
                                        7 -> SettingsAdvancedSection(viewModel)
                                        8 -> SettingsAboutSection()
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Wide Screen Split Layout
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
                ) {
                    // Left Column: Navigation Sidebar
                    LazyColumn(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .width(240.dp)
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .padding(top = 68.dp, bottom = 16.dp, end = 12.dp),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                    ) {
                        if (searchQuery.isBlank()) {
                            val grouped = tabs.groupBy { it.group }
                            grouped.forEach { (groupName, items) ->
                                item(key = "header_$groupName") {
                                    Text(
                                        text = groupName,
                                        color = theme.textSecondary.copy(alpha = 0.8f),
                                        fontSize = 11.sp * fontScale.scale,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                        modifier = Modifier.padding(start = 6.dp, top = 8.dp, bottom = 4.dp)
                                    )
                                }
                                items(items.size, key = { items[it].id }) { idx ->
                                    val item = items[idx]
                                    val isSelected = activeTab == item.id
                                    SettingsNavCard(
                                        item = item,
                                        isSelected = isSelected,
                                        theme = theme,
                                        onClick = {
                                            SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                            activeTab = item.id
                                        }
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            item(key = "search_header") {
                                Text(
                                    text = "符合的分區 (${filteredTabs.size})",
                                    color = theme.accent,
                                    fontSize = 11.sp * fontScale.scale,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                    modifier = Modifier.padding(start = 6.dp, top = 4.dp, bottom = 4.dp)
                                )
                            }
                            items(filteredTabs.size, key = { filteredTabs[it].id }) { idx ->
                                val item = filteredTabs[idx]
                                val isSelected = activeTab == item.id
                                SettingsNavCard(
                                    item = item,
                                    isSelected = isSelected,
                                    theme = theme,
                                    onClick = {
                                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                        activeTab = item.id
                                    }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Right Column: Active Category Content or Item-Level Search Results
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(1f)
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .padding(top = 68.dp, bottom = 16.dp)
                    ) {
                        if (searchQuery.isNotBlank()) {
                            SearchResultsPanel(
                                results = itemSearchResults,
                                theme = theme,
                                onSelectEntry = { entry ->
                                    SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                    activeTab = entry.targetTabId
                                    searchQuery = ""
                                    pendingTargetAnchor = entry.anchorId
                                }
                            )
                        } else {
                            CompositionLocalProvider(LocalSettingsRequesters provides anchorRequesters) {
                                LazyColumn(
                                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
                                    contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 32.dp)
                                ) {
                                    item {
                                        when (activeTab) {
                                            0 -> SettingsAppearanceSection(viewModel)
                                            1 -> SettingsGameplaySection(viewModel)
                                            2 -> SettingsLibrarySection(viewModel)
                                            3 -> SettingsEmulatorsSection(viewModel)
                                            4 -> SettingsAiSection(viewModel)
                                            5 -> SettingsResearchSection(viewModel)
                                            6 -> SettingsTasksSection(viewModel)
                                            7 -> SettingsAdvancedSection(viewModel)
                                            8 -> SettingsAboutSection()
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Floating Top Bar with Back, Title and Live Search Input
            Surface(
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp),
                color = theme.surface.copy(alpha = glassOpacity.coerceAtLeast(0.88f)),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.textMain.copy(alpha = 0.15f)),
                shadowElevation = 8.dp,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(start = 16.dp, end = 16.dp, top = 12.dp)
                    .align(Alignment.TopCenter)
            ) {
                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                ) {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        IconButton(
                            onClick = onClose,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(38.dp)
                                .clip(CircleShape)
                                .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack,
                                contentDescription = "返回",
                                tint = theme.textMain,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                            )
                        }
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "設定",
                            color = theme.textMain,
                            fontSize = 17.sp * fontScale.scale,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
                        )
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Surface(
                            shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                            color = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.18f),
                            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.35f))
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = tabs.find { it.id == activeTab }?.title ?: "",
                                color = theme.accent,
                                fontSize = 12.sp * fontScale.scale,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                            )
                        }
                    }

                    // Search Box
                    Surface(
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                        color = theme.background.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.25f)),
                        modifier = Modifier.widthIn(min = 180.dp, max = 260.dp).height(38.dp)
                    ) {
                        Row(
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp)
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                Icons.Filled.Search,
                                contentDescription = "搜尋設定",
                                tint = theme.accent,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                            )
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                            androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField(
                                value = searchQuery,
                                onValueChange = { searchQuery = it },
                                singleLine = true,
                                textStyle = androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(
                                    color = theme.textMain,
                                    fontSize = 12.sp * fontScale.scale
                                ),
                                decorationBox = { innerTextField ->
                                    if (searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                                        Text(
                                            "搜尋設定項目...",
                                            color = theme.textSecondary.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                                            fontSize = 12.sp * fontScale.scale
                                        )
                                    }
                                    innerTextField()
                                },
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                            )
                            if (searchQuery.isNotEmpty()) {
                                IconButton(
                                    onClick = { searchQuery = "" },
                                    modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                                ) {
                                    Icon(
                                        Icons.Filled.Close,
                                        contentDescription = "清除搜尋",
                                        tint = theme.textSecondary,
                                        modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp)
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SettingsNavCard(
    item: SettingsTabItem,
    isSelected: Boolean,
    theme: com.example.ui.theme.PegasusTheme,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
        color = if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
        border = BorderStroke(
            1.dp,
            if (isSelected) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.06f)
        ),
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 11.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
        ) {
            Icon(
                imageVector = item.icon,
                contentDescription = item.title,
                tint = if (isSelected) theme.background else theme.accent,
                modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
            )
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = item.title,
                    color = if (isSelected) theme.background else theme.textMain,
                    fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.ExtraBold else FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )
                Text(
                    text = item.subtitle,
                    color = if (isSelected) theme.background.copy(alpha = 0.75f) else theme.textSecondary,
                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SearchResultsPanel(
    results: List<SettingsSearchEntry>,
    theme: com.example.ui.theme.PegasusTheme,
    onSelectEntry: (SettingsSearchEntry) -> Unit
) {
    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 32.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "設定搜尋結果 (${results.size} 項符合)",
                    color = theme.accent,
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                )
            }
        }

        if (results.isEmpty()) {
            item {
                Surface(
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                    color = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f)),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 16.dp)
                ) {
                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(24.dp),
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            Icons.Filled.SearchOff,
                            contentDescription = null,
                            tint = theme.textSecondary,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp)
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            "找不到符合的設定項目",
                            color = theme.textMain,
                            fontSize = 14.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                        Text(
                            "請嘗試輸入其他關鍵字，如 音量、ROM、AI、考據、核心、Token 等",
                            color = theme.textSecondary,
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 4.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            items(results.size, key = { results[it].id }) { idx ->
                val entry = results[idx]
                Surface(
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                    color = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.25f)),
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clickable { onSelectEntry(entry) }
                ) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
                    ) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(36.dp)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                .background(theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.18f)),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                Icons.Filled.Tune,
                                contentDescription = null,
                                tint = theme.accent,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                            )
                        }

                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Row(
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = entry.title,
                                    color = theme.textMain,
                                    fontSize = 14.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                )
                                Surface(
                                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                                    color = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f)
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = entry.sectionName,
                                        color = theme.accent,
                                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                        modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = entry.description,
                                color = theme.textSecondary,
                                fontSize = 12.sp,
                                maxLines = 2,
                                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                            )
                        }

                        Icon(
                            Icons.Filled.ArrowForward,
                            contentDescription = "前往設定",
                            tint = theme.accent,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ui.screens

import androidx.compose.animation.*
import androidx.compose.animation.core.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.Image
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.interaction.MutableInteractionSource
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.CircleShape
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.AutoAwesome
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.NightlightRound
import androidx.compose.material3.Icon
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.alpha
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.blur
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.scale
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontFamily
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextAlign
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.example.R
import com.example.audio.SoundManager
import com.example.ui.theme.LocalPegasusTheme
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay

@Composable
fun SylphoraSplashScreen(
    onFinished: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current

    var visible by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var textPhase by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }

    // Breathing pulse for cosmic moonlight atmosphere
    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "SylphoraPulse")
    val pulseScale by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 1.0f,
        targetValue = 1.05f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(4000, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "pulseScale"
    )

    val starlightGlow by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.4f,
        targetValue = 0.95f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(2800, easing = LinearEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "starlightGlow"
    )

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        visible = true
        delay(600)
        textPhase = 1
        delay(1200)
        textPhase = 2
        delay(1800)
        // Automatic gentle transition
        onFinished()
    }

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(Color(0xFF070B14))
            .clickable(
                interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                indication = null
            ) {
                try {
                    SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                } catch (e: Throwable) {}
                onFinished()
            }
    ) {
        // Celestial Starry Background Artwork
        Image(
            painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.sylphora_celestial_bg),
            contentDescription = "Sylphora Celestial Moonlight Background",
            contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .scale(pulseScale)
                .alpha(0.85f)
        )

        // Ethereal Vignette Overlay (Deep cosmic blue and moonlight silver)
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(
                    Brush.radialGradient(

package com.example.ui.screens.settings

import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.compose.rememberLauncherForActivityResult
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.*
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalClipboardManager
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.text.AnnotatedString
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontFamily
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.example.GameViewModel
import com.example.agent.TokenBudgetManager
import com.example.agent.TokenDiagnostics
import com.example.ui.theme.LocalPegasusTheme

@Composable
fun SettingsAdvancedSection(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val clipboardManager = LocalClipboardManager.current
    val games by viewModel.allGames.collectAsState()

    var showClearDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var tokenDiagnostics by remember { mutableStateOf(TokenBudgetManager.getDiagnostics(games.size)) }

    var fullLibraryExportText by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var pendingFullLibraryExport by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val fullLibraryExportLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri != null && pendingFullLibraryExport != null) {
            runCatching {
                context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.bufferedWriter()?.use {
                    it.write(pendingFullLibraryExport!!)
                } ?: error("無法寫入檔案")
                Toast.makeText(context, "完整遊戲庫已匯出", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }.onFailure {
                Toast.makeText(context, "匯出失敗：${it.message ?: "未知錯誤"}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }
        pendingFullLibraryExport = null
    }

    var pegasusExportText by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var pendingPegasusExport by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val pegasusExportLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("text/plain")
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri != null && pendingPegasusExport != null) {
            runCatching {
                context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.bufferedWriter()?.use {
                    it.write(pendingPegasusExport!!)
                } ?: error("無法寫入檔案")
                Toast.makeText(context, "Pegasus metadata 已匯出", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }.onFailure {
                Toast.makeText(context, "匯出失敗：${it.message ?: "未知錯誤"}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }
        pendingPegasusExport = null
    }

    var themeExportText by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var pendingThemeExport by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val themeExportLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri != null && pendingThemeExport != null) {
            runCatching {
                context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.bufferedWriter()?.use {
                    it.write(pendingThemeExport!!)
                } ?: error("無法寫入檔案")
                Toast.makeText(context, "主題 JSON 已匯出", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }.onFailure {
                Toast.makeText(context, "匯出失敗：${it.message ?: "未知錯誤"}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }
        pendingThemeExport = null
    }

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp)) {
        // Section Header
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.SettingsSuggest, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent)
                    Text("📦 進階維護與診斷匯出 (Advanced & Diagnostics)", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
                Text(
                    "包含 AI Token 預算與檢索診斷、快取管理、標準 Pegasus Frontend 格式 (metadata.pegasus.txt) 匯出、JSON 備份與資料庫重設。",
                    color = theme.textSecondary,
                    fontSize = 13.sp
                )
            }
        }

        // Token & AI Retrieval Diagnostics Dashboard
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("token_diagnostics").settingsAnchor("context_strategy"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.Analytics, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent)
                        Text("AI 檢索效率與 Token 診斷", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                    }
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = { tokenDiagnostics = TokenBudgetManager.getDiagnostics(games.size) },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.2f)),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.Refresh, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
                        Text("刷新", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }

                Text(
                    "Sylphora 採用 Retrieval-First 架構，先由本機檢索並過濾候選遊戲，僅將關鍵資訊送入大模型，大幅節省 Token 並避免溢出。",
                    color = theme.textSecondary,
                    fontSize = 12.sp
                )

                // 2x3 Metric Grid
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        MetricBox("遊戲庫總數", "${games.size} 款", Modifier.weight(1f), theme)
                        MetricBox("檢索候選數", "${tokenDiagnostics.totalRetrievedCandidates}", Modifier.weight(1f), theme)
                        MetricBox("送入 AI 數", "${tokenDiagnostics.totalSentToAiCandidates}", Modifier.weight(1f), theme)
                    }
                    Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        val actualTokens = tokenDiagnostics.totalActualInputTokens + tokenDiagnostics.totalActualOutputTokens
                        val estTokens = tokenDiagnostics.totalEstimatedInputTokens + tokenDiagnostics.totalEstimatedOutputTokens
                        MetricBox("實際 Token (API)", if (actualTokens > 0) "$actualTokens" else "無數據", Modifier.weight(1f), theme)
                        MetricBox("估算 Token (Fallback)", if (estTokens > 0) "≈ $estTokens" else "0", Modifier.weight(1f), theme)
                        MetricBox("快取節省 Token", "≈ ${tokenDiagnostics.cacheSavedTokensEstimated}", Modifier.weight(1f), theme)
                    }
                }

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = {
                            TokenBudgetManager.clearAllCaches()
                            tokenDiagnostics = TokenBudgetManager.getDiagnostics(games.size)
                            Toast.makeText(context, "AI 摘要與重覆請求快取已清除", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.surface),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.height(38.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.CleaningServices, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.textMain, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                        Text("清除 AI 快取", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }

                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = {
                            TokenBudgetManager.resetDiagnostics()
                            tokenDiagnostics = TokenBudgetManager.getDiagnostics(games.size)
                            Toast.makeText(context, "Token 統計數據已歸零", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.surface),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.height(38.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.RestartAlt, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.textMain, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                        Text("歸零統計", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Force Rematch Assets Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("force_rematch"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Sync, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent)
                    Text("強制重新比對資產 (Force Re-match Assets)", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                }
                Text("清除本地資材比對記錄快取 (Asset Match Records)，強制重新深度掃描資材目錄並更新遊戲庫資材。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)

                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = {
                        viewModel.matchLocalAssetsFromAssetRoot(missingOnly = false, forceRematch = true)
                        Toast.makeText(context, "已啟動資材強制重新比對", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(42.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Autorenew, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.background, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Text("強制重新比對", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }
        }

        // Pegasus Export Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("pegasus_export"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Description, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent)
                    Text("匯出 Pegasus 格式 (metadata.pegasus.txt)", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                }
                Text("將遊戲標題、檔案路徑、封面資材、平台分類與歷史描述轉換為標準 Pegasus 前端設定檔文字。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)

                SylphoraButton(

                        pegasusExportLauncher.launch("metadata.pegasus.txt")
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(42.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.ContentCopy, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.background, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))

                if (pegasusExportText != null) {

                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .heightIn(max = 120.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                            .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                            .padding(10.dp)

                        Text(
                            text = pegasusExportText!!,
                            color = Color(0xFF34D399),
                            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                            fontSize = 11.sp
                        )
                    }

            }
        }

        // Full Library Export Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Save, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent)
                    Text("完整遊戲庫 JSON 備份", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                }
                Text("匯出完整遊戲庫 JSON，包含遊戲資料、收藏分析、健康狀態與研究統計。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)

                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = {
                        val json = viewModel.exportFullLibrary()
                        fullLibraryExportText = json
                        clipboardManager.setText(AnnotatedString(json))
                        pendingFullLibraryExport = json
                        fullLibraryExportLauncher.launch("sylphora-full-library.json")
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(42.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Save, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.background, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Text("匯出完整遊戲庫 JSON", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }
        }

        // Theme JSON Export Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Palette, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent)
                    Text("匯出主題配置 (Theme JSON)", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                }
                Text("將目前主題配色、佈局模式與音效偏好匯出為 JSON 設定檔。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)

                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = {
                        val json = viewModel.exportThemeJson()
                        themeExportText = json
                        clipboardManager.setText(AnnotatedString(json))
                        pendingThemeExport = json
                        themeExportLauncher.launch("sylphora-theme.json")
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.surface),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(42.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Code, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.textMain, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Text("匯出主題 JSON", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }
        }

        // Clear Library Dangerous Zone
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("db_reset"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = Color(0xFF7F1D1D).copy(alpha = 0.35f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFEF4444).copy(alpha = 0.5f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Warning, contentDescription = null, tint = Color(0xFFEF4444))
                    Text("危險區域：重設遊戲資料庫", color = Color(0xFFFCA5A5), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                }
                Text("清空本機資料庫中的所有遊戲索引、考據資料與遊玩紀錄。可隨時重新掃描 ROM 資料夾重建。", color = Color(0xFFFCA5A5).copy(alpha = 0.8f), fontSize = 12.sp)

                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = { showClearDialog = true },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFDC2626)),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(42.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.DeleteSweep, contentDescription = null, tint = Color.White, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Text("清空遊戲庫資料庫", color = Color.White, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (showClearDialog) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { showClearDialog = false },
            title = { Text("確認清空遊戲庫？", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
            text = { Text("此操作將刪除目前資料庫中的所有遊戲資料。你可以隨時重新選擇 ROM 資料夾進行掃描。", color = theme.textSecondary) },
            confirmButton = {
                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = {
                        viewModel.clearLibrary()
                        showClearDialog = false
                        Toast.makeText(context, "遊戲庫已清空", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFDC2626))
                ) {
                    Text("確定清空", color = Color.White, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                SylphoraTextButton(onClick = { showClearDialog = false }) {
                    Text("取消", color = theme.textMain)
                }
            },
            containerColor = theme.background,
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp)
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun MetricBox(label: String, value: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, theme: com.example.ui.theme.PegasusTheme) {
    Surface(
        modifier = modifier,
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
        color = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f))
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)
        ) {
            Text(label, color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 10.sp, maxLines = 1)
            Text(value, color = theme.accent, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 1)
        }
    }
}
