@Composable
fun SettingsAiSection(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current

    val colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
        focusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
        unfocusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
        focusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
        unfocusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.3f),
        focusedIndicatorColor = theme.accent,
        unfocusedIndicatorColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f)
    )

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp)) {
        // Section Header
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp)) {
                Text("🤖 AI 服務與金鑰設定", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text(
                    "設定目前使用中的 AI 模型與 Provider。沒有有效 API 或連線失敗時，系統會自動切換為本機演算法模式，確保所有功能隨時可用。",
                    color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp
                )
            }
        }

        // Api Profile Manager
        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("ai_profiles").settingsAnchor("ai_rotation")) {
            ApiProfileManager(viewModel)
        }

        // Feature Profile Bindings
        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("feature_binding")) {
            FeatureProfileBindingsCard(viewModel)
        }

        // Asset Image Scrape Services (SteamGridDB)
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Text("🖼️ 圖片與資材服務 (SteamGridDB)", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Text("提供高品質 Cover、Banner、Icon、Logo 與 Hero 圖檔自動下載。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)

                val sgdbKey = remember { mutableStateOf(viewModel.getSgdbKey()) }
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = sgdbKey.value,
                    onValueChange = { sgdbKey.value = it },
                    label = { Text("SteamGridDB API Key（選填，支援全自動資材抓取）") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    colors = colors,
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                    singleLine = true
                )

                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = {
                        viewModel.saveApiKeys(sgdbKey = sgdbKey.value, geminiKey = viewModel.getGeminiKey())
                        Toast.makeText(context, "圖片服務設定已儲存", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.surface),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(44.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("儲存圖片服務 Key", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }

        // Curator Personality
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("curator_personality"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Text("💬 AI 館長對話風格", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Text("自訂 AI 館長在推薦遊戲與歷史考據時的語氣與性格。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)

                val personality = remember { mutableStateOf(viewModel.getCuratorPersonality()) }
                Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    listOf("friendly" to "親切熱情 🌸", "neutral" to "冷靜客觀 🏛️", "sarcastic" to "幽默輕鬆 ⚡").forEach { (type, label) ->
                        val selected = personality.value == type
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .weight(1f)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                                .background(if (selected) theme.accent else theme.surface.copy(alpha = .5f))
                                .clickable { personality.value = type }
                                .padding(vertical = 12.dp),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                label,
                                color = if (selected) theme.background else theme.textMain,
                                fontSize = 13.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = {
                        viewModel.saveApiKeys(sgdbKey = viewModel.getSgdbKey(), geminiKey = viewModel.getGeminiKey(), personality = personality.value)
                        Toast.makeText(context, "顧問對話風格已儲存", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.surface),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(44.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("儲存顧問設定", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ApiProfileManager(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var revision by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var editingId by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var showEditor by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var testMessage by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var refreshingProfileId by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val profiles = remember(revision) { viewModel.apiProfiles }
    val defaultId = remember(revision) { viewModel.defaultApiProfileId }
    val editing = profiles.firstOrNull { it.id == editingId }

    // Editor state
    var name by remember(showEditor, editingId) { mutableStateOf(editing?.displayName ?: "我的 AI") }
    var selectedModel by remember(showEditor, editingId) { mutableStateOf(editing?.model ?: "") }
    var baseUrl by remember(showEditor, editingId) { mutableStateOf(if (editing?.provider == "CLOUDFLARE") editing.accountId.orEmpty() else editing?.baseUrl.orEmpty()) }
    var keysText by remember(showEditor, editingId) {
        mutableStateOf(editing?.apiKeys?.joinToString("\n") { it.key } ?: editing?.apiKey.orEmpty())
    }
    var provider by remember(showEditor, editingId) { mutableStateOf(editing?.provider ?: com.example.api.AiProvider.GEMINI.name) }
    var isDiscoveringModels by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var discoveredModels by remember { mutableStateOf<List<com.example.api.AiModel>>(emptyList()) }
    var discoveryError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var editorTestMessage by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var isEditorTesting by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var modelDropdownExpanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    Card(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp), colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)), border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text("AI API 管理 (Provider Cards)", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                    Text("從 Provider API 動態獲取可用模型。支援金鑰輪替、容錯轉移與功能分派。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
                Button(
                    onClick = {
                        editingId = null
                        name = "新的 AI Profile"
                        selectedModel = ""
                        baseUrl = ""
                        keysText = ""
                        provider = com.example.api.AiProvider.GEMINI.name
                        discoveredModels = emptyList()
                        discoveryError = null
                        testMessage = null
                        editorTestMessage = null
                        showEditor = true
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(40.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Add, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Text("新增 API", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }

            if (profiles.isEmpty()) {
                Box(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)).background(theme.background.copy(alpha = 0.25f)).padding(16.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text("目前沒有 AI Profile。請點擊上方「新增 API」新增一組；無可用 API 時系統將使用 LOCAL 演算法。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            } else {
                profiles.forEach { profile ->
                    val isDefault = profile.id == defaultId

                    Card(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
                            containerColor = if (isDefault) theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.14f) else theme.background.copy(alpha = 0.35f)
                        ),
                        border = BorderStroke(
                            if (isDefault) 1.5.dp else 1.dp,
                            if (isDefault) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f)
                        )
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                            // Header Row
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                            ) {
                                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                                    Box(
                                        modifier = Modifier.size(34.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(if (isDefault) theme.accent else theme.surface),
                                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                    ) {
                                        Icon(
                                            Icons.Filled.Key,
                                            contentDescription = null,
                                            tint = if (isDefault) theme.background else theme.accent,
                                            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                                        )
                                    }
                                    Column {
                                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                                            Text(profile.displayName, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                                            if (isDefault) {
                                                Box(
                                                    modifier = Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)).background(theme.accent).padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                                                ) {
                                                    Text("目前使用", color = theme.background, fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                        Text("Provider: ${profile.provider}", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
                                    }
                                }

                                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                                    if (!isDefault) {
                                        IconButton(onClick = {
                                            viewModel.setDefaultApiProfile(profile.id)
                                            revision++
                                            testMessage = "已將「${profile.displayName}」設為目前主要使用 API"
                                            Toast.makeText(context, "已設為目前使用", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                        }) {
                                            Icon(Icons.Filled.CheckCircleOutline, contentDescription = "設為目前使用", tint = theme.accent)
                                        }
                                    }
                                    IconButton(onClick = {
                                        editingId = profile.id
                                        name = profile.displayName
                                        selectedModel = profile.model
                                        baseUrl = if (profile.provider == "CLOUDFLARE") profile.accountId.orEmpty() else profile.baseUrl.orEmpty()
                                        keysText = if (profile.apiKeys.isNotEmpty()) profile.apiKeys.joinToString("\n") { it.key } else profile.apiKey.orEmpty()
                                        provider = profile.provider
                                        discoveredModels = viewModel.getCachedModelsForProfile(profile.id)
                                        discoveryError = null
                                        testMessage = null
                                        editorTestMessage = null
                                        showEditor = true
                                    }) {
                                        Icon(Icons.Filled.Edit, contentDescription = "編輯 API", tint = theme.textMain)
                                    }
                                    IconButton(onClick = {
                                        viewModel.deleteApiProfile(profile.id)
                                        if (isDefault) {
                                            profiles.firstOrNull { it.id != profile.id }?.let { viewModel.setDefaultApiProfile(it.id) }
                                        }
                                        revision++
                                        testMessage = "已刪除「${profile.displayName}」"
                                    }) {
                                        Icon(Icons.Filled.DeleteOutline, contentDescription = "刪除 API", tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            // Model & Key Details
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                            ) {
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.7f)).padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                                ) {
                                    Text("Model: ${profile.model.ifBlank { "未指定 Model" }}", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            testMessage?.let {
                Text(it, color = theme.accent, fontSize = 12.sp)
            }
        }
    }

    if (showEditor) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { showEditor = false },
            title = {
                Text(if (editingId == null) "新增 AI Profile" else "編輯 AI Profile", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            },
            text = {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(max = 420.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
                ) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = name,
                        onValueChange = { name = it },
                        label = { Text("Profile 名稱") },
                        singleLine = true,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )

                    // Provider Selector
                    Text("選擇 Provider", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    val providers = listOf(
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.GEMINI.name,
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.OPENAI.name,
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.GROQ.name,
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.CLOUDFLARE.name,
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.GITHUB.name,
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.OPENROUTER.name,
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.OLLAMA.name,
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.CUSTOM.name,
                        com.example.api.AiProvider.LOCAL.name
                    )
                    androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                        items(providers.size, key = { providers[it] }) { idx ->
                            val p = providers[idx]
                            FilterChip(
                                selected = provider == p,
                                onClick = {
                                    provider = p
                                    if (p == "CLOUDFLARE" && baseUrl.isBlank()) baseUrl = ""
                                },
                                label = { Text(p, fontSize = 11.sp) }
                            )
                        }
                    }

                    if (provider in listOf("OPENAI", "CLAUDE", "DEEPSEEK", "GROQ", "CUSTOM", "LOCAL")) {
                        OutlinedTextField(
                            value = baseUrl,
                            onValueChange = { baseUrl = it },
                            label = { Text("Base URL (選填，保留預設請留空)") },
                            placeholder = { Text("例如: https://api.openai.com/v1") },
                            singleLine = true,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        )
                    }

                    if (provider == "CLOUDFLARE") {
                        OutlinedTextField(
                            value = baseUrl,
                            onValueChange = { baseUrl = it },
                            label = { Text("Cloudflare Account ID") },
                            placeholder = { Text("貼上你的 Cloudflare Account ID") },
                            singleLine = true,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        )
                    }

                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = keysText,
                        onValueChange = { keysText = it },
                        label = { Text(if (provider == "CLOUDFLARE") "Cloudflare API Token(s)" else "API Key(s) (每行一個輪替)") },
                        placeholder = { Text("貼上 API Key（支援多行多組輪替）") },
                        minLines = 2,
                        maxLines = 3,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )

                    // Dynamic Model Discovery
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        SylphoraButton(
                            onClick = {
                                isDiscoveringModels = true
                                discoveryError = null
                                scope.launch {
                                    val tempProfile = ApiProfile(
                                        id = editingId ?: "temp",
                                        provider = provider,
                                        displayName = name,
                                        model = selectedModel,
                                        baseUrl = if (provider == "CLOUDFLARE") null else baseUrl.trim().ifBlank { null },
                                        accountId = if (provider == "CLOUDFLARE") baseUrl.trim().ifBlank { null } else null,
                                        apiKey = keysText.lines().firstOrNull { it.isNotBlank() }?.trim(),
                                        apiKeys = keysText.lines().filter { it.isNotBlank() }.map { com.example.api.ApiKeyEntry(java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(), it.trim(), "Key") }
                                    )
                                    val firstKey = keysText.lines().firstOrNull { it.isNotBlank() }?.trim().orEmpty()
                                    val res = viewModel.discoverModels(tempProfile, firstKey)
                                    isDiscoveringModels = false
                                    if (res.isSuccess) {
                                        discoveredModels = res.getOrDefault(emptyList())
                                        if (discoveredModels.isNotEmpty()) {
                                            if (selectedModel.isBlank() || discoveredModels.none { it.id == selectedModel }) {
                                                selectedModel = discoveredModels.first().id
                                            }
                                        }
                                    } else {
                                        discoveryError = res.exceptionOrNull()?.message ?: "獲取模型失敗"
                                    }
                                }
                            },
                            enabled = !isDiscoveringModels,
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(40.dp),
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent)
                        ) {
                            if (isDiscoveringModels) {
                                CircularProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp), strokeWidth = 2.dp, color = theme.background)
                                Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                Text("搜尋中...", color = theme.background, fontSize = 11.sp)
                            } else {
                                Icon(Icons.Filled.Search, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp), tint = theme.background)
                                Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                Text("取得可用模型清單", color = theme.background, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (discoveryError != null) {
                        Text("錯誤: $discoveryError", color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error, fontSize = 11.sp)
                    } else if (discoveredModels.isNotEmpty()) {
                        Text("✓ 已成功獲取 ${discoveredModels.size} 個相容模型", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp)
                    }

                    // Model Selector
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                        OutlinedTextField(
                            value = selectedModel,
                            onValueChange = { selectedModel = it },
                            label = { Text("Model 名稱") },
                            placeholder = { Text("例如: gemini-2.5-flash / gpt-4o") },
                            singleLine = true,
                            trailingIcon = {
                                if (discoveredModels.isNotEmpty()) {
                                    IconButton(onClick = { modelDropdownExpanded = true }) {
                                        Icon(Icons.Filled.ArrowDropDown, contentDescription = "選擇")
                                    }
                                }
                            },
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        )
                        if (discoveredModels.isNotEmpty()) {
                            DropdownMenu(
                                expanded = modelDropdownExpanded,
                                onDismissRequest = { modelDropdownExpanded = false },
                                modifier = Modifier.heightIn(max = 240.dp)
                            ) {
                                discoveredModels.forEach { m ->
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                        text = {
                                            Column {
                                                Text(m.displayName, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                                                Text(m.id, fontSize = 10.sp, color = Color.Gray)
                                            }
                                        },
                                        onClick = {
                                            selectedModel = m.id
                                            modelDropdownExpanded = false
                                        }
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Test connection
                    SylphoraOutlinedButton(
                        onClick = {
                            isEditorTesting = true
                            scope.launch {
                                val keyList = keysText.lines().map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.mapIndexed { idx, k ->
                                    com.example.api.ApiKeyEntry(java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(), k, "Key #${idx + 1}")
                                }
                                val tempProfile = ApiProfile(
                                    id = editingId ?: "test_temp",
                                    provider = provider,
                                    displayName = name.trim(),
                                    model = selectedModel.trim(),
                                    baseUrl = if (provider == "CLOUDFLARE") null else baseUrl.trim().ifBlank { null },
                                    accountId = if (provider == "CLOUDFLARE") baseUrl.trim().ifBlank { null } else null,
                                    apiKey = keyList.firstOrNull()?.key,
                                    apiKeys = keyList
                                )
                                val res = viewModel.testApiProfile(tempProfile)
                                isEditorTesting = false
                                editorTestMessage = "${if (res.success) "✓ " else "✗ "}${res.message}"
                            }
                        },
                        enabled = !isEditorTesting && selectedModel.isNotBlank(),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(38.dp)
                    ) {
                        if (isEditorTesting) {
                            CircularProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp), strokeWidth = 2.dp)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                            Text("連線測試中...", fontSize = 11.sp)
                        } else {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.NetworkCheck, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                            Text("立即測試連線", fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }
                    }
                    editorTestMessage?.let {
                        Text(it, color = if (it.startsWith("✓")) theme.accent else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error, fontSize = 11.sp)
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = {
                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = {
                        if (name.isNotBlank()) {
                            val id = editingId ?: java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                            val finalModel = selectedModel.trim()
                            val keyList = keysText.lines().map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.mapIndexed { idx, k ->
                                com.example.api.ApiKeyEntry(id = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(), key = k, name = "Key #${idx + 1}")
                            }
                            val profile = ApiProfile(
                                id = id,
                                provider = provider,
                                displayName = name.trim(),
                                model = finalModel,
                                baseUrl = if (provider == "CLOUDFLARE") null else baseUrl.trim().ifBlank { null },
                                accountId = if (provider == "CLOUDFLARE") baseUrl.trim().ifBlank { null } else null,
                                apiKey = keyList.firstOrNull()?.key,
                                apiKeys = keyList
                            )
                            viewModel.saveApiProfile(profile)
                            if (defaultId == null || editingId == null) {
                                viewModel.setDefaultApiProfile(id)
                            }
                            revision++
                            showEditor = false
                            Toast.makeText(context, "API Profile 已儲存", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        }
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent)
                ) {
                    Text("儲存", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                SylphoraTextButton(onClick = { showEditor = false }) {
                    Text("取消", color = theme.textSecondary)
                }
            }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun FeatureProfileBindingsCard(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var revision by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val profiles = remember(revision, viewModel.apiProfiles) { viewModel.apiProfiles }
    val bindings = remember(revision) { viewModel.getFeatureProfileBindings() }
    val defaultProfileId = remember(revision) { viewModel.defaultApiProfileId }
    val defaultProfile = profiles.firstOrNull { it.id == defaultProfileId }

    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.AltRoute, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent, modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp))
                }
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text("🎯 各功能專屬 API 指派 (Feature Profile Binding)", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Text("可為 AI 館長、考據研究、DNA 分析等不同功能獨立指定專屬 Provider 與模型；未指定時自動跟隨主要使用 API。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }

            val featureList = listOf(
                Triple(AiFeature.CURATOR, "AI 遊戲顧問與館長", "即時對話、情緒推薦、隨機命運推薦"),
                Triple(AiFeature.RESEARCH, "歷史考據研究中心", "深層考據報告、跨作品比較、史料索引"),
                Triple(AiFeature.MUSEUM, "遊戲博物館與背景", "遊戲歷史背景、文化脈絡、發行逸事"),
                Triple(AiFeature.DNA, "遊戲 DNA 架構分析", "核心玩法拆解、難度曲線、風格標籤"),
                Triple(AiFeature.EVOLUTION, "系列演化譜系", "前後代繼承關係、歷史影響力脈絡"),
                Triple(AiFeature.DESCRIPTION, "遊戲描述自動生成", "簡介補充、無描述遊戲元資料擴充"),
                Triple(AiFeature.CHEATS, "秘技與金手指", "通關秘笈、隱藏要素、作弊碼解析"),
                Triple(AiFeature.GENERAL, "通用預設任務", "其他輔助分析與雜項任務")
            )

            featureList.forEach { (feature, title, desc) ->
                val currentBoundId = bindings[feature]
                val boundProfile = profiles.firstOrNull { it.id == currentBoundId }
                var expanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.background.copy(alpha = 0.35f)),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.06f))
                ) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text(title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                            Text(desc, color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }

                        Box {
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = { expanded = true },
                                shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (boundProfile != null) theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.6f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.15f)),
                                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                                colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(
                                    contentColor = if (boundProfile != null) theme.accent else theme.textSecondary
                                )
                            ) {
                                val label = if (boundProfile != null) {
                                    "${boundProfile.displayName} (${boundProfile.provider})"
                                } else {
                                    "預設 (${defaultProfile?.displayName ?: "主要 API"})"
                                }
                                Text(label, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium)
                                Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                Icon(Icons.Filled.ArrowDropDown, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            }

                            DropdownMenu(
                                expanded = expanded,
                                onDismissRequest = { expanded = false }
                            ) {
                                DropdownMenuItem(
                                    text = {
                                        Text(
                                            "跟隨主要使用 API (預設: ${defaultProfile?.displayName ?: "主要 API"})",
                                            fontWeight = if (currentBoundId == null) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal
                                        )
                                    },
                                    onClick = {
                                        viewModel.updateFeatureProfileBinding(feature, "")
                                        revision++
                                        expanded = false
                                        Toast.makeText(context, "$title 已恢復跟隨主要 API", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                    }
                                )
                                profiles.forEach { prof ->
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                        text = {
                                            Text(
                                                "${prof.displayName} · ${prof.provider} (${prof.model.ifBlank { "預設模型" }})",
                                                fontWeight = if (currentBoundId == prof.id) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal
                                            )
                                        },
                                        onClick = {
                                            viewModel.updateFeatureProfileBinding(feature, prof.id)
                                            revision++
                                            expanded = false
                                            Toast.makeText(context, "$title 已指派為 ${prof.displayName}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                        }
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@file:OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)

package com.example.ui.screens.settings

import androidx.compose.foundation.ExperimentalFoundationApi
import androidx.compose.foundation.relocation.BringIntoViewRequester
import androidx.compose.foundation.relocation.bringIntoViewRequester
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.composed

val LocalSettingsRequesters = staticCompositionLocalOf<MutableMap<String, BringIntoViewRequester>> {
    error("No Requesters")
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
fun Modifier.settingsAnchor(id: String): Modifier = composed {
    val map = LocalSettingsRequesters.current
    val requester = remember(id) { BringIntoViewRequester() }
    DisposableEffect(id) {
        map[id] = requester
        onDispose { map.remove(id) }
    }
    this.bringIntoViewRequester(requester)
}

@Composable
fun SettingsAppearanceSection(viewModel: GameViewModel) {

    val context = LocalContext.current
    val isDark by viewModel.isDarkTheme.collectAsState()
    val currentFamilyIndex by viewModel.currentThemeFamilyIndex.collectAsState()
    val currentLayout by viewModel.currentLayoutMode.collectAsState()
    val glassOpacity by viewModel.glassOpacity.collectAsState()
    val isCrtEnabled by viewModel.isCrtEnabled.collectAsState()
    var customWallpaper by remember { mutableStateOf(viewModel.customWallpaperUri.value ?: "") }

        contract = ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia()

        if (pickedUri == null) return@rememberLauncherForActivityResult
        val savedUri = AppImageStorage.copyToPrivateStorage(
            context, pickedUri, backgroundFileName
        )
        if (savedUri != null) {
            customWallpaper = savedUri.toString()
            viewModel.saveThemePreferences(currentFamilyIndex, isDark, currentLayout, savedUri.toString(), glassOpacity)
            Toast.makeText(context, "背景已更新", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(context, "背景圖片讀取失敗，請重新選擇", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp)) {
        // Theme Families Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("theme_selection"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    ThemeFamilies.forEachIndexed { index, family ->
                        val isSelected = index == currentFamilyIndex
                        ThemeFamilyCard(
                            family = family,
                            isSelected = isSelected,
                            onClick = {
                                SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                viewModel.saveThemePreferences(index, isDark, currentLayout, customWallpaper.ifBlank { null }, glassOpacity)
                            }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 字體大小設定
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp)) {
                val fontSize by viewModel.fontSize.collectAsState()
                Text("字體大小", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {

                        FilterChip(

                                Text(
                                    when (size) {
                                        FontSize.SMALL -> "小"

                                    fontSize = when (size) {
                                        FontSize.SMALL -> 12.sp
                                        FontSize.MEDIUM -> 14.sp
                                        FontSize.LARGE -> 16.sp
                                    }
                                )
                            }
                        )
                    }
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Text(
                    text = "這是字體大小預覽",

        ) {

                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text("CRT 濾鏡效果", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                    Text("模擬復古電視掃描線與暗角", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
                Switch(
                    checked = isCrtEnabled,
                    onCheckedChange = { viewModel.toggleCrtEnabled() },
                    colors = SwitchDefaults.colors(checkedThumbColor = theme.accent)
                )
            }
        }

        // 自訂桌布
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("custom_glass"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))

                            customWallpaper = ""
                            viewModel.saveThemePreferences(currentFamilyIndex, isDark, currentLayout, null, glassOpacity)
                            Toast.makeText(context, "已恢復預設背景", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        }) {
                            Text("移除／恢復預設", color = theme.textSecondary)

                Text(

                    color = theme.textSecondary,

        // Glass Opacity
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))

                        viewModel.saveThemePreferences(currentFamilyIndex, isDark, currentLayout, customWallpaper.ifBlank { null }, it)

        // Player Achievements
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("achievements"),

            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))

            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp)) {

                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                                .background(if (ach.isUnlocked) theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f) else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
                                .border(1.dp, if (ach.isUnlocked) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                                .padding(14.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(ach.icon, fontSize = 28.sp)
                            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                Text(ach.title, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                                Text(ach.description, color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                                LinearProgressIndicator(
                                    progress = { ach.progress },
                                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(4.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)),
                                    color = theme.accent,
                                    trackColor = theme.background
                                )
                            }
                            if (ach.isUnlocked) {
                                Text("已解鎖", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ThemeFamilyCard(
    family: ThemeFamily,
    isSelected: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val previewTheme = if (theme.isDark) family.dark else family.light

    Card(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clickable(onClick = onClick),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
            containerColor = if (isSelected) theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f) else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f)
        ),
        border = BorderStroke(
            if (isSelected) 2.dp else 1.dp,
            if (isSelected) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f)
        )
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(14.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = family.name,
                    color = if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.textMain,
                    fontSize = 15.sp,
                    fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium
                )
                Text(
                    text = "${previewTheme.name} · ${if (previewTheme.isDark) "暗色" else "亮色"}",
                    color = theme.textSecondary,
                    fontSize = 11.sp
                )
            }

            // Preview Color Swatches
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(20.dp)
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(family.dark.background)
                        .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.2f), CircleShape)
                )
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(20.dp)
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(family.dark.accent)
                )
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(20.dp)
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(
                            Brush.linearGradient(
                                listOf(family.dark.cardStart, family.dark.cardEnd)
                            )
                        )
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ui.screens.settings

import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SportsEsports
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color

import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight

import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp

@Composable
fun SettingsEmulatorsSection(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val settingsRepo = remember { com.example.settings.SettingsRepository(context) }
    var refreshTrigger by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }

    val platformConfigs = remember(refreshTrigger) {
        LauncherBridge.getPlatformEmulatorConfigs()
    }

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
        // Section Title & Overview Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("core_mapping").settingsAnchor("retroarch_path"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.12f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.35f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.SportsEsports, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent)
                    Text("🎮 平台模擬器與核心管理 (Emulator & Core Registry)", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                }
                Text(
                    "自訂各平台的預設模擬器與 Libretro 核心。預設使用系統最佳推薦（Auto）；亦可手動指定（Manual）特定模擬器或核心版本。",
                    color = theme.textSecondary,
                    fontSize = 12.sp
                )
                HorizontalDivider(color = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.2f), modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 4.dp))
                Row(

                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {

                    Text("Arcade 預設：MAME 2003", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                }
            }
        }

        // List of Platforms
        platformConfigs.forEach { config ->
            PlatformEmulatorRow(
                config = config,
                settingsRepo = settingsRepo,
                onRefresh = { refreshTrigger++ }
            )
        }

@Composable
private fun PlatformEmulatorRow(
    config: LauncherBridge.PlatformEmulatorConfig,
    settingsRepo: com.example.settings.SettingsRepository,
    onRefresh: () -> Unit
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val platKey = config.platform.uppercase()

    val currentMode = settingsRepo.getEmulatorMode(platKey)
    val currentEmuOverride = settingsRepo.getEmulatorOverride(platKey)
    val currentCoreOverride = settingsRepo.getCoreOverride(platKey)

    val activeEmulatorId = if (currentMode == "MANUAL") {
        currentEmuOverride ?: config.defaultEmulatorId
    } else {
        config.defaultEmulatorId
    }

    val activeEmulator = config.emulators.find { it.id == activeEmulatorId } ?: config.emulators.firstOrNull()

    val activeCoreFileName = if (currentMode == "MANUAL") {
        currentCoreOverride ?: (activeEmulator?.cores?.firstOrNull()?.coreFileName ?: config.defaultCoreFileName)
    } else {
        config.defaultCoreFileName
    }

    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (currentMode == "MANUAL") theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.5f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            // Header Row: Platform Name + Mode Toggle
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Column {
                    Text(
                        text = config.displayName,
                        color = theme.textMain,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 15.sp
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = "標籤 ID: ${config.platform}",
                        color = theme.textSecondary,
                        fontSize = 11.sp
                    )
                }

                // Auto / Manual Toggle
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f))
                        .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                        .padding(2.dp)
                ) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                            .background(if (currentMode == "AUTO") theme.accent else Color.Transparent)
                            .clickable {
                                SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                settingsRepo.saveEmulatorMode(platKey, "AUTO")
                                onRefresh()
                                Toast.makeText(context, "${config.displayName} 已設為自動推薦", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            "自動 (Auto)",
                            color = if (currentMode == "AUTO") theme.background else theme.textSecondary,
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                            .background(if (currentMode == "MANUAL") theme.accent else Color.Transparent)
                            .clickable {
                                SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                settingsRepo.saveEmulatorMode(platKey, "MANUAL")
                                if (currentEmuOverride == null) {
                                    settingsRepo.saveEmulatorOverride(platKey, config.defaultEmulatorId)
                                }
                                if (currentCoreOverride == null && config.defaultCoreFileName != null) {
                                    settingsRepo.saveCoreOverride(platKey, config.defaultCoreFileName)
                                }
                                onRefresh()
                                Toast.makeText(context, "${config.displayName} 已切換為手動指定", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            "手動 (Manual)",
                            color = if (currentMode == "MANUAL") theme.background else theme.textSecondary,
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            // Content based on Mode
            if (currentMode == "AUTO") {
                // Summary of current auto selection
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.35f))
                        .padding(10.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("推薦模擬器:", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    Text(
                        activeEmulator?.label ?: "RetroArch",
                        color = theme.accent,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                    if (activeCoreFileName != null) {
                        Text("• 核心:", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                        Text(
                            activeEmulator?.cores?.find { it.coreFileName == activeCoreFileName }?.label ?: activeCoreFileName,
                            color = theme.textMain,
                            fontSize = 12.sp
                        )
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Manual Mode: Select Emulator & Core
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Text("1. 選擇模擬器應用 (Emulator Target)", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

                    config.emulators.forEach { emu ->
                        val isEmuSelected = emu.id == activeEmulatorId
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                .background(if (isEmuSelected) theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f) else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
                                .border(1.dp, if (isEmuSelected) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                .clickable {
                                    SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                    settingsRepo.saveEmulatorOverride(platKey, emu.id)
                                    if (emu.cores.isNotEmpty() && emu.cores.none { it.coreFileName == activeCoreFileName }) {
                                        settingsRepo.saveCoreOverride(platKey, emu.cores.first().coreFileName)
                                    }
                                    onRefresh()
                                }
                                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Column {
                                Text(emu.label, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                                Text("套件: ${emu.packageName}", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 10.sp)
                            }
                            if (isEmuSelected) {
                                Text("✓ 已選用", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // If the selected emulator has multiple cores (e.g. RetroArch)
                    if (activeEmulator != null && activeEmulator.cores.isNotEmpty()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                        Text("2. 指定 Libretro 核心 (Core)", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

                        activeEmulator.cores.forEach { core ->
                            val isCoreSelected = core.coreFileName == activeCoreFileName
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                    .background(if (isCoreSelected) theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f) else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.2f))
                                    .border(1.dp, if (isCoreSelected) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                    .clickable {
                                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                        settingsRepo.saveCoreOverride(platKey, core.coreFileName)
                                        onRefresh()
                                    }
                                    .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                            ) {
                                Column {
                                    Text(core.label, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium)
                                    Text("檔案: ${core.coreFileName}", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 10.sp)
                                }
                                if (isCoreSelected) {
                                    Text("✓ 目前核心", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

import android.net.Uri

@Composable
fun SettingsGameplaySection(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val userProfile by viewModel.userProfile.collectAsState()

    val isSfxEnabled by viewModel.isSfxEnabled.collectAsState()
    val isBgmEnabled by viewModel.isBgmEnabled.collectAsState()
    val bgmVolume by viewModel.bgmVolume.collectAsState()

    var username by remember(userProfile.username) { mutableStateOf(userProfile.username) }
    var title by remember(userProfile.title) { mutableStateOf(userProfile.title) }
    var selectedAvatarType by remember(userProfile.avatarType) { mutableStateOf(userProfile.avatarType) }
    var customAvatarUri by remember(userProfile.customAvatarUri) { mutableStateOf(userProfile.customAvatarUri ?: "") }

    val colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
        focusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
        unfocusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
        focusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
        unfocusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.3f),
        focusedIndicatorColor = theme.accent,
        unfocusedIndicatorColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f)
    )

    val avatarPickerLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia()
    ) { pickedUri: Uri? ->
        if (pickedUri == null) return@rememberLauncherForActivityResult
        val savedUri = AppImageStorage.copyToPrivateStorage(
            context, pickedUri, "user_avatar.jpg"
        )
        if (savedUri != null) {
            customAvatarUri = savedUri.toString()
            selectedAvatarType = "custom"
            Toast.makeText(context, "頭像已更新，記得按下方「儲存個人檔案」", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(context, "頭像圖片讀取失敗，請重新選擇", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp)) {
        // Audio & Haptics Engine
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("audio_volume"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
                Text("🔊 原生音效與氛圍 BGM 引擎", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

                // SFX Switch
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
                ) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(14.dp),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text("掌機操作音效 (SFX & Haptics)", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp)
                            Text("選單切換、啟動遊戲、按鈕點擊等低延遲音效與震動回饋", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }
                        Switch(
                            checked = isSfxEnabled,
                            onCheckedChange = { viewModel.saveAudioSettings(it, isBgmEnabled, bgmVolume) },
                            colors = SwitchDefaults.colors(checkedThumbColor = theme.accent, checkedTrackColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                        )
                    }
                }

                // BGM Switch
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
                ) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(14.dp)) {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                Text("背景音樂 (BGM)", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp)
                                Text("播放晶片風格環境背景音樂", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
                            }
                            Switch(
                                checked = isBgmEnabled,
                                onCheckedChange = { viewModel.saveAudioSettings(isSfxEnabled, it, bgmVolume) },
                                colors = SwitchDefaults.colors(checkedThumbColor = theme.accent, checkedTrackColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                            )
                        }

                        if (isBgmEnabled) {
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
                            Text("BGM 音量: ${(bgmVolume * 100).toInt()}%", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 13.sp)
                            Slider(
                                value = bgmVolume,
                                onValueChange = { viewModel.saveAudioSettings(isSfxEnabled, true, it) },
                                valueRange = 0.05f..1.0f,
                                colors = SliderDefaults.colors(thumbColor = theme.accent, activeTrackColor = theme.accent)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Sound Test Buttons
                Text("測試音效", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = { SoundManager.playMoveSound(context) },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.surface),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text("游標移動", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = { SoundManager.playSelectSound(context) },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.surface),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text("確認點擊", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = { SoundManager.playLaunchSound(context) },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text("啟動遊戲", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Player Profile Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("player_profile"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                Text("👤 玩家個人設定", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = username,
                    onValueChange = { username = it },
                    label = { Text("玩家暱稱", color = theme.textSecondary) },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    colors = colors,
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                )

                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = title,
                    onValueChange = { title = it },
                    label = { Text("玩家頭銜/稱號", color = theme.textSecondary) },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    colors = colors,
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                )

                Text("選擇復古玩家頭像", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

                val avatarOptions = listOf(
                    "pixel_warrior" to "🗡️ 像素勇者",
                    "pixel_wizard" to "🧙 像素法師",
                    "pixel_cyber" to "⚡ 賽博駭客",
                    "pixel_robot" to "🤖 復古機器人",
                    "pixel_dragon" to "🐉 像素赤龍"
                )

                Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    avatarOptions.forEach { (type, label) ->
                        val isSelected = type == selectedAvatarType
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                                .background(if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                                .border(1.dp, if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                                .clickable {
                                    SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                    selectedAvatarType = type
                                }
                                .padding(10.dp),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = label.substring(0, 2),
                                fontSize = 22.sp
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                Text("或上傳自訂頭像照片", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                    if (selectedAvatarType == "custom" && customAvatarUri.isNotBlank()) {
                        AsyncImage(
                            model = customAvatarUri,
                            contentDescription = "目前頭像預覽",
                            contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(50.dp)
                                .clip(CircleShape)
                                .border(2.dp, theme.accent, CircleShape)
                        )
                    }
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = {
                            avatarPickerLauncher.launch(
                                androidx.activity.result.PickVisualMediaRequest(
                                    ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia.ImageOnly
                                )
                            )
                        },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.surface)
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.Image, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.textMain, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                        Text("選擇相片作為頭像", color = theme.textMain)
                    }
                    if (selectedAvatarType == "custom") {
                        SylphoraOutlinedButton(onClick = {
                            AppImageStorage.remove(context, "user_avatar.jpg")
                            customAvatarUri = ""
                            selectedAvatarType = "pixel_warrior"
                        }) {
                            Text("移除", color = theme.textSecondary)
                        }
                    }
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = {
                        viewModel.saveUserProfile(
                            username, title, selectedAvatarType,
                            if (selectedAvatarType == "custom") customAvatarUri.ifBlank { null } else null
                        )
                        Toast.makeText(context, "玩家檔案已更新！", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(48.dp),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("儲存個人檔案", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ui.screens.settings

import android.net.Uri
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.compose.rememberLauncherForActivityResult
