@Composable
fun SettingsLibrarySection(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current

    val romSources by viewModel.romSources.collectAsState()
    val discoveredPlatforms by viewModel.discoveredPlatforms.collectAsState()
    val isScanning by viewModel.isScanning.collectAsState()
    val assetRootUri by viewModel.assetRootUri.collectAsState()
    val descriptionRootUri by viewModel.descriptionRootUri.collectAsState()
    val importStatus by viewModel.importStatus.collectAsState()
    val customCollections by viewModel.customCollectionsList.collectAsState()
    var newCollectionName by remember { mutableStateOf("") }

    val colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
        focusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
        unfocusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
        focusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
        unfocusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.3f),
        focusedIndicatorColor = theme.accent,
        unfocusedIndicatorColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f)
    )

    val addRomSourcePicker = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocumentTree()
    ) { uri: Uri? ->
        uri?.let {
            viewModel.addRomSource("ROM 資料夾 ${romSources.size + 1}", it)
            Toast.makeText(context, "已新增 ROM 資料夾來源", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    val assetRootPicker = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocumentTree()
    ) { uri: Uri? ->
        uri?.let {
            viewModel.setAssetRootUri(it)
            Toast.makeText(context, "Asset 圖檔根目錄已保存", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    val descriptionRootPicker = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocumentTree()
    ) { uri: Uri? ->
        uri?.let {
            viewModel.setDescriptionRootUri(it)
            Toast.makeText(context, "Description CSV 目錄已設定並啟動同步", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    val externalImportPicker = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()
    ) { uri: Uri? -> uri?.let { viewModel.importExternalFile(it) } }

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp)) {
        // Section Intro
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp)) {
                Text("📂 資料與儲存 (ROM 來源 & 資材目錄)", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text("支援多個獨立 ROM 資料夾來源（以 SAF Tree 存取）、依平台個別掃描、Android 應用掃描、Asset 圖檔及描述目錄設定。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp)
            }
        }

        // ROM Sources List Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("rom_source"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Column {
                        Text("🎮 ROM 目錄來源", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                        Text("可新增多個 ROM 目錄，每個目錄可分別探索平台並進行掃描", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
                    }
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = { addRomSourcePicker.launch(null) },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent)
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.Add, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                        Text("新增 ROM 資料夾", fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                }

                if (romSources.isEmpty()) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .padding(vertical = 12.dp),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text("尚未加入任何 ROM 資料夾，請點擊上方按鈕選取 ROM 資料夾", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp)
                    }
                } else {
                    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                        romSources.forEach { source ->
                            val platforms = discoveredPlatforms[source.id] ?: emptyList()
                            Card(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f)),
                                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (source.enabled) theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.3f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f))
                            ) {
                                Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                                    Row(
                                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                                    ) {
                                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                            Text(source.name, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp)
                                            Text(source.treeUri, color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 10.sp, maxLines = 1)
                                        }
                                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                            Switch(
                                                checked = source.enabled,
                                                onCheckedChange = { viewModel.toggleRomSource(source.id, it) },
                                                colors = SwitchDefaults.colors(
                                                    checkedThumbColor = theme.accent,
                                                    checkedTrackColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.3f)
                                                )
                                            )
                                            IconButton(
                                                onClick = { viewModel.removeRomSource(source.id) },
                                                modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
                                            ) {
                                                Icon(Icons.Filled.Delete, contentDescription = "刪除", tint = Color.Red.copy(alpha = 0.7f), modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                                    // Discovered platforms chips
                                    if (platforms.isNotEmpty()) {
                                        Text("已辨識平台（點擊單獨掃描）：", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
                                        LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                                            items(platforms, key = { it }) { platform ->
                                                Box(
                                                    modifier = Modifier
                                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                                        .background(theme.surface)
                                                        .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.5f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                                        .clickable {
                                                            viewModel.scanRomSourcePlatform(source, platform)
                                                            Toast.makeText(context, "開始掃描平台：$platform", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                                        }
                                                        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                                                ) {
                                                    Text("🕹️ $platform", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium)
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                                        SylphoraOutlinedButton(
                                            onClick = { viewModel.scanRomSourcePlatform(source, null) },
                                            enabled = !isScanning && source.enabled,
                                            modifier = Modifier.height(36.dp)
                                        ) {
                                            Icon(Icons.Filled.Refresh, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                                            Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                            Text("掃描此目錄全部", fontSize = 11.sp)
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                            SylphoraButton(
                                onClick = { viewModel.scanAllRomSources() },
                                enabled = !isScanning && romSources.any { it.enabled },
                                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent)
                            ) {
                                Icon(Icons.Filled.FolderSpecial, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                                Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                Text("一鍵掃描所有啟用的 ROM 來源")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Android Apps & Emulators Scanner Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Text("📱 Android 應用程式與模擬器掃描", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                Text("獨立掃描本機已安裝的 Android 應用、遊戲與模擬器，並收錄至主程式庫中。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                SylphoraOutlinedButton(
                    onClick = { viewModel.scanInstalledAndroidApps() },
                    enabled = !isScanning
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Apps, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Text("掃描本機 Android 應用與模擬器")
                }
            }
        }

        // Asset Roots & Scraping Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("asset_matching").settingsAnchor("description_csv").settingsAnchor("scraper_settings"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                    Text("🖼️ 遊戲圖檔與資材總管", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                    Text("依序進行圖檔比對、Description CSV 同步與網路資材補充。系統遵循「只補缺、不覆蓋」原則。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }

                HorizontalDivider(color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))

                // Section 1: 遊戲圖片 (Asset Root & Scrape)
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Text("1. 遊戲圖片管理 (Cover / Background / Logo / Screenshot / Icon)", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 13.sp)
                    Text("Asset 根目錄：${assetRootUri ?: "未指定（網路抓取與圖片將儲存於 App 專屬內部空間 filesDir/assets/；可點擊下方按鈕指定外部目錄）"}", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp, maxLines = 2)

                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                        SylphoraOutlinedButton(
                            onClick = { assetRootPicker.launch(null) },
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.Collections, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp)); Text("指定 Asset 根目錄", fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }
                        SylphoraButton(
                            onClick = { viewModel.matchLocalAssetsFromAssetRoot() },
                            enabled = !isScanning,
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.Sync, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp)); Text("比對本地 Asset 與 CSV", fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }
                    }
                }

                HorizontalDivider(color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f))

                // Section 2: Description CSV Master Data
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Text("2. 遊戲簡介 Master Data (Description CSV)", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 13.sp)
                    Text("Description 資料夾：${descriptionRootUri ?: "未指定（預設讀寫：/storage/emulated/0/description/{platform}.csv）"}\n格式：Game,Description (最高優先權 Master Data，遵循不覆蓋原則)", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)

                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                        SylphoraOutlinedButton(
                            onClick = { descriptionRootPicker.launch(null) },
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.FolderOpen, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp)); Text("選擇 Description 資料夾", fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }
                        SylphoraButton(
                            onClick = { viewModel.syncAllGameDescriptions(false) },
                            enabled = !isScanning,
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.Sync, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp)); Text("重新同步 Description", fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }
                    }
                }

                HorizontalDivider(color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f))

                // Section 3: External metadata & Scraping
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Text("3. 外部匯入與網路補充", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 13.sp)
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                        SylphoraOutlinedButton(
                            onClick = {
                                externalImportPicker.launch(arrayOf("application/json", "text/csv", "text/plain", "application/xml", "text/*"))
                            },
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.FileOpen, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp)); Text("匯入外部 JSON/CSV", fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }
                        SylphoraOutlinedButton(
                            onClick = { viewModel.startBatchSteamGridScraping() },
                            enabled = !isScanning,
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Filled.CloudDownload, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp)); Text("全庫網路資材補充", fontSize = 11.sp)
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (importStatus.isNotBlank()) {
                    Text(importStatus, color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp)
                }
            }
        }

        // Custom Collections & Tags Management Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp)) {
                Text("🏷️ 自訂收藏集與分類標籤管理", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                Text("你可以自由建立如「中文漢化」、「童年神作」、「必玩JRPG」等標籤，在遊戲館中為喜愛的遊戲歸類！", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(14.dp))

                // Add new collection input
                Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = newCollectionName,
                        onValueChange = { newCollectionName = it },
                        placeholder = { Text("輸入新收藏集標籤名稱...", color = theme.textSecondary) },
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                        colors = colors,
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                        singleLine = true
                    )
                    SylphoraButton(
                        onClick = {
                            if (newCollectionName.isNotBlank()) {
                                viewModel.createCollection(newCollectionName)
                                newCollectionName = ""
                                Toast.makeText(context, "已新增收藏集！", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }
                        },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.height(52.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.Add, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.background)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                        Text("新增", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

                Text("現有收藏集清單", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    if (customCollections.isEmpty()) {
                        Text("目前尚未建立任何自訂收藏集標籤。", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    } else {
                        customCollections.forEach { col ->
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                                    .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                                    .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                                    .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                            ) {
                                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                                    Text("🏷️", fontSize = 18.sp)
                                    Text(col, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                                }
                                SylphoraIconButton(onClick = { viewModel.deleteCollection(col) }) {
                                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Delete, contentDescription = "刪除", tint = Color(0xFFEF4444))
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ui.screens.settings

import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyRow
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.TravelExplore
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.example.GameViewModel
import com.example.ui.theme.LocalPegasusTheme

@Composable
fun SettingsResearchSection(viewModel: GameViewModel) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val repo = viewModel.settingsRepository

    var searchMode by remember { mutableStateOf(repo.getWebSearchMode()) }
    var searchProvider by remember { mutableStateOf(repo.getWebSearchProvider()) }
    var apiKey by remember { mutableStateOf(repo.getWebSearchApiKey()) }
    var customEndpoint by remember { mutableStateOf(repo.getWebSearchCustomEndpoint().orEmpty()) }

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp)) {
        // Section Overview
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.TravelExplore, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent)
                    Text("🌐 考據與網路檢索設定 (Research & Web Search)", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
                Text(
                    "獨立控制 Web 搜尋服務與歷史資料庫，作為遊戲考古、版本比對與系列沿革的查證工具。",
                    color = theme.textSecondary,
                    fontSize = 13.sp
                )
            }
        }

        // Web Search Mode & Provider Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().settingsAnchor("search_mode").settingsAnchor("search_provider").settingsAnchor("research_autofill"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(18.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
                Text("1. 搜尋觸發模式", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = searchMode == "SMART_SEARCH",
                        onClick = {
                            searchMode = "SMART_SEARCH"
                            repo.saveWebSearchMode("SMART_SEARCH")
                            Toast.makeText(context, "已設為 Smart Search 智慧模式", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        },
                        label = { Text("● Smart Search", fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
                    )
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = searchMode == "ALWAYS_SEARCH",
                        onClick = {
                            searchMode = "ALWAYS_SEARCH"
                            repo.saveWebSearchMode("ALWAYS_SEARCH")
                            Toast.makeText(context, "已設為 Always Search 模式", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        },
                        label = { Text("Always Search", fontSize = 12.sp) }
                    )
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = searchMode == "SEARCH_OFF",
                        onClick = {
                            searchMode = "SEARCH_OFF"
                            repo.saveWebSearchMode("SEARCH_OFF")
                            Toast.makeText(context, "已關閉 Web Search", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        },
                        label = { Text("Search Off", fontSize = 12.sp) }
                    )
                }
                Text(
                    when (searchMode) {
                        "SMART_SEARCH" -> "「需要確認資訊、冷門遊戲或最新發售消息時自動進行網路查證；常識問題不發起搜尋。」"
                        "ALWAYS_SEARCH" -> "「所有適合搜尋的問題一律強制進行網路查證。」"
                        else -> "「完全停用 Web Search，純使用 AI 模型內建知識與本地遊戲庫。」"
                    },
                    color = theme.accent,
                    fontSize = 12.sp
                )

                HorizontalDivider(color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))

                Text("2. Web Search Provider", color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    val providers = listOf("DUCKDUCKGO", "BRAVE", "BING", "GOOGLE_CUSTOM", "CUSTOM")
                    items(providers, key = { it }) { p ->
                        FilterChip(
                            selected = searchProvider == p,
                            onClick = {
                                searchProvider = p
                                repo.saveWebSearchProvider(p)
                            },
                            label = { Text(p, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = if (searchProvider == p) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal) }
                        )
                    }
                }

                if (searchProvider in listOf("BRAVE", "BING", "GOOGLE_CUSTOM", "CUSTOM")) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = apiKey,
                        onValueChange = {
                            apiKey = it
                            repo.saveWebSearchApiKey(it)
                        },
                        label = { Text("Search API Key / Subscription Token") },
                        placeholder = { Text("貼上對應的 Web Search API Key") },
                        singleLine = true,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )
                }

                if (searchProvider in listOf("GOOGLE_CUSTOM", "CUSTOM")) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = customEndpoint,
                        onValueChange = {
                            customEndpoint = it
                            repo.saveWebSearchCustomEndpoint(it)
                        },
                        label = { Text(if (searchProvider == "GOOGLE_CUSTOM") "Engine ID (CX)" else "Custom Search Endpoint URL") },
                        placeholder = { Text(if (searchProvider == "GOOGLE_CUSTOM") "例如: 0123456789:abc..." else "https://search.example.com/api") },
                        singleLine = true,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            anchorId = "force_rematch"
        ),
        SettingsSearchEntry(
            id = "maintenance.pegasus_export",
            title = "Pegasus Frontend 元資料匯出 (Pegasus Metadata Export)",
            description = "匯出相容 Pegasus Frontend 的 metadata.pegasus.txt 與遊戲庫設定檔案",
            keywords = listOf("pegasus", "export", "backup", "metadata.txt", "匯出", "備份"),
            sectionName = "進階維護",
            targetTabId = 7,
            anchorId = "pegasus_export"
        ),
        SettingsSearchEntry(
            id = "maintenance.db_reset",
            title = "資料庫快取與重設 (Database Cache & Reset)",
            description = "清除快取的 AI 考據知識、重整 Room 資料庫或完整重設遊戲庫",
            keywords = listOf("database", "reset", "clear", "cache", "clean", "重設", "清除", "資料庫", "快取"),
            sectionName = "進階維護",
            targetTabId = 7,
            anchorId = "db_reset"
        ),

        // Tab 8: 關於 (About)
        SettingsSearchEntry(
            id = "about.version",
            title = "版本與系統架構 (Version & Architecture)",
            description = "Sylphora 復古主機遊戲前端版本、Kotlin Compose 架構與開源授權",
            keywords = listOf("about", "version", "architecture", "build", "credits", "license", "版本", "架構", "關於", "致謝"),
            sectionName = "關於",
            targetTabId = 8,
            anchorId = "about_info"
        )
    )

    fun search(query: String): List<SettingsSearchEntry> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()
        val q = query.trim().lowercase()
        val tokens = q.split(" ", "-", "_", ".").filter { it.isNotBlank() }

        val scored = entries.mapNotNull { entry ->
            val titleLower = entry.title.lowercase()
            val descLower = entry.description.lowercase()
            val sectionLower = entry.sectionName.lowercase()
            val keywordsJoined = entry.keywords.joinToString(" ").lowercase()

            var score = 0

            // 1. Exact Title Match
            if (titleLower == q) {
                score += 1000
            } else if (titleLower.startsWith(q)) {
                score += 800
            } else if (titleLower.contains(q)) {
                score += 600
            }

            // 2. Keyword exact / prefix / contains match
            for (kw in entry.keywords) {
                val kwLower = kw.lowercase()
                if (kwLower == q) {
                    score += 500
                    break
                } else if (kwLower.startsWith(q)) {
                    score += 350
                } else if (kwLower.contains(q)) {
                    score += 200
                }
            }

            // 3. Description match
            if (descLower.contains(q)) {
                score += 150
            }

            // 4. Section match
            if (sectionLower.contains(q)) {
                score += 100
            }

            // 5. Multi-token partial match
            if (tokens.size > 1) {
                val matchedTokens = tokens.count { token ->
                    titleLower.contains(token) || descLower.contains(token) || keywordsJoined.contains(token)
                }
                score += matchedTokens * 80
            }

            if (score > 0) {
                entry to score
            } else {
                null
            }
        }

        return scored.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<Pair<SettingsSearchEntry, Int>> { it.second }
                .thenBy { it.first.targetTabId }
                .thenBy { it.first.title }
        ).map { it.first }
    }
}

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {

                        onClick = { viewModel.startOneClickMaintenance(dryRun = true) },
                        enabled = !isScanning && !isBatchScraping
                    ) {
                        Text("模擬執行 (Dry Run)")
                    }
                }

                if (maintenanceStatus.isNotBlank()) {
                    Text("維護狀態：$maintenanceStatus", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ui.theme

import androidx.compose.animation.core.FastOutLinearInEasing
import androidx.compose.animation.core.RepeatMode
import androidx.compose.animation.core.infiniteRepeatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.rememberInfiniteTransition
import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween
import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

@Composable
fun CrtOverlay(
    enabled: Boolean,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    scanlineIntensity: Float = 0.12f,
    vignetteIntensity: Float = 0.30f
) {
    if (!enabled) return

    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "crt_breath")
    val breath by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.95f,
        targetValue = 1.05f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(3000, easing = FastOutLinearInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "crt_breath_intensity"
    )

    Canvas(modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val width = size.width
        val height = size.height
        val scanlineSpacing = 3.dp.toPx()
        var y = 0f
        while (y < height) {
            drawLine(
                color = Color.Black.copy(alpha = scanlineIntensity * breath),
                start = Offset(0f, y),
                end = Offset(width, y),
                strokeWidth = 1f
            )
            y += scanlineSpacing
        }

        val center = Offset(width / 2f, height / 2f)
        drawRect(
            brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                colors = listOf(
                    Color.Transparent,
                    Color.Black.copy(alpha = vignetteIntensity * 0.5f),
                    Color.Black.copy(alpha = vignetteIntensity)
                ),
                center = center,
                radius = maxOf(width, height) * 0.75f
            )
        )
    }
}

    fun getStyle(platform: String): PlatformStyle {
        val normalized = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform)
        val key = normalized.uppercase().replace(" ", "").replace("-", "")
        return styles[key] ?: styles[normalized.uppercase()] ?: styles[platform.uppercase().replace(" ", "").replace("-", "")] ?: PlatformStyle(
            name = platform.ifBlank { "Console" },
            brand = "SYSTEM",
            primaryColor = Color(0xFF455A64),
            secondaryColor = Color(0xFF263238),
            icon = Icons.Filled.SportsEsports,
            iconEmoji = "🎮",
            bannerUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libretro/RetroArch/master/media/assets/xmb/monochrome/png/RetroArch.png",
            libretroRepo = null
        )
    }

    fun getFallbackBoxartUrl(platform: String, title: String): String? {
        val style = getStyle(platform)
        val repo = style.libretroRepo ?: return null
        val clean = title
            .replace('&', '_')
            .replace('/', '_')
            .replace('\\', '_')
            .replace(':', '_')
            .replace('?', '_')
            .trim()
        val encRepo = URLEncoder.encode(repo, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20")
        val encTitle = URLEncoder.encode("$clean.png", "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20")
        return "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libretro-thumbnails/$encRepo/master/Named_Boxarts/$encTitle"
    }

    /**
     * Phase 3 Platform Icon 4-tier fallback hierarchy:
     * 1. Local Asset folder icon (_platforms/{platform}.png or {platform}/icon.png)
     * 2. Project Drawable resource (ic_platform_{platform} or ic_{platform})
     * 3. Remote Platform Icon (bannerUrl)
     * 4. Generic Vector Icon (style.icon)
     */
    private val iconCache = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Any>()
    private val fetchMutexes = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex>()

    fun getFastFallbackIconModel(context: android.content.Context, platform: String): Any {
        val style = getStyle(platform)
        val canonical = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform).lowercase()

        // 2. Project Drawable resource check
        val resId = context.resources.getIdentifier("ic_platform_$canonical", "drawable", context.packageName).let {
            if (it != 0) it else context.resources.getIdentifier("ic_$canonical", "drawable", context.packageName)
        }
        if (resId != 0) return resId

        // 3. Remote Icon URL
        if (style.bannerUrl.isNotBlank()) return style.bannerUrl

        // 4. Default Generic Vector Icon
        return style.icon
    }

    suspend fun getPlatformIconModelAsync(context: android.content.Context, platform: String, assetRootUriStr: String? = null): Any {
        val canonical = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform).lowercase()
        val effectiveAssetRoot = assetRootUriStr ?: try {
            com.example.settings.SettingsRepository(context).getAssetRootUri()
        } catch (_: Exception) { null }

        val cacheKey = "${canonical}_${effectiveAssetRoot ?: "null"}"
        iconCache[cacheKey]?.let { return it }

        val mutex = fetchMutexes.getOrPut(cacheKey) { kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex() }
        
        return mutex.withLock {
            iconCache[cacheKey]?.let { return@withLock it }
            val result = kotlinx.coroutines.withContext(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.IO) {
                resolvePlatformIconModelBlocking(context, platform, effectiveAssetRoot)
            }
            iconCache[cacheKey] = result
            result
        }
    }

    private fun resolvePlatformIconModelBlocking(context: android.content.Context, platform: String, effectiveAssetRoot: String?): Any {
        val style = getStyle(platform)
        val canonical = PlatformRegistry.normalizePlatform(platform).lowercase()

        // 1. Description icons check (e.g. description/icons/psp.png)
        try {
            val csvService = com.example.metadata.MetadataCsvService(context)
            val descRoot = csvService.resolveDescriptionRoot(null)
            if (descRoot != null) {
                val iconsDir = descRoot.listFiles().firstOrNull { it.isDirectory && it.name.equals("icons", ignoreCase = true) }
                if (iconsDir != null) {
                    val localIcon = iconsDir.listFiles().firstOrNull { it.isFile && it.name?.substringBeforeLast('.').equals(canonical, ignoreCase = true) }
                    if (localIcon != null) return localIcon.uri.toString()
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}

        // 1b. Local Asset folder check
        if (!effectiveAssetRoot.isNullOrBlank()) {
            try {
                val root = androidx.documentfile.provider.DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, android.net.Uri.parse(effectiveAssetRoot))
                if (root != null) {
                    val platDir = root.listFiles().firstOrNull { it.isDirectory && (it.name.equals(platform, ignoreCase = true) || it.name.equals(canonical, ignoreCase = true)) }
                    if (platDir != null) {
                        val localIcon = platDir.listFiles().firstOrNull { it.isFile && (it.name.equals("icon.png", ignoreCase = true) || it.name.equals("logo.png", ignoreCase = true)) }
                        if (localIcon != null) return localIcon.uri.toString()
                    }
                    val platGroupDir = root.listFiles().firstOrNull { it.isDirectory && it.name.equals("_platforms", ignoreCase = true) }
                    if (platGroupDir != null) {
                        val localGroupIcon = platGroupDir.listFiles().firstOrNull { it.isFile && it.name?.substringBeforeLast('.').equals(canonical, ignoreCase = true) }
                        if (localGroupIcon != null) return localGroupIcon.uri.toString()
                    }
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }

        // 2. Project Drawable resource check
        val resId = context.resources.getIdentifier("ic_platform_$canonical", "drawable", context.packageName).let {
            if (it != 0) it else context.resources.getIdentifier("ic_$canonical", "drawable", context.packageName)
        }
        if (resId != 0) return resId

        // 3. Remote Icon URL
        if (style.bannerUrl.isNotBlank()) return style.bannerUrl

        // 4. Default Generic Vector Icon
        return style.icon
    }
}

/**
 * Universal Gorgeous Game Art Card:
 * 1. Shows coverPath if loaded
 * 2. If null, tries online Libretro boxart fallback
 * 3. If none, renders a rich custom retro physical cartridge / disc art with console color badge and title
 */
@Composable
fun UniversalGameArt(
    game: GameEntity,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    contentScale: ContentScale = ContentScale.Crop
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val style = remember(game.platform) { PlatformVisuals.getStyle(game.platform) }
    val isPlatformSelector = game.platform == "PLATFORM_SELECTOR"

    if (isPlatformSelector) {
        PlatformBannerCard(
            platform = game.title,
            gameCountText = game.publisher ?: "",
            modifier = modifier
        )
    } else {
        val isAndroidApp = game.platform.equals("Android", ignoreCase = true) ||
                game.romPath.startsWith("app://") ||
                game.coverPath?.startsWith("app://") == true

        val androidIcon = remember(game.romPath, game.coverPath, isAndroidApp) {
            if (isAndroidApp) {
                val pkg = (game.coverPath?.removePrefix("app://")?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                    ?: game.romPath.removePrefix("app://")).trim()
                try {
                    context.packageManager.getApplicationIcon(pkg)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    null
                }
            } else null
        }

        if (androidIcon != null) {
            Box(
                modifier = modifier
                    .background(Color(0xFF1E1B2E))
                    .padding(8.dp),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Image(
                    painter = rememberDrawablePainter(drawable = androidIcon),
                    contentDescription = game.title,
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                )
            }
        } else {
            var imageLoadFailed by remember(game.id, game.coverPath, game.iconPath, game.backgroundPath, game.screenshotPath) { mutableStateOf(false) }
            val fallbackUrl = remember(game.platform, game.title) {
                PlatformVisuals.getFallbackBoxartUrl(game.platform, game.title)
            }
            val targetImageModel = when {
                !game.iconPath.isNullOrBlank() && !game.iconPath.startsWith("app://") -> game.iconPath
                !game.coverPath.isNullOrBlank() && !game.coverPath.startsWith("app://") -> game.coverPath
                !game.backgroundPath.isNullOrBlank() -> game.backgroundPath
                !game.screenshotPath.isNullOrBlank() -> game.screenshotPath
                !imageLoadFailed && !fallbackUrl.isNullOrBlank() -> fallbackUrl
                else -> null
            }

            if (targetImageModel != null) {
                AsyncImage(
                    model = targetImageModel,
                    contentDescription = game.title,
                    contentScale = contentScale,
                    onError = { imageLoadFailed = true },
                    modifier = modifier
                )
            } else {
                // Render styled retro physical cartridge / disc artwork
                RetroCartridgeArt(game = game, style = style, modifier = modifier)
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Renders a full native retro physical cartridge card when no cover art is available
 */
@Composable
fun RetroCartridgeArt(
    game: GameEntity,
    style: PlatformStyle,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .background(
                Brush.linearGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        Color(0xFF1E222A),
                        Color(0xFF12141A),
                        style.primaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.35f)
                    )
                )
            )
            .border(1.dp, style.secondaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.40f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .padding(6.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
        ) {
            // Top Header: Brand Tag
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(3.dp))
                    .background(style.primaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.85f))
                    .padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = style.brand,
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    letterSpacing = 1.sp
                )
                Text(
                    text = game.platform.uppercase(),
                    color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.9f),
                    fontSize = 8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                )
            }

            // Center: Game Icon / Sticker
            Column(
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .weight(1f)
                    .padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
            ) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = style.icon,
                    contentDescription = null,
                    tint = style.secondaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.9f),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp)
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text(
                    text = game.title,
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                    maxLines = 3,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    lineHeight = 13.sp
                )
            }

            // Bottom: Metallic contact pins / seal of quality
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(6.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(1.dp))
                    .background(
                        Brush.horizontalGradient(
                            listOf(
                                Color(0xFFD4AF37),
                                Color(0xFFFFDF73),
                                Color(0xFFB8860B),
                                Color(0xFFFFDF73),
                                Color(0xFFD4AF37)
                            )
                        )
                    )
            ) {}
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Platform Banner Card shown on the Home Screen when selecting a platform
 */
@Composable
fun PlatformBannerCard(
    platform: String,
    gameCountText: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    customImageUrl: String? = null,
    assetRootUriStr: String? = null
) {
    val context = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
    val style = remember(platform) { PlatformVisuals.getStyle(platform) }
    
    var iconModel by remember(platform, customImageUrl, assetRootUriStr) {
        androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf<Any>(
            if (!customImageUrl.isNullOrBlank() && !customImageUrl.contains("Video_Game_Controller_Icon.svg")) {
                customImageUrl
            } else {
                PlatformVisuals.getFastFallbackIconModel(context, platform)
            }
        )
    }

    androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(platform, customImageUrl, assetRootUriStr) {
        if (customImageUrl.isNullOrBlank() || customImageUrl.contains("Video_Game_Controller_Icon.svg")) {
            iconModel = PlatformVisuals.getPlatformIconModelAsync(context, platform, assetRootUriStr)
        }
    }

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .background(
                Brush.linearGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        style.primaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.95f),
                        style.secondaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.75f),
                        Color(0xFF0E131F)
                    )
                )
            )
            .border(1.5.dp, style.secondaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.8f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        // Background Logo Image or Vector Icon Fallback
        val currentIconModel = iconModel
        if (currentIconModel is androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector) {
            Icon(
                imageVector = currentIconModel,
                contentDescription = style.name,
                tint = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.35f),
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .padding(24.dp)
            )
        } else {
            AsyncImage(
                model = currentIconModel,
                contentDescription = style.name,
                contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .padding(16.dp)
                    .drawBehind {
                        drawRect(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.20f))
                    }
            )
        }

        // Overlay Content
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(12.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.Start
        ) {
            // Brand & Icon Chip
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                    .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.45f))
                    .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 3.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
            ) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = style.icon,
                    contentDescription = null,
                    tint = Color.White,
                    modifier = Modifier.size(12.dp)
                )
                Text(
                    text = style.brand,
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 9.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    letterSpacing = 1.sp
                )
            }

            // Platform Title & ROM Count
            Column {
                Text(
                    text = style.name,
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 18.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )
                if (gameCountText.isNotBlank()) {
                    Text(
                        text = gameCountText,
                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Sylphora Core Color Palette Constants (Exact Variant C Values)
val SylphoraPrimaryCyan = Color(0xFFE0F7FA)
val SylphoraCelestialPurple = Color(0xFFC084FC)
val SylphoraDeepCosmic = Color(0xFF0C0F10)
val SylphoraDeepCosmicDark = Color(0xFF050812)
val SylphoraPurpleGlow = Color(0xFFC084FC)

// Sylphora Light Mode Palette (白銀精靈 / Silver Spirit)
val SylphoraLightBackground = Color(0xFFF1F6F8)

/**
 * Animated Dense Stardust & Starfield Canvas Particle System
 * Faithful 1:1 translation of HTML `<canvas class="shader-canvas-dense">`
 * Supports both Dark (Deep Cosmic Void) and Light (Silver Ethereal Dawn) modes.
 */
private data class DenseStardustParticle(
    var x: Float,
    var y: Float,
    var radius: Float,
    val speedX: Float,
    val speedY: Float,
    val isPurple: Boolean,
    val baseAlpha: Float,
    val phaseOffset: Float
)

@Composable
fun SylphoraCosmicStarfield(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    particleCount: Int = 320,
    isDark: Boolean = true
) {
    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "StarfieldDensePulse")
    val time by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = 6.283f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(6000, easing = LinearEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
        ),
        label = "time"
    )

    val particles = remember {
        List(particleCount) {
            DenseStardustParticle(
                x = Random.nextFloat(),
                y = Random.nextFloat(),
                radius = Random.nextFloat() * 1.8f + 0.6f,
                speedX = (Random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.0003f,
                speedY = -(Random.nextFloat() * 0.0005f + 0.0001f),
                isPurple = Random.nextFloat() > 0.40f,
                baseAlpha = Random.nextFloat() * 0.5f + 0.2f,
                phaseOffset = Random.nextFloat() * 6.283f
            )
        }
    }

    Canvas(modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        if (w <= 0f || h <= 0f) return@Canvas

        if (isDark) {
            // Base Dark Cosmic Void (#050812)
            drawRect(color = SylphoraDeepCosmicDark)

            // Cosmic Overlay Purple: radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 0%, rgba(15, 10, 30, 0.7) 60%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95) 100%)
            drawRect(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        Color.Transparent,
                        Color(0xFF0F0A1E).copy(alpha = 0.70f),
                        Color(0xFF020408).copy(alpha = 0.96f)
                    ),
                    center = Offset(w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f),
                    radius = (w * 0.75f).coerceAtLeast(10f)
                )
            )

            // Subtle gradient: from-purple-900/10 via-transparent to-[#e0f7fa]/5
            drawRect(
                brush = Brush.linearGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        Color(0xFF581C87).copy(alpha = 0.12f),
                        Color.Transparent,
                        SylphoraPrimaryCyan.copy(alpha = 0.06f)
                    ),
                    start = Offset(0f, h),
                    end = Offset(w, 0f)
                )
            )
        } else {
            // Base Light Silver Dawn (#F1F6F8)
            drawRect(color = SylphoraLightBackground)

            // Ethereal Morning Mist overlay
            drawRect(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                        Color(0xFFE0F2F1).copy(alpha = 0.50f),
                        Color(0xFFDCECEF).copy(alpha = 0.90f)
                    ),
                    center = Offset(w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f),
                    radius = (w * 0.85f).coerceAtLeast(10f)
                )
            )

            // Subtle silver pastel aura
            drawRect(
                brush = Brush.linearGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        Color(0xFFE1BEE7).copy(alpha = 0.15f),
                        Color.Transparent,
                        Color(0xFFB2EBF2).copy(alpha = 0.20f)
                    ),
                    start = Offset(0f, h),
                    end = Offset(w, 0f)
                )
            )
        }

        // Draw Twinkling Stardust Particles (Cyan + Purple upwards drift with pulse)
        for (p in particles) {
            p.x = (p.x + p.speedX + 1f) % 1f
            p.y = (p.y + p.speedY + 1f) % 1f

            val pulse = (kotlin.math.sin(time + p.phaseOffset) + 1f) * 0.5f
            val rad = (p.radius * (0.8f + 0.4f * pulse)).dp.toPx()
            val alpha = (p.baseAlpha * (0.6f + 0.4f * pulse)).coerceIn(0.15f, 0.95f)
            val color = if (isDark) {
                if (p.isPurple) SylphoraCelestialPurple.copy(alpha = alpha) else SylphoraPrimaryCyan.copy(alpha = alpha)
            } else {
                if (p.isPurple) Color(0xFF7E57C2).copy(alpha = alpha) else Color(0xFF00838F).copy(alpha = alpha)
            }

            drawCircle(
                color = color,
                radius = rad,
                center = Offset(p.x * w, p.y * h)
            )
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Sylphora Variant C Spirit Guardian Silhouette Backdrop
 * Centered deeply integrated silhouette with celestial aura, subtle floating & purple pulse glow
 */
@Composable
fun SylphoraSpiritGuardianBackdrop(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    scale: Float = 1.15f,
    isDark: Boolean = true
) {
    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "GuardianPulseGlow")
    val glowAlpha by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.35f,
        targetValue = 0.75f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(3600, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "glowAlpha"
    )
    val floatY by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = -8f,
        targetValue = 8f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(4500, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "floatY"
    )

    val auraPurple = if (isDark) SylphoraCelestialPurple else Color(0xFF7E57C2)
    val auraCyan = if (isDark) SylphoraPrimaryCyan else Color(0xFF00838F)

    Box(
        modifier = modifier.scale(scale),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        // 1. Broad ethereal purple backlight aura
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(480.dp)
                .background(
                    brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                        colors = listOf(
                            auraPurple.copy(alpha = if (isDark) 0.38f * glowAlpha else 0.28f * glowAlpha),
                            auraPurple.copy(alpha = if (isDark) 0.15f * glowAlpha else 0.10f * glowAlpha),
                            Color.Transparent
                        ),
                        radius = 480f
                    ),
                    shape = CircleShape
                )
        )

        // 2. Inner cyan/purple spirit core radiance
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(280.dp)
                .background(
                    brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                        colors = listOf(
                            auraCyan.copy(alpha = if (isDark) 0.28f * glowAlpha else 0.22f * glowAlpha),
                            auraPurple.copy(alpha = if (isDark) 0.18f * glowAlpha else 0.12f * glowAlpha),
                            Color.Transparent
                        ),
                        radius = 280f
                    ),
                    shape = CircleShape
                )
        )

        // 3. Floating Guardian silhouette image
        Image(
            painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.sylphiette_silhouette),
            contentDescription = "Spirit Guardian Silhouette",
            contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxHeight()
                .offset(y = floatY.dp)
                .alpha(if (isDark) 0.38f else 0.30f)
        )
    }
}

/**
 * Variant C Museum Side-Scrolling Game Card
 * 220px x 140px with bottom gradient accent line and subtle glow
 */
@Composable
fun SylphoraMuseumCard(
    game: GameEntity,
    isSelected: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    isDark: Boolean = true
) {
    val cardShape = RoundedCornerShape(SylphoraTokens.Radius.md)

    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "CardGlow")
    val pulseGlow by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.40f,
        targetValue = 0.80f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(3000, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "pulseGlow"
    )

    val cardBg = if (isDark) {
        if (isSelected) Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.04f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.02f)
    } else {
        if (isSelected) Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.95f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.80f)
    }

    val cardBorder = if (isDark) {
        if (isSelected) SylphoraCelestialPurple.copy(alpha = 0.30f * pulseGlow + 0.15f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f)
    } else {
        if (isSelected) Color(0xFF00838F).copy(alpha = 0.60f) else Color(0xFFB2DFDB).copy(alpha = 0.60f)
    }

    val glowColor = if (isDark) SylphoraCelestialPurple else Color(0xFF00838F)

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .width(220.dp)
            .height(140.dp)
            .clip(cardShape)
            .background(cardBg)
            .border(
                width = if (isSelected) 1.5.dp else 1.dp,
                color = cardBorder,
                shape = cardShape
            )
            .shadow(
                elevation = if (isSelected) 20.dp else 4.dp,
                shape = cardShape,
                ambientColor = if (isSelected) glowColor.copy(alpha = 0.15f * pulseGlow) else Color.Transparent,
                spotColor = if (isSelected) glowColor.copy(alpha = 0.25f * pulseGlow) else Color.Transparent
            )
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
    ) {
        // Optional Cover image with soft transparency
        val cover = game.coverPath ?: game.backgroundPath
        if (!cover.isNullOrBlank()) {
            AsyncImage(
                model = cover,
                contentDescription = game.title,
                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .alpha(if (isDark) (if (isSelected) 0.40f else 0.20f) else (if (isSelected) 0.50f else 0.30f))
            )
        }

        // Inner soft overlay
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(
                    Brush.verticalGradient(
                        colors = if (isDark) {
                            listOf(
                                Color.Transparent,
                                SylphoraDeepCosmicDark.copy(alpha = 0.65f),
                                SylphoraDeepCosmicDark.copy(alpha = 0.95f)
                            )
                        } else {
                            listOf(
                                Color.Transparent,
                                Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.60f),
                                Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.95f)
                            )
                        }
                    )
                )
        )

        // Bottom Glow Accent (active glow)
        if (isSelected) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(48.dp)
                    .background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(
                            listOf(Color.Transparent, glowColor.copy(alpha = (if (isDark) 0.20f else 0.15f) * pulseGlow))
                        )
                    )
            )
            // Bottom gradient highlight line
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(2.dp)
                    .background(
                        Brush.horizontalGradient(
                            listOf(
                                Color.Transparent,
                                glowColor.copy(alpha = 0.60f * pulseGlow + 0.20f),
                                Color.Transparent
                            )
                        )
                    )
            )
        } else {
            // Subtle inactive bottom line
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(1.5.dp)
                    .background(
                        Brush.horizontalGradient(
                            listOf(
                                Color.Transparent,
                                glowColor.copy(alpha = if (isDark) 0.20f else 0.15f),
                                Color.Transparent
                            )
                        )
                    )
            )
        }

        // Card Content Title: uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-light
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.BottomStart)
                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 14.dp)
        ) {
            Text(
                text = game.title.uppercase(),
                color = if (isDark) SylphoraPrimaryCyan else SylphoraLightTextMain,
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontWeight = if (isDark) FontWeight.Light else FontWeight.Medium,
                letterSpacing = 2.sp,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                modifier = Modifier.alpha(if (isSelected) 0.95f else 0.60f)
            )
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Unified Sylphora Material Button family using SylphoraTokens
 */
@Composable
fun SylphoraButton(
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    shape: Shape = RoundedCornerShape(SylphoraTokens.Radius.md),
    border: BorderStroke? = null,
    colors: ButtonColors? = null,
    contentPadding: PaddingValues = ButtonDefaults.ContentPadding,
    content: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val effectiveColors = colors ?: ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
        containerColor = theme.accent,
        contentColor = theme.background
    )
    Button(
        onClick = onClick,
        modifier = modifier,
        enabled = enabled,
        shape = shape,
        border = border,
        colors = effectiveColors,
        contentPadding = contentPadding,
        content = content
    )
}

@Composable
fun SylphoraOutlinedButton(
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    shape: Shape = RoundedCornerShape(SylphoraTokens.Radius.md),
    border: BorderStroke? = null,
    colors: ButtonColors? = null,
    contentPadding: PaddingValues = ButtonDefaults.ContentPadding,
    content: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val effectiveBorder = border ?: BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
    val effectiveColors = colors ?: ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(
        contentColor = theme.textMain
    )
    SylphoraButton(
        onClick = onClick,
        modifier = modifier,
        enabled = enabled,
        shape = shape,
        border = effectiveBorder,
        colors = effectiveColors,
        contentPadding = contentPadding,
        content = content
    )
}

@Composable
fun P3ExplorerScreen(
    viewModel: GameViewModel,
    onLaunchGame: (GameEntity) -> Unit
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val allGames by viewModel.allGames.collectAsState()
    val assetRootUri by viewModel.assetRootUri.collectAsState()
    var searchQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var debouncedQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        snapshotFlow { searchQuery }
            .collectLatest { q ->
                delay(250)
                debouncedQuery = q
            }
    }
    var selectedPlatform by remember { mutableStateOf("ALL") }

    val platforms = remember(allGames) {
        listOf("ALL") + allGames.map { it.platform }.distinct().sorted()
    }

    val filteredGames = remember(allGames, debouncedQuery, selectedPlatform) {
        allGames.filter { game ->
            val matchPlat = selectedPlatform == "ALL" || game.platform.equals(selectedPlatform, ignoreCase = true)
            val matchQuery = debouncedQuery.isBlank() || game.title.contains(debouncedQuery, ignoreCase = true) || game.platform.contains(debouncedQuery, ignoreCase = true)
            matchPlat && matchQuery
        }
    }

    androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            // Top Banner / Status Card
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                    .background(Brush.horizontalGradient(listOf(theme.surface, theme.cardStart)))
                    .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                    .padding(16.dp)
            ) {
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    Text("📡 P3 資材與元資料探索器", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Text(
                        text = if (assetRootUri.isNullOrBlank()) "目前資材根目錄：預設本機內部儲存" else "本機資材根目錄：$assetRootUri",
                        color = theme.textSecondary,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                    )
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
                        Text("收錄作品: ${allGames.size} 款", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium)
                        Text("簡介同步: ${allGames.count { !it.description.isNullOrBlank() }} 款", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        item {
            // Search field
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = searchQuery,
                onValueChange = { searchQuery = it },
                placeholder = { Text("搜尋遊戲標題或檔名...", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp) },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
                    focusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
                    unfocusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
                    focusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                    unfocusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.3f),
                    focusedIndicatorColor = theme.accent,
                    unfocusedIndicatorColor = Color.Transparent
                ),
                singleLine = true
            )
        }

        item {
            // Platform Filter Row
            androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                items(platforms.size, key = { platforms[it] }) { idx ->
                    val plat = platforms[idx]
                    val isSelected = plat == selectedPlatform
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                            .background(if (isSelected) theme.accent else theme.surface)
                            .clickable { selectedPlatform = plat }
                            .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = plat,
                            color = if (isSelected) theme.background else theme.textMain,
                            fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                            fontSize = 12.sp
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        items(filteredGames.size, key = { filteredGames[it].id }) { idx ->
            val game = filteredGames[idx]
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                    .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                    .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                    .padding(12.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
            ) {
                AsyncImage(
                    model = game.coverPath ?: game.backgroundPath ?: "file:///android_asset/default_box.png",
                    contentDescription = game.title,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(56.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface),
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
                )

                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                                .background(theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f))
                                .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(game.platform, color = theme.accent, fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        }
                        Text(
                            text = if (!game.description.isNullOrBlank()) "✓ 已包含簡介" else "無簡介",
                            color = if (!game.description.isNullOrBlank()) Color(0xFF10B981) else theme.textSecondary,
                            fontSize = 11.sp
                        )
                    }
                }

                SylphoraButton(
                    onClick = { onLaunchGame(game) },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(36.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("啟動", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ResearchCenterScreen(
    viewModel: GameViewModel,
    onLaunchGame: (GameEntity) -> Unit
) {
    val theme = LocalPegasusTheme.current
    val context = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
    val allGames by viewModel.allGames.collectAsState()
    val researchItems by viewModel.researchManager.researchItems.collectAsState()
    
    var selectedGameIndex by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var selectedTopicIndex by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var isStartingResearch by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val topics = viewModel.researchManager.defaultTopics
    val activeGame = allGames.getOrNull(selectedGameIndex)

    androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn(

        }

        item {
            Text("📋 研究報告歷程紀錄 (${researchItems.size})", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        }

        // Research Results List
        if (researchItems.isEmpty()) {

                Box(

        } else {
            items(researchItems.size, key = { researchItems[it].id }) { idx ->
