                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
                        .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                        .clickable { isExpanded = !isExpanded }
                        .padding(14.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                ) {
                    Row(
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text(item.gameTitle, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                            Text("${item.platform}  •  ${item.topicTitle}", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 12.sp)
                        }
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                .background(
                                    when (item.status) {
                                        "COMPLETED" -> Color(0xFF10B981).copy(alpha = 0.2f)
                                        "RUNNING" -> theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.2f)
                                        else -> Color(0xFFEF4444).copy(alpha = 0.2f)
                                    }
                                )
                                .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = when (item.status) {
                                    "COMPLETED" -> "考據完成"
                                    "RUNNING" -> "分析與 Web 檢索中..."
                                    else -> "考據失敗"
                                },
                                color = when (item.status) {
                                    "COMPLETED" -> Color(0xFF10B981)
                                    "RUNNING" -> theme.accent
                                    else -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
                                },
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                            )
                        }
                    }

                    if (!item.result.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        Text(
                            text = item.result,
                            color = theme.textSecondary,
                            fontSize = 13.sp,
                            lineHeight = 18.sp,
                            maxLines = if (isExpanded) Int.MAX_VALUE else 3,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                        )
                    }

                    if (item.status == "RUNNING") {
                        LinearProgressIndicator(
                            progress = item.progress,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp)),
                            color = theme.accent,
                            trackColor = theme.surface
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun SparkrainRainCanvas(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    isDark: Boolean = true
) {
    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "SparkrainRainMotion")
    val time by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = 6.283f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(4000, easing = LinearEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
        ),
        label = "rainTime"
    )

    val rainDrops = remember {
        List(80) {
            floatArrayOf(
                Random.nextFloat(), // x
                Random.nextFloat(), // y
                Random.nextFloat() * 26f + 12f, // length
                Random.nextFloat() * 0.016f + 0.009f, // speed
                Random.nextFloat() * 0.35f + 0.15f, // alpha
                Random.nextFloat() * 1.2f + 0.8f // width
            )
        }
    }

    val sparkles = remember {
        List(40) {
            floatArrayOf(
                Random.nextFloat(), // x
                Random.nextFloat(), // y
                Random.nextFloat() * 2.2f + 0.8f, // radius
                (Random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.0004f, // speedX
                -(Random.nextFloat() * 0.0006f + 0.0002f), // speedY
                Random.nextInt(3).toFloat(), // 0: purple, 1: cyan, 2: gold
                Random.nextFloat() * 0.6f + 0.2f, // baseAlpha
                Random.nextFloat() * 6.283f // phase
            )
        }
    }

    Canvas(modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        if (w <= 0f || h <= 0f) return@Canvas

        // Draw falling rain streaks (diagonal tilt ~12 degrees)
        for (drop in rainDrops) {
            drop[0] = (drop[0] + drop[3] * 0.28f + 1f) % 1f
            drop[1] = (drop[1] + drop[3] + 1f) % 1f

            val startX = drop[0] * w
            val startY = drop[1] * h
            val len = drop[2]
            val endX = startX + len * 0.28f
            val endY = startY + len

            val dropColor = if (isDark) {
                Color(0xFFE9D5FF).copy(alpha = drop[4])
            } else {
                Color(0xFF9333EA).copy(alpha = drop[4] * 0.7f)
            }

            drawLine(
                color = dropColor,
                start = Offset(startX, startY),
                end = Offset(endX, endY),
                strokeWidth = drop[5]
            )
        }

        // Draw soft bokeh firework particles / starlight
        for (sp in sparkles) {
            sp[0] = (sp[0] + sp[3] + 1f) % 1f
            sp[1] = (sp[1] + sp[4] + 1f) % 1f

            val pulse = (kotlin.math.sin(time + sp[7]) + 1f) * 0.5f
            val rad = sp[2] * (0.8f + 0.4f * pulse)
            val alpha = (sp[6] * (0.5f + 0.5f * pulse)).coerceIn(0.1f, 0.95f)

            val color = when (sp[5].toInt()) {
                0 -> Color(0xFFC084FC).copy(alpha = alpha) // Purple
                1 -> Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = alpha) // Cyan
                else -> Color(0xFFFDE047).copy(alpha = alpha) // Gold
            }

            drawCircle(
                color = color,
                radius = rad.dp.toPx(),
                center = Offset(sp[0] * w, sp[1] * h)
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ThemeErrorState(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    themeIndex: Int = 0,
    title: String,
    message: String
) {
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .background(Color.Red.copy(alpha = 0.15f))
            .border(1.dp, Color.Red)
            .padding(12.dp)
    ) {
        Column {
            Text(title, color = Color.Red, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            Text(message, color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp)
        }
    }
}

import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

object SylphoraTokens {
    object Spacing {
        val xs = 4.dp
        val sm = 8.dp
        val md = 16.dp
        val lg = 24.dp
        val xl = 36.dp
    }
    object Radius {
        val sm = 8.dp
        val md = 14.dp
        val lg = 20.dp
        val xl = 24.dp
    }
    object Motion {
        const val fast = 150
        const val med = 300
        const val slow = 500
    }
}

package com.example.ui.theme

val RetroMuseumDarkColorScheme: ColorScheme = darkColorScheme(
    primary = RetroMuseumDarkPrimary,
    onPrimary = RetroMuseumDarkOnPrimary,
    primaryContainer = RetroMuseumDarkPrimaryContainer,
    onPrimaryContainer = RetroMuseumDarkOnPrimaryContainer,
    secondary = RetroMuseumDarkSecondary,
    onSecondary = RetroMuseumDarkOnSecondary,
    secondaryContainer = RetroMuseumDarkSecondaryContainer,
    onSecondaryContainer = RetroMuseumDarkOnSecondaryContainer,
    tertiary = RetroMuseumDarkTertiary,
    onTertiary = RetroMuseumDarkOnTertiary,
    tertiaryContainer = RetroMuseumDarkTertiaryContainer,
    onTertiaryContainer = RetroMuseumDarkOnTertiaryContainer,
    background = RetroMuseumDarkBackground,
    onBackground = RetroMuseumDarkOnBackground,
    surface = RetroMuseumDarkSurface,
    onSurface = RetroMuseumDarkOnSurface,
    surfaceVariant = RetroMuseumDarkSurfaceVariant,
    onSurfaceVariant = RetroMuseumDarkOnSurfaceVariant,
    outline = RetroMuseumDarkOutline,
    outlineVariant = RetroMuseumDarkOutlineVariant
)

val RetroMuseumLightColorScheme: ColorScheme = lightColorScheme(
    primary = RetroMuseumLightPrimary,
    onPrimary = RetroMuseumLightOnPrimary,
    primaryContainer = RetroMuseumLightPrimaryContainer,
    onPrimaryContainer = RetroMuseumLightOnPrimaryContainer,
    secondary = RetroMuseumLightSecondary,
    onSecondary = RetroMuseumLightOnSecondary,
    secondaryContainer = RetroMuseumLightSecondaryContainer,
    onSecondaryContainer = RetroMuseumLightOnSecondaryContainer,
    tertiary = RetroMuseumLightTertiary,
    onTertiary = RetroMuseumLightOnTertiary,
    tertiaryContainer = RetroMuseumLightTertiaryContainer,
    onTertiaryContainer = RetroMuseumLightOnTertiaryContainer,
    background = RetroMuseumLightBackground,
    onBackground = RetroMuseumLightOnBackground,
    surface = RetroMuseumLightSurface,
    onSurface = RetroMuseumLightOnSurface,
    surfaceVariant = RetroMuseumLightSurfaceVariant,
    onSurfaceVariant = RetroMuseumLightOnSurfaceVariant,
    outline = RetroMuseumLightOutline,
    outlineVariant = RetroMuseumLightOutlineVariant
)

@Composable
fun MyApplicationTheme(
    darkTheme: Boolean = isSystemInDarkTheme(),
    dynamicColor: Boolean = false,
    content: @Composable () -> Unit,
) {
    val colorScheme = when {
        dynamicColor && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S -> {
            val context = LocalContext.current
            if (darkTheme) dynamicDarkColorScheme(context) else dynamicLightColorScheme(context)
        }
        darkTheme -> RetroMuseumDarkColorScheme
        else -> RetroMuseumLightColorScheme
    }

    MaterialTheme(
        colorScheme = colorScheme,
        typography = RetroMuseumTypography,
        content = content
    )
}

/**
 * Cyberpunk HUD Dedicated AI Subsystem (K.A.I.D.A. - Cyber Kinetic AI Companion)
 * Complete sci-fi command terminal with animated HUD diagnostics, interactive holographic robot companion,
 * direct neural query terminal, and instant game execution.
 */
@Composable
fun CyberpunkRobotCurator(viewModel: GameViewModel, theme: PegasusTheme) {
    val mono = FontFamily.Monospace
    val neonCyan = Color(0xFF00FFF0)
    val neonYellow = Color(0xFFFFE600)
    val neonPink = Color(0xFFFF0055)
    val matrixGreen = Color(0xFF00FF66)
    val darkHud = Color(0xFF050811)

    val chatMessages: List<ChatMessage> by viewModel.chatMessages.collectAsState()
    val isAgentTyping by viewModel.isAgentTyping.collectAsState()
    val allGames by viewModel.allGames.collectAsState()
    var inputMessage by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val listState = rememberLazyListState()
    val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    // Interactive robot states: 0: Normal/Idle, 1: Diagnostic/Hacking, 2: Combat/Surge
    var robotMode by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var robotVoiceLine by remember {
        mutableStateOf("SYS://KAIDA_V4.8 ONLINE. NEURAL LINK ACTIVE. WAITING FOR DIRECTIVE.")
    }

    LaunchedEffect(chatMessages.size, isAgentTyping) {
        if (chatMessages.isNotEmpty()) {
            listState.animateScrollToItem(chatMessages.lastIndex)
        }
        if (isAgentTyping) {
            robotVoiceLine = "NEURAL COGNITION RUNNING // SCANNING QUANTUM MATRIX..."
            robotMode = 1

/**
 * Animated Sci-Fi Canvas rendering of the Holographic Cyber Robot (K.A.I.D.A.)
 */
@Composable
private fun CyberRobotCanvas(mode: Int, isTyping: Boolean) {
    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "robot_anim")
    val pulse by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.85f,
        targetValue = 1.15f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(if (isTyping) 400 else 1200, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "pulse"
    )
    val scanY by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(2000, easing = LinearEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
        ),
        label = "scanline"
    )

    val primaryColor = when (mode) {
        1 -> Color(0xFFFF0055) // Combat Pink
        2 -> Color(0xFFFFE600) // Overclock Yellow
        else -> Color(0xFF00FFF0) // Cyber Cyan
    }

    androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val cx = w / 2f
        val cy = h / 2f - 10f

        // Draw Background Radar Circle Grid
        drawCircle(
            color = primaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.15f),
            radius = 70f * pulse,
            center = Offset(cx, cy),
            style = Stroke(width = 1.5f)
        )
        drawCircle(
            color = primaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.08f),
            radius = 95f * pulse,
            center = Offset(cx, cy),
            style = Stroke(width = 1f)
        )

        // Robot Head Chassis (Futuristic Angular Hexagon)
        val headPath = Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx - 35f, cy - 40f)
            lineTo(cx + 35f, cy - 40f)
            lineTo(cx + 50f, cy)
            lineTo(cx + 35f, cy + 45f)
            lineTo(cx - 35f, cy + 45f)
            lineTo(cx - 50f, cy)
            close()
        }

        // Fill Head
        drawPath(
            path = headPath,
            color = Color(0xFF081220).copy(alpha = 0.9f)
        )
        // Stroke Head Outline
        drawPath(
            path = headPath,
            color = primaryColor,
            style = Stroke(width = 2.5f)
        )

        // Robot Visor / Cyber Optical Sensors
        val visorY = cy - 8f
        val visorWidth = 36f * pulse
        drawRoundRect(
            color = primaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.25f),
            topLeft = Offset(cx - visorWidth, visorY - 8f),
            size = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(visorWidth * 2, 16f),
            cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(4f, 4f)
        )

        // Glowing Core Eyes
        drawCircle(
            color = if (isTyping) Color(0xFFFF0055) else primaryColor,
            radius = 5f * pulse,
            center = Offset(cx - 18f, visorY)
        )
        drawCircle(
            color = if (isTyping) Color(0xFFFF0055) else primaryColor,
            radius = 5f * pulse,
            center = Offset(cx + 18f, visorY)
        )

        // Audio Frequency Wave lines at the bottom of the mouth
        val mouthY = cy + 26f
        for (i in -3..3) {
            val barH = if (isTyping) (kotlin.math.abs(i) * 3f + 4f) * pulse else 4f
            drawLine(
                color = primaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.8f),
                start = Offset(cx + i * 8f, mouthY - barH),
                end = Offset(cx + i * 8f, mouthY + barH),
                strokeWidth = 2f
            )
        }

        // Antennae / Neural horns
        drawLine(
            color = primaryColor,
            start = Offset(cx - 30f, cy - 40f),
            end = Offset(cx - 45f, cy - 65f),
            strokeWidth = 2f
        )
        drawCircle(color = primaryColor, radius = 3f, center = Offset(cx - 45f, cy - 65f))

        drawLine(
            color = primaryColor,
            start = Offset(cx + 30f, cy - 40f),
            end = Offset(cx + 45f, cy - 65f),
            strokeWidth = 2f
        )
        drawCircle(color = primaryColor, radius = 3f, center = Offset(cx + 45f, cy - 65f))

        // Moving Scanline Effect
        val scanLineY = h * scanY
        drawLine(
            color = primaryColor.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
            start = Offset(0f, scanLineY),
            end = Offset(w, scanLineY),
            strokeWidth = 1.5f
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CyberTelemetryBar(label: String, progress: Float, color: Color) {
    val mono = FontFamily.Monospace
    Column {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
        ) {
            Text(label, color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.7f), fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 8.sp)
            Text("${(progress * 100).toInt()}%", color = color, fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .height(4.dp)
                .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f))
        ) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .fillMaxWidth(progress)
                    .background(color)
            )
        }
    }
}
