/**
 * P2 visual foundation.
 *
 * Sylphora deliberately does not use this layer: its existing home remains the
 * reference/default experience. Every other family gets a genuinely different
 * composition while consuming the same GameEntity data and launch callbacks.
 */
@Composable
private fun ThemeFocusMotion(active: Boolean, theme: PegasusTheme, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, shape: androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp), content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit) {
    val scale by animateFloatAsState(if (active) 1.025f else 1f, tween(durationMillis = 200, easing = FastOutLinearInEasing), label = "theme-focus-scale")
    val glowAlpha by animateFloatAsState(if (active) 0.34f else 0.08f, tween(durationMillis = 200, easing = FastOutLinearInEasing), label = "theme-focus-glow")
    Box(
        modifier
            .scale(scale)
            .shadow(if (active) 14.dp else 3.dp, shape, clip = false, ambientColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = glowAlpha), spotColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = glowAlpha * .8f))
            .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = if (active) .72f else .14f), shape)
            .clip(shape),
        content = content
    )
}

private fun Modifier.themeFocusInput(active: Boolean): Modifier = if (active) this.alpha(1f) else this.alpha(.88f)

@Composable
fun ThemeExperienceHome(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    themeIndex: Int,
    fontScale: Float = 1f,
    games: List<GameEntity>,
    selectedIndex: Int,
    onGameSelected: (Int) -> Unit,
    onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit,
    onOpenSettings: () -> Unit = {},
    onBack: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    userProfile: com.example.UserProfile? = null,
    onOpenProfile: (() -> Unit)? = null
) {
    val selected = games.getOrNull(selectedIndex)
    val focusRequester = androidx.compose.runtime.remember { FocusRequester() }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { focusRequester.requestFocus() }
    Box(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().focusRequester(focusRequester).focusable().onPreviewKeyEvent { event ->
            if (event.type != KeyEventType.KeyDown || games.isEmpty()) return@onPreviewKeyEvent false
            val current = selectedIndex.coerceIn(0, games.lastIndex)
            when (event.nativeKeyEvent.keyCode) {
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP -> { onGameSelected((current - 1 + games.size) % games.size); true }
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN -> { onGameSelected((current + 1) % games.size); true }
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A -> { onLaunch(games[current]); true }
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B -> { onBack?.invoke(); true }
                else -> false
            }
        }
    ) {
        AnimatedContent(
            targetState = themeIndex,
            transitionSpec = { fadeIn() togetherWith fadeOut() },
            label = "theme-home"
        ) { index ->
            when (index) {
                0 -> SylphoraHome(theme, fontScale, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch, onOpenSettings, onBack, userProfile, onOpenProfile)
                1 -> IisuHome(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                2 -> PegasusHome(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                3 -> EsdeHome(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                4 -> SteamDeckHome(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                5 -> CyberpunkHome(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                6 -> NintendoHome(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                7 -> GameBoyHome(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                8 -> AnimeHome(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                9 -> Ps5Home(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                10 -> Switch2Home(theme, games, selectedIndex, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
                else -> LegacyThemeHome(theme, selected, onLaunch)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SylphoraHome(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    fontScale: Float,
    games: List<GameEntity>,
    selectedIndex: Int,
    onGameSelected: (Int) -> Unit,
    onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit,
    onOpenSettings: () -> Unit = {},
    onBack: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    userProfile: com.example.UserProfile? = null,
    onOpenProfile: (() -> Unit)? = null
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val isDark = theme.isDark

    var selectedFilterIndex by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var sortModeIndex by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var showSortDropdown by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var showFilterDropdown by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val sortModes = listOf("預設排序", "評分最高", "遊玩次數", "名稱 A-Z")
    val filterOptions = listOf("全部遊戲 (All Games)", "經典主機 (ROMs)", "我的最愛 (Favorites)", "安卓應用 (Apps)")

    val filteredGames = remember(games, selectedFilterIndex, sortModeIndex) {
        val list = when (selectedFilterIndex) {
            1 -> games.filter { !it.platform.equals("Android", ignoreCase = true) && !it.romPath.startsWith("app://") }
            2 -> games.filter { it.isFavorite || it.rating >= 4.0f }
            3 -> games.filter { it.platform.equals("Android", ignoreCase = true) || it.romPath.startsWith("app://") }
            else -> games
        }
        when (sortModeIndex) {
            1 -> list.sortedByDescending { it.rating }
            2 -> list.sortedByDescending { it.playCount }
            3 -> list.sortedBy { it.title.lowercase() }
            else -> list
        }
    }

    var lastSelectedGameId by remember { mutableStateOf<Int?>(null) }
    val currentSelectedGame = games.getOrNull(selectedIndex)
    LaunchedEffect(currentSelectedGame?.id) {
        if (currentSelectedGame != null) {
            lastSelectedGameId = currentSelectedGame.id
        }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(filteredGames, selectedFilterIndex, sortModeIndex) {
        val targetId = lastSelectedGameId
        if (targetId != null && filteredGames.isNotEmpty()) {
            val idx = filteredGames.indexOfFirst { it.id == targetId }
            if (idx >= 0 && idx != selectedIndex) {
                onGameSelected(idx)
            } else if (idx < 0) {
                onGameSelected(0)
            }
        }
    }

    val actualSelectedIndex = selectedIndex.coerceIn(0, (filteredGames.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0))
    val selected = filteredGames.getOrNull(actualSelectedIndex)
    var showDetailOverlay by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val listState = rememberLazyListState()
    val rightRailState = rememberLazyListState()
    LaunchedEffect(actualSelectedIndex) {
        if (filteredGames.isNotEmpty()) {
            listState.animateScrollToItem(actualSelectedIndex.coerceIn(0, filteredGames.lastIndex))
            rightRailState.animateScrollToItem((actualSelectedIndex - 2).coerceAtLeast(0))
        }
    }

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(if (isDark) theme.background else theme.background)
    ) {
        // 1. Fullscreen Hero Artwork Backdrop if game has background/screenshot/cover
        val heroImage = selected?.backgroundPath.takeIf { !it.isNullOrBlank() }
            ?: selected?.screenshotPath.takeIf { !it.isNullOrBlank() }
            ?: selected?.coverPath.takeIf { !it.isNullOrBlank() && !it.startsWith("app://") }

        if (!heroImage.isNullOrBlank()) {
            AsyncImage(
                model = heroImage,
                contentDescription = null,
                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .alpha(if (isDark) 0.35f else 0.20f)
            )
        }

        // 2. Deep Cosmic Gradient Scrim
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(
                    Brush.verticalGradient(
                        colors = listOf(
                            theme.background.copy(alpha = if (heroImage != null) 0.85f else 1.0f),
                            theme.surface.copy(alpha = if (heroImage != null) 0.88f else 1.0f),
                            theme.background.copy(alpha = if (heroImage != null) 0.95f else 1.0f)
                        )
                    )
                )
        )

        // 3. Subtle Cosmic Starfield Atmosphere
        SylphoraCosmicStarfield(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), particleCount = 180, isDark = isDark)

        // 4. Main UI Content Tree
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 12.dp)
        ) {
            // Top Capsule Bar (1:1 with reference)
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(bottom = 12.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                // Left Capsule Group
                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
                ) {
                    // Circular Back Button
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .size(38.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.75f))
                            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.18f), CircleShape)
                            .clickable {
                                SoundManager.playBackSound(context)
                                onBack?.invoke()
                            },
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack,
                            contentDescription = "Back",
                            tint = Color.White,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                        )
                    }

                    // Circular Action Button (Settings)
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .size(38.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.75f))
                            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.18f), CircleShape)
                            .clickable {
                                SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                onOpenSettings()
                            },
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = Icons.Filled.Settings,
                            contentDescription = "Settings",
                            tint = Color.White,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                        )
                    }

                    // Sort Capsule Pill [⇅ Preset]
                    Box {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                                .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.75f))
                                .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.18f), RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                                .clickable {
                                    SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                    showSortDropdown = true
                                }
                                .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = Icons.Filled.SwapVert,
                                contentDescription = null,
                                tint = theme.accent,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                            )
                            Text(
                                text = sortModes[sortModeIndex],
                                color = Color.White,
                                fontSize = 12.sp * fontScale,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                            )
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = Icons.Filled.ArrowDropDown,
                                contentDescription = null,
                                tint = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.7f),
                                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                            )
                        }

                        DropdownMenu(
                            expanded = showSortDropdown,
                            onDismissRequest = { showSortDropdown = false },
                            modifier = Modifier.background(theme.surface)
                        ) {
                            sortModes.forEachIndexed { index, modeName ->
                                DropdownMenuItem(
                                    text = {
                                        Row(
                                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                                        ) {
                                            Text(
                                                text = modeName,
                                                color = if (sortModeIndex == index) theme.accent else Color.White,
                                                fontWeight = if (sortModeIndex == index) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                                                fontSize = 13.sp * fontScale
                                            )
                                            if (sortModeIndex == index) {
                                                Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                                                Icon(Icons.Filled.Check, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.accent, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                                            }
                                        }
                                    },
                                    onClick = {
                                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                        sortModeIndex = index
                                        showSortDropdown = false
                                    }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Category Capsule [ ≡ All Games ]
                    Box {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                                .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.75f))
                                .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.18f), RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                                .clickable {
                                    SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                    showFilterDropdown = true
                                }
                                .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = Icons.Filled.Menu,
                                contentDescription = null,
                                tint = theme.tertiary,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                            )
                            Text(
                                text = filterOptions.getOrElse(selectedFilterIndex) { filterOptions[0] },
                                color = Color.White,
                                fontSize = 12.sp * fontScale,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                            )
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = Icons.Filled.ArrowDropDown,
                                contentDescription = null,
                                tint = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.7f),
                                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                            )
                        }

                        DropdownMenu(
                            expanded = showFilterDropdown,
                            onDismissRequest = { showFilterDropdown = false },
                            modifier = Modifier.background(theme.surface)
                        ) {
                            filterOptions.forEachIndexed { index, optionName ->
                                DropdownMenuItem(
                                    text = {
                                        Row(
                                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                                        ) {
                                            Text(
                                                text = optionName,
                                                color = if (selectedFilterIndex == index) theme.tertiary else Color.White,
                                                fontWeight = if (selectedFilterIndex == index) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                                                fontSize = 13.sp * fontScale
                                            )
                                            if (selectedFilterIndex == index) {
                                                Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                                                Icon(Icons.Filled.Check, contentDescription = null, tint = theme.tertiary, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                                            }
                                        }
                                    },
                                    onClick = {
                                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                        selectedFilterIndex = index
                                        showFilterDropdown = false
                                    }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Right Profile Badge (User / Avatar)
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.75f))
                        .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.35f), RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                        .clickable {
                            SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                            onOpenProfile?.invoke() ?: onOpenSettings()
                        }
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = userProfile?.username?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "Guest",
                        color = Color.White,
                        fontSize = 13.sp * fontScale,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )

                    // Profile Icon
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .size(28.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
                            .border(1.2.dp, theme.accent, CircleShape),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        if (userProfile?.customAvatarUri != null && userProfile.customAvatarUri.isNotBlank()) {
                            AsyncImage(
                                model = userProfile.customAvatarUri,
                                contentDescription = "Avatar",
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
                            )
                        } else {
                            Text(
                                text = when (userProfile?.avatarType) {
                                    "robot" -> "🤖"
                                    "cat" -> "🐱"
                                    "ghost" -> "👻"
                                    "alien" -> "👾"
                                    "skull" -> "💀"
                                    "ninja" -> "🥷"
                                    "mage" -> "🧙"
                                    else -> "👤"
                                },
                                fontSize = 16.sp * fontScale
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Main Stage: Left Tracklist Wheel + Center Hero Cover + Far Right Filter Rail + Bottom Stats
            if (filteredGames.isEmpty()) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .weight(1f),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                        Text(
                            text = "🌧️ 尚無此分類遊戲",
                            color = Color.White,
                            fontSize = 20.sp * fontScale,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "請切換篩選條件，或前往設定掃描遊戲庫",
                            color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                            fontSize = 14.sp * fontScale
                        )
                    }
                }
            } else {
            BoxWithConstraints(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .weight(1f)
            ) {
                val isCompactWidth = maxWidth < 680.dp
                val leftWeight = if (isCompactWidth) 0.46f else 0.40f
                val rightWeight = if (isCompactWidth) 0.54f else 0.53f
                val spacingDp = if (isCompactWidth) 10.dp else 20.dp

                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(spacingDp)
                ) {
                    // LEFT COLUMN: Arc / Rhythm Game Tracklist Wheel
                    LazyColumn(
                        state = listState,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(leftWeight)
                            .fillMaxHeight(),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = 8.dp)
                    ) {
                        itemsIndexed(filteredGames, key = { _, game -> "${game.id}_${game.romPath}" }) { index, game ->
                            val isSelected = index == actualSelectedIndex
                            val itemRank = remember(index) { "${index + 1}" }

                            if (isSelected) {
                                // Selected glowing purple bar with triangular chevron pointing to cover art
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .fillMaxWidth()
                                        .height(64.dp)
                                        .clickable {
                                            SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                            onGameSelected(index)
                                        }
                                ) {
                                    // Custom Chevron background drawing with arrow tip on right
                                    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                                        val w = size.width
                                        val h = size.height
                                        val arrowWidth = 20.dp.toPx()
                                        val cornerRad = 12.dp.toPx()

                                        val path = Path().apply {
                                            moveTo(cornerRad, 0f)
                                            lineTo(w - arrowWidth, 0f)
                                            lineTo(w, h * 0.5f) // Triangle Tip pointing right
                                            lineTo(w - arrowWidth, h)
                                            lineTo(cornerRad, h)
                                            cubicTo(0f, h, 0f, 0f, cornerRad, 0f)
                                            close()
                                        }

                                        drawPath(
                                            path = path,
                                            brush = Brush.horizontalGradient(
                                                listOf(theme.accent, theme.accent)
                                            ),
                                            style = Fill
                                        )
                                    }

                                    // Item Content inside Chevron
                                    Row(
                                        modifier = Modifier
                                            .fillMaxSize()
                                            .padding(start = 14.dp, end = 26.dp),
                                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
                                    ) {
                                        // Big Bold Rank Number on left
                                        Text(
                                            text = itemRank,
                                            color = Color.White,
                                            fontSize = 22.sp * fontScale,
                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                                            modifier = Modifier.width(36.dp)
                                        )

                                        // Title and Developer
                                        Column(
                                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
                                        ) {
                                            Text(
                                                text = game.title,
                                                color = Color.White,
                                                fontSize = 16.sp * fontScale,
                                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                                maxLines = 1,
                                                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                            )
                                            Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
                                            Text(
                                                text = game.developer?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: game.platform,
                                                color = theme.accent,
                                                fontSize = 12.sp * fontScale,
                                                maxLines = 1,
                                                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                            )
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                // Non-selected Item Card
                                Row(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .fillMaxWidth()
                                        .height(68.dp)
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                        .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.65f))
                                        .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                        .combinedClickable(
                                            onClick = {
                                                SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                                onGameSelected(index)
                                            },
                                            onDoubleClick = { onLaunch(game) },
                                            onLongClick = { onLaunch(game) }
                                        )
                                        .padding(horizontal = 14.dp),
                                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
                                ) {
                                    // Rank Number
                                    Text(
                                        text = itemRank,
                                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                                        fontSize = 16.sp * fontScale,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                        modifier = Modifier.width(32.dp)
                                    )

                                    // Title & Platform Subtitle
                                    Column(
                                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
                                    ) {
                                        Text(
                                            text = game.title,
                                            color = Color.White,
                                            fontSize = 14.sp * fontScale,
                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                                            maxLines = 1,
                                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                        )
                                        Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
                                        Text(
                                            text = game.developer?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: game.platform,
                                            color = Color(0xFFB8B2D8),
                                            fontSize = 11.sp * fontScale,
                                            maxLines = 1,
                                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                        )
                                    }

                                    if (game.isFavorite) {
                                        Text(
                                            text = "★",
                                            color = Color(0xFFFDE047),
                                            fontSize = 14.sp * fontScale,
                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // CENTER-RIGHT STAGE: Floating Hero Game Cover Artwork + Info + Play Button
                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(rightWeight)
                            .fillMaxHeight(),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                    ) {
                        if (selected != null) {
                            // Floating Hero Game Cover Card (16:9 / Landscape Art)
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .weight(1f)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(22.dp))
                                    .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.7f))
                                    .border(1.5.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(22.dp))
                                    .shadow(16.dp, RoundedCornerShape(22.dp), spotColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                                    .clickable {
                                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                        showDetailOverlay = true
                                    },
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                // Real Game Cover Art via UniversalGameArt (Boxart, Libretro, Android icon, or Retro Cartridge)
                                UniversalGameArt(
                                    game = selected,
                                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                                    contentScale = ContentScale.Fit
                                )

                                // Subtle bottom gradient vignette over cover
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .fillMaxWidth()
                                        .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                                        .height(80.dp)
                                        .background(
                                            Brush.verticalGradient(
                                                listOf(Color.Transparent, Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.85f))
                                            )
                                        )
                                )

                                // Platform Badge on Top-Right
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .align(Alignment.TopEnd)
                                        .padding(14.dp)
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                        .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.65f))
                                        .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.7f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = selected.platform.uppercase(),
                                        color = theme.accent,
                                        fontSize = 11.sp * fontScale,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                                        letterSpacing = 1.sp
                                    )
                                }

                                // Large title overlay at bottom of cover
                                Column(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .align(Alignment.BottomStart)
                                        .padding(16.dp)
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = selected.title,
                                        color = Color.White,
                                        fontSize = 20.sp * fontScale,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                                        maxLines = 1,
                                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                    )
                                }
                            }

                            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))

                            // Bottom-Right Info Bar & Play Action Trigger
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                                    .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.85f))
                                    .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f), RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                                    .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                            ) {
                                // Left Info: Developer / Publisher & Play Count & Synopsis
                                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 12.dp)) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = selected.developer?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                                            ?: selected.publisher?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                                            ?: selected.platform,
                                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                                        fontSize = 13.sp * fontScale,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                        maxLines = 1,
                                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                    )
                                    Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
                                    Text(
                                        text = selected.description?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                                            ?: "點擊「考據館」瀏覽 7 大歷史維度、金手指與 Game DNA。",
                                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.65f),
                                        fontSize = 11.sp * fontScale,
                                        maxLines = 1,
                                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                    )
                                    Spacer(Modifier.height(3.dp))
                                    Row(
                                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                                    ) {
                                        Text(
                                            text = if (selected.playCount > 0) "已遊玩 ${selected.playCount} 次" else "尚未遊玩",
                                            color = theme.accent,
                                            fontSize = 11.sp * fontScale,
                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                                        )
                                        if (selected.rating > 0f) {
                                            Text(
                                                text = "★ ${String.format("%.1f", selected.rating)}",
                                                color = Color(0xFFFDE047),
                                                fontSize = 11.sp * fontScale,
                                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                            )
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                    // Museum Button
                                    OutlinedButton(
                                        onClick = {
                                            SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                            showDetailOverlay = true
                                        },
                                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                                        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.65f)),
                                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
                                    ) {
                                        Icon(
                                            Icons.Filled.Museum,
                                            contentDescription = null,
                                            tint = theme.accent,
                                            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                                        )
                                        Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                        Text(
                                            text = "考據館",
                                            color = theme.accent,
                                            fontSize = 13.sp * fontScale,
                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                        )
                                    }

                                    // Big Glowing START Action Button
                                    Button(
                                        onClick = {
                                            SoundManager.playLaunchSound(context)
                                            onLaunch(selected)
                                        },
                                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                                            containerColor = theme.accent
                                        ),
                                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
                                        elevation = ButtonDefaults.buttonElevation(defaultElevation = 8.dp)
                                    ) {
                                        Icon(
                                            Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
                                            contentDescription = "Start",
                                            tint = Color.White,
                                            modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                                        )
                                        Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                        Text(
                                            text = "開始遊戲",
                                            color = Color.White,
                                            fontSize = 14.sp * fontScale,
                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // FAR-RIGHT COLUMN: Game Number Indexing Rail (1-based index)
                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(0.075f)
                            .fillMaxHeight(),
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "NO.",
                            color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
                            fontSize = 10.sp * fontScale,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                            letterSpacing = 1.sp
                        )

                        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))

                        LazyColumn(
                            state = rightRailState,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .weight(1f)
                                .fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                            contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = 4.dp)
                        ) {
                            itemsIndexed(filteredGames, key = { _, game -> "rail_${game.id}_${game.romPath}" }) { gIndex, _ ->
                                val isSelected = actualSelectedIndex == gIndex
                                val itemNumber = gIndex + 1
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .size(36.dp)
                                        .clip(CircleShape)
                                        .background(
                                            if (isSelected) Brush.radialGradient(
                                                listOf(theme.accent, theme.accent)
                                            )
                                            else Brush.verticalGradient(
                                                listOf(theme.surface.copy(alpha = 0.75f), Color(0xFF13111E).copy(alpha = 0.75f))
                                            )
                                        )
                                        .border(
                                            width = if (isSelected) 1.5.dp else 1.dp,
                                            color = if (isSelected) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.15f),
                                            shape = CircleShape
                                        )
                                        .clickable {
                                            SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                                            onGameSelected(gIndex)
                                        },
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = "$itemNumber",
                                        color = if (isSelected) Color.White else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                                        fontSize = (if (itemNumber > 99) 10.sp else 12.sp) * fontScale,
                                        fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Black else FontWeight.SemiBold
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))

                        Text(
                            text = "${actualSelectedIndex + 1}/${filteredGames.size}",
                            color = theme.accent,
                            fontSize = 10.sp * fontScale,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        }
        if (showDetailOverlay && selected != null) {
            ThemeGameDetailOverlay(
                theme = theme,
                themeIndex = 0,
                game = selected,
                onDismiss = { showDetailOverlay = false },
                onLaunch = {
                    showDetailOverlay = false
                    onLaunch(it)
                }
            )
        }
    }
}

private fun String?.isNullByBlank(): Boolean = this.isNullOrBlank()


















@Composable
fun ThemeExperienceLibrary(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    themeIndex: Int,
    games: List<GameEntity>,
    selectedGame: GameEntity?,
    searchQuery: String,
    onSearchQueryChange: (String) -> Unit,
    selectedPlatform: String?,
    platforms: List<String>,
    onPlatformChange: (String?) -> Unit,
    selectedCollection: String?,
    collections: List<String>,
    onCollectionChange: (String?) -> Unit,
    onGameSelected: (GameEntity) -> Unit,
    onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit
) {
    var showDetail by remember(selectedGame) { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        ThemeLibraryTools(
            theme = theme,
            themeIndex = themeIndex,
            searchQuery = searchQuery,
            onSearchQueryChange = onSearchQueryChange,
            selectedPlatform = selectedPlatform,
            platforms = platforms,
            onPlatformChange = onPlatformChange,
            selectedCollection = selectedCollection,
            collections = collections,
            onCollectionChange = onCollectionChange,
            gameCount = games.size
        )
        when (themeIndex) {
            1 -> IisuLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            2 -> PegasusLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            3 -> EsdeLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            4 -> SteamDeckLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            5 -> CyberpunkLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            6 -> NintendoLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            7 -> GameBoyLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            8 -> AnimeLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            9 -> PS5Library(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            10 -> Switch2Library(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
            else -> LegacyLibrary(theme, games, selectedGame, onGameSelected, onLaunch)
        }
        }
        selectedGame?.let { game ->
            if (showDetail) {
                ThemeGameDetailOverlay(theme, themeIndex, game, onDismiss = { showDetail = false }, onLaunch = onLaunch)
            } else {
                Box(Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd).padding(18.dp)) {
                    OutlinedButton(onClick = { showDetail = true }, shape = when (themeIndex) { 5, 7 -> RoundedCornerShape(2.dp); 6 -> RoundedCornerShape(24.dp); else -> RoundedCornerShape(10.dp) }) {
                        Text(if (themeIndex == 5) "DETAIL://OPEN" else "DETAILS", fontFamily = if (themeIndex == 5 || themeIndex == 7) FontFamily.Monospace else FontFamily.Default)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ThemeLibraryTools(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    themeIndex: Int,
    searchQuery: String,
    onSearchQueryChange: (String) -> Unit,
    selectedPlatform: String?,
    platforms: List<String>,
    onPlatformChange: (String?) -> Unit,
    selectedCollection: String?,
    collections: List<String>,
    onCollectionChange: (String?) -> Unit,
    gameCount: Int
) {
    val mono = if (themeIndex == 5 || themeIndex == 7 || themeIndex == 2) FontFamily.Monospace else FontFamily.Default
    Row(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
    ) {
        OutlinedTextField(
            value = searchQuery,
            onValueChange = onSearchQueryChange,
            singleLine = true,
            placeholder = { Text(if (themeIndex == 5) "SEARCH://TITLE" else "搜尋遊戲", fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 12.sp) },
            leadingIcon = { Icon(Icons.Filled.Search, null, tint = theme.accent) },
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(50.dp),
            shape = when (themeIndex) { 5, 7 -> RoundedCornerShape(2.dp); 6 -> RoundedCornerShape(26.dp); else -> RoundedCornerShape(12.dp) },
            colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
                focusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
                unfocusedTextColor = theme.textMain,
                focusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = .55f),
                unfocusedContainerColor = theme.surface.copy(alpha = .35f),
                focusedIndicatorColor = theme.accent,
                unfocusedIndicatorColor = theme.accent.copy(alpha = .22f),
                cursorColor = theme.accent
            )
        )
        if (platforms.size > 1) {
            var expanded by androidx.compose.runtime.remember { androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf(false) }
            Box {
                OutlinedButton(onClick = { expanded = true }, shape = if (themeIndex == 7) RoundedCornerShape(2.dp) else RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)) {
                    Text(selectedPlatform ?: "平台", fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 11.sp)
                }
                DropdownMenu(expanded = expanded, onDismissRequest = { expanded = false }) {
                    platforms.forEach { platform ->
                        DropdownMenuItem(
                            text = { Text(platform, fontFamily = mono) },
                            onClick = { expanded = false; onPlatformChange(if (platform == "全部") null else platform) }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (collections.isNotEmpty()) {
            var expanded by androidx.compose.runtime.remember { androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf(false) }
            Box {
                OutlinedButton(onClick = { expanded = true }, shape = if (themeIndex == 7) RoundedCornerShape(2.dp) else RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)) {
                    Text(selectedCollection ?: "收藏集", fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 11.sp, maxLines = 1)
                }
                DropdownMenu(expanded = expanded, onDismissRequest = { expanded = false }) {
                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("全部", fontFamily = mono) }, onClick = { expanded = false; onCollectionChange(null) })
                    collections.forEach { collection ->
                        DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(collection, fontFamily = mono) }, onClick = { expanded = false; onCollectionChange(collection) })
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Text(gameCount.toString().padStart(3, '0'), color = theme.accent, fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 12.sp)
    }
}

@Composable
private fun IisuLibrary(theme: PegasusTheme, games: List<GameEntity>, selected: GameEntity?, onSelect: (GameEntity) -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 18.dp)) {
        Text("YOUR COLLECTION", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, letterSpacing = 3.sp)
        Text("選一款，繼續你的旅程", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 28.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        if (games.isEmpty()) return@Column
        LazyRow(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp), contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = 12.dp)) {
            itemsIndexed(games, key = { _, game -> "${game.id}_${game.romPath}" }) { _, game ->
                val active = selected?.id == game.id
                Column(Modifier.width(if (active) 220.dp else 180.dp).themeFocusInput(active).clickable { onSelect(game) }) {
                    UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(if (active) 290.dp else 245.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(28.dp)).border(if (active) 2.dp else 1.dp, if (active) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = .08f), RoundedCornerShape(28.dp)))
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = if (active) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium, maxLines = 1)
                    Text("", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
                }
            }
        }
        selected?.let { game ->
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 8.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) { Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold); Text(game.description ?: "尚無描述", color = theme.textSecondary, maxLines = 1) }
                Button(onClick = { onLaunch(game) }, colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent), shape = RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)) { Text("PLAY", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun PegasusLibrary(theme: PegasusTheme, games: List<GameEntity>, selected: GameEntity?, onSelect: (GameEntity) -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val isCompact = maxWidth < 600.dp
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(24.dp)) {
            if (!isCompact || selected == null) {
                Column(Modifier.widthIn(max = 300.dp).fillMaxWidth(if (isCompact) 1f else 0.4f).fillMaxHeight()) {
                    Text("ARCHIVE / 01", color = theme.accent, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, fontSize = 12.sp, letterSpacing = 3.sp)
                    Text("典藏索引", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 30.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                    Text("${games.size} OBJECTS", color = theme.textSecondary, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, fontSize = 11.sp)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                    LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                        itemsIndexed(games, key = { _, game -> "${game.id}_${game.romPath}" }) { index, game ->
                            val active = selected?.id == game.id
                            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable { onSelect(game) }.background(if (active) theme.accent.copy(alpha = .12f) else Color.Transparent).padding(vertical = 9.dp, horizontal = 6.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                Text("${(index + 1).toString().padStart(3, '0')}", color = if (active) theme.accent else theme.textSecondary, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, modifier = Modifier.width(38.dp))
                                Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!isCompact || selected != null) {
                selected?.let { game ->
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight()) {
                        UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f).border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = .55f)))
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                        Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Text(game.genre ?: "分類未記", color = theme.textSecondary, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, fontSize = 12.sp)
                        Text(game.description ?: "尚無典藏描述", color = theme.textSecondary, maxLines = 2, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 6.dp))
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp), modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp)) {
                            Button(onClick = { onLaunch(game) }, colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent)) { Text("ENTER COLLECTION", color = theme.background) }
                            if (isCompact) {
                                OutlinedButton(onClick = { onSelect(game) }) { Text("BACK") }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun EsdeLibrary(theme: PegasusTheme, games: List<GameEntity>, selected: GameEntity?, onSelect: (GameEntity) -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val isCompact = maxWidth < 600.dp
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            if (!isCompact) {
                Column(Modifier.widthIn(max = 220.dp).fillMaxWidth(0.35f).fillMaxHeight().background(theme.surface).padding(16.dp)) {
                    Text("SYSTEMS", color = theme.accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, letterSpacing = 2.sp)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    games.map { it.platform }.distinct().sorted().forEach { platform ->
                        val active = selected?.platform == platform
                        Text(platform, color = if (active) theme.accent else theme.textSecondary, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp)).background(if (active) theme.accent.copy(alpha = .12f) else Color.Transparent).padding(9.dp))
                    }
                }
            }
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight().padding(horizontal = if (isCompact) 12.dp else 22.dp)) {
                Text("MEDIA WALL", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = 10.dp)) {
                    itemsIndexed(games, key = { _, game -> "${game.id}_${game.romPath}" }) { _, game ->
                        val active = selected?.id == game.id
                        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(92.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp)).background(if (active) theme.surface else Color.Transparent).clickable { onSelect(game) }.padding(7.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.width(if (isCompact) 90.dp else 130.dp).fillMaxHeight().clip(RoundedCornerShape(3.dp)))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(14.dp))
                            Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) { Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis); Text("READY", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp); Text(game.description ?: "No description", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!isCompact) {
                selected?.let { game ->
                    Column(Modifier.widthIn(max = 320.dp).fillMaxWidth(0.45f).fillMaxHeight().padding(18.dp)) {
                        UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(210.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(5.dp)))
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp)); Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold); Text("READY", color = theme.accent); Text(game.description ?: "No description", color = theme.textSecondary, maxLines = 4, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp)); Button(onClick = { onLaunch(game) }, colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent), modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp)) { Text("LAUNCH", color = theme.background) }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun NintendoLibrary(theme: PegasusTheme, games: List<GameEntity>, selected: GameEntity?, onSelect: (GameEntity) -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 22.dp)) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) { Box(Modifier.size(38.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(theme.accent), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { Text("N", color = Color.White, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black) }; Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp)); Text("PLAY", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 26.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black) }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        LazyVerticalGrid(columns = GridCells.Adaptive(150.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 14.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
            items(games.size, key = { games[it].id }) { index ->
                val game = games[index]; val active = selected?.id == game.id
                Column(Modifier.clickable { onSelect(game) }) {
                    UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(170.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)).border(if (active) 4.dp else 1.dp, if (active) theme.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = .12f), RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)))
                    Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 1, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 6.dp))
                    Text(game.platform, color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 10.sp)
                }
            }
        }
        selected?.let { game ->
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 5.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) { Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)); Button(onClick = { onLaunch(game) }, colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent), shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp)) { Text("PLAY", color = Color.White) } }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun GameBoyLibrary(theme: PegasusTheme, games: List<GameEntity>, selected: GameEntity?, onSelect: (GameEntity) -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    val mono = FontFamily.Monospace
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 18.dp)) {
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().border(2.dp, theme.textMain).padding(7.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) { Text("POCKET // LIBRARY", color = theme.textMain, fontFamily = mono, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold); Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f)); Text("${games.size.toString().padStart(3, '0')} ITEMS", color = theme.textMain, fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 10.sp) }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        LazyColumn(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
            itemsIndexed(games, key = { _, game -> "${game.id}_${game.romPath}" }) { index, game ->
                val active = selected?.id == game.id
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().border(2.dp, if (active) theme.textMain else theme.textMain.copy(alpha = .35f)).background(if (active) theme.textMain.copy(alpha = .12f) else Color.Transparent).clickable { onSelect(game) }.padding(8.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text("${(index + 1).toString().padStart(3, '0')}", color = theme.textMain, fontFamily = mono, modifier = Modifier.width(42.dp)); UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.size(56.dp)); Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp)); Column { Text(game.title.uppercase(), color = theme.textMain, fontFamily = mono, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 1); Text("${game.platform} // ${game.genre ?: "GAME"}", color = theme.textSecondary, fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 10.sp) }
                }
            }
        }
        selected?.let { game -> Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().border(2.dp, theme.textMain).padding(8.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) { Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) { Text(game.title.uppercase(), color = theme.textMain, fontFamily = mono, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold); Text(game.description ?: "NO DESCRIPTION", color = theme.textSecondary, fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 10.sp, maxLines = 1) }; Button(onClick = { onLaunch(game) }, colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.textMain), shape = RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)) { Text("START", color = theme.background, fontFamily = mono, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) } } }
    }
}


@Composable
private fun AnimeLibrary(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    games: List<GameEntity>,
    selected: GameEntity?,
    onSelect: (GameEntity) -> Unit,
    onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit
) {
    if (games.isEmpty()) {
        ThemeEmptyState(theme, 8, onImport = {})
        return
    }
    Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(18.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(18.dp)) {
        LazyVerticalGrid(
            columns = GridCells.Adaptive(170.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(4.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
        ) {
            items(games, key = { it.id }) { game ->
                val active = selected?.id == game.id
                Column(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(22.dp))
                        .background(if (active) theme.accent.copy(alpha = .13f) else theme.surface.copy(alpha = .55f))
                        .border(
                            if (active) 2.dp else 1.dp,
                            theme.accent.copy(alpha = if (active) .70f else .18f),
                            RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)
                        )
                        .clickable { onSelect(game) }
                        .padding(8.dp)
                ) {
                    UniversalGameArt(
                        game,
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(220.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(17.dp))
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        game.title,
                        color = theme.textMain,
                        fontSize = 14.sp,
                        fontWeight = if (active) FontWeight.Black else FontWeight.Bold,
                        maxLines = 2,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(3.dp))
                    Text(
                        game.platform,
                        color = theme.accent,
                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        selected?.let { game ->
            Column(
                Modifier.widthIn(max = 300.dp).fillMaxWidth(0.4f).fillMaxHeight().clip(RoundedCornerShape(26.dp))
                    .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = .72f))
                    .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = .32f), RoundedCornerShape(26.dp))
                    .padding(16.dp)
            ) {
                UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(220.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp)))
                Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 23.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, maxLines = 2)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(5.dp))
                Text(game.platform, color = theme.accent, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Text(game.description ?: "尚無描述", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp, maxLines = 6, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                Button(
                    onClick = { onLaunch(game) },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(50.dp),
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("開始遊玩", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun PS5Library(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    games: List<GameEntity>,
    selected: GameEntity?,
    onSelect: (GameEntity) -> Unit,
    onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit
) {
    if (games.isEmpty()) {
        EmptyThemeState(theme, "PlayStation 5 遊戲庫尚無遊戲")

    ) {

            columns = GridCells.Adaptive(160.dp),

                .weight(1f)
                .fillMaxHeight(),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 24.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),

        ) {

                val game = games[index]
                val active = selected?.id == game.id

                Column(

                            if (active) Color(0xFF00439C).copy(alpha = 0.35f)
                            else Color(0xFF131722).copy(alpha = 0.85f)

                            if (active) 2.dp else 1.dp,

                        )
                        .clickable { onSelect(game) }
                        .padding(10.dp)
                ) {

                        game = game,

                            .height(180.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
                        contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))

                        game.title,
                        color = Color.White,
                        fontSize = 14.sp,
                        fontWeight = if (active) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(3.dp))
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),

                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Text(

                            color = Color(0xFF0070D1),
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                        if (game.playCount > 0) {
                            Text(
                                "${game.playCount} 次遊玩",
                                color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                                fontSize = 10.sp
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        selected?.let { game ->
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .width(320.dp)
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                    .background(Color(0xFF0F141F).copy(alpha = 0.95f))
                    .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF0070D1).copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                    .padding(20.dp)
            ) {
                com.example.ui.theme.UniversalGameArt(
                    game = game,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(200.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)),
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(14.dp))
                Text(
                    game.title,
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 20.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    maxLines = 2
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text(
                    game.platform.uppercase(),
                    color = Color(0xFF0070D1),
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Text(
                    game.description ?: "歡迎體驗次世代經典館藏。透過 AI 深度解析與遊戲回憶庫，重現最純粹的冒險體驗。",
                    color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.75f),

@Composable

    }
}

@Composable
private fun EmptyThemeState(theme: PegasusTheme, text: String) {
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
            Icon(Icons.Filled.SportsEsports, null, tint = theme.accent, modifier = Modifier.size(54.dp))
            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))

        }
