}

@Composable
private fun ThemeGameDetailOverlay(theme: PegasusTheme, themeIndex: Int, game: GameEntity, onDismiss: () -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    val shape = when (themeIndex) { 5, 7 -> RoundedCornerShape(2.dp); 6 -> RoundedCornerShape(28.dp); else -> RoundedCornerShape(14.dp) }
    val focusRequester = androidx.compose.runtime.remember { FocusRequester() }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { focusRequester.requestFocus() }
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = .68f)).clickable { onDismiss() }, contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        BoxWithConstraints(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth(.94f)
                .fillMaxHeight(.90f)
                .clip(shape)
                .background(theme.surface)
                .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = .55f), shape)
                .focusRequester(focusRequester)
                .focusable()
                .onPreviewKeyEvent { event ->
                    if (event.type != KeyEventType.KeyDown) return@onPreviewKeyEvent false
                    when (event.nativeKeyEvent.keyCode) {
                        KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B -> { onDismiss(); true }
                        KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A -> { if (!game.romPath.isNullOrBlank()) onLaunch(game); true }
                        else -> false
                    }
                }
        ) {
            val compact = maxWidth < 700.dp
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(if (compact) 14.dp else 20.dp)) {
            if (compact) {
                Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                    UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(190.dp).clip(shape))
                    ThemeDetailContent(theme, themeIndex, game, onDismiss, onLaunch, shape, compact)
                }
            } else {
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp)) {
                    UniversalGameArt(game, Modifier.width(280.dp).fillMaxHeight().clip(shape))
                    ThemeDetailContent(theme, themeIndex, game, onDismiss, onLaunch, shape, compact)
                }
            }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ThemeDetailContent(theme: PegasusTheme, themeIndex: Int, game: GameEntity, onDismiss: () -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit, shape: androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shape, compact: Boolean) {
    val mono = FontFamily.Monospace
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().fillMaxHeight(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
        Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState())) {
            Text(when (themeIndex) { 1 -> "COLLECTION / DETAIL"; 2 -> "ARCHIVE OBJECT"; 3 -> "MEDIA PROFILE"; 4 -> "GAME PROFILE"; 5 -> "SYS://DETAIL"; 6 -> "GAME DETAILS"; else -> "POCKET ENTRY" }, color = theme.accent, fontFamily = if (themeIndex == 5 || themeIndex == 7) mono else FontFamily.Default, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = if (compact) 24.sp else 30.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontFamily = if (themeIndex == 5 || themeIndex == 7) mono else FontFamily.Default, maxLines = 2, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
            Text(game.platform, color = theme.accent, fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 11.sp)
            Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
            Text(game.description ?: "No description available.", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 14.sp, lineHeight = 20.sp)
            Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
            if (game.romPath.isNullOrBlank()) {
                ThemeErrorState(theme, themeIndex, "ROM SOURCE UNAVAILABLE", "This entry has no launchable ROM URI. Re-scan or repair the source before launching.")
                Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
            }
            Text("${game.genre ?: "GENRE —"}   •   ${game.developer ?: "DEVELOPER —"}", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 11.sp)
            Text("PLAYED ${game.playCount} TIMES   •   ${game.playTimeMinutes} MIN", color = theme.textSecondary, fontFamily = mono, fontSize = 10.sp, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 6.dp))
        }
        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp), modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp)) {
            Button(enabled = !game.romPath.isNullOrBlank(), onClick = { onLaunch(game) }, shape = shape, colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent), modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) { Text(if (themeIndex == 5) "EXECUTE" else "PLAY", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = if (themeIndex == 5) mono else FontFamily.Default) }
            OutlinedButton(onClick = onDismiss, shape = shape, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) { Text(if (themeIndex == 7) "B BACK" else "CLOSE", fontFamily = if (themeIndex == 7) mono else FontFamily.Default) }
        }
    }
}

// ==========================================
// 9. PLAYSTATION 5 (PS5 Home Interface)
// ==========================================
@Composable
private fun Ps5Home(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    games: List<GameEntity>,
    selectedIndex: Int,
    onGameSelected: (Int) -> Unit,
    onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit
) {
    if (games.isEmpty()) {
        EmptyThemeState(theme, "PlayStation 遊戲庫暫無資料")
        return
    }
    val selected = games.getOrNull(selectedIndex.coerceIn(0, (games.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)))
    val listState = androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.rememberLazyListState()

    LaunchedEffect(selectedIndex) {
        if (games.isNotEmpty()) {
            listState.animateScrollToItem(selectedIndex.coerceIn(0, games.size - 1))
        }
    }

    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val maxWidth = maxWidth
        val isCompact = maxWidth < 600.dp

        // Background layer: Full screen blur/dim of current game cover
        selected?.let { game ->
            val hero = game.backgroundPath ?: game.coverPath
            if (!hero.isNullOrBlank()) {
                AsyncImage(
                    model = hero,
                    contentDescription = null,
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().alpha(if (theme.isDark) 0.4f else 0.2f)
                )
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(
                            colors = listOf(
                                Color.Transparent,
                                theme.background.copy(alpha = 0.8f),
                                theme.background
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            // Top Section: Game Details (Dynamic, elegant)
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(if (isCompact) 0.6f else 0.5f).padding(24.dp)) {
                selected?.let { game ->
                    Column(
                        Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomStart),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Bottom
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = game.title,
                            color = theme.textMain,
                            fontSize = if (isCompact) 28.sp else 36.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                            maxLines = 2,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Icon(
                                Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
                                contentDescription = "Play",
                                tint = theme.background,
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .size(20.dp)
                                    .clip(CircleShape)
                                    .background(theme.textMain)
                                    .padding(2.dp)
                            )
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                            Text(
                                "Start Game",
                                color = theme.textMain,
                                fontSize = 14.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                            )
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(16.dp))
                            Text(
                                "${game.playTimeMinutes} mins",
                                color = theme.textSecondary,
                                fontSize = 14.sp
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Bottom Section: Horizontal scroll list (PS5 style small square tiles)
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(if (isCompact) 0.4f else 0.5f).padding(bottom = 24.dp)) {
                LazyRow(
                    state = listState,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 24.dp, vertical = 16.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    itemsIndexed(games, key = { _, game -> "${game.id}_${game.romPath}" }) { index, game ->
                        val isSelected = index == selectedIndex
                        val tileScale by animateFloatAsState(
                            targetValue = if (isSelected) 1.15f else 1f,
                            animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 200, easing = FastOutLinearInEasing)
                        )

                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .width(if (isCompact) 110.dp else 140.dp)
                                .aspectRatio(1f) // Square tiles like PS5 UI
                                .scale(tileScale)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                .background(theme.surface)
                                .border(
                                    width = if (isSelected) 2.dp else 0.dp,
                                    color = if (isSelected) theme.accent else Color.Transparent,
                                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                                )
                                .clickable {
                                    if (isSelected) {
                                        onLaunch(game)
                                    } else {
                                        onGameSelected(index)
                                    }
                                }
                        ) {
                            AsyncImage(
                                model = game.coverPath ?: game.backgroundPath,
                                contentDescription = game.title,
                                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                            )
                            if (!isSelected) {
                                Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.4f)))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun Switch2PillDock(
    currentRoute: String = "home",
    activeDockIndex: Int = 7, // 7 is Settings
    onNavigate: (String) -> Unit = {},
    context: android.content.Context = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
) {
    Column(
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            // 1. Nintendo Switch Online / Home (首頁)
            val isHomeSelected = currentRoute == "home" && (activeDockIndex == 0 || activeDockIndex !in listOf(4, 5, 6, 7))
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(40.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (isHomeSelected) Color(0xFFE60012) else Color(0xFFCC0010))
                    .border(if (isHomeSelected) 2.5.dp else 0.dp, Color.White, CircleShape)
                .clickable {
                    SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                    onNavigate("home")
                },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.SportsEsports, contentDescription = "Online", tint = Color.White, modifier = Modifier.size(15.dp))
                    Text("ONLINE", color = Color.White, fontSize = 6.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                }
            }

            // 2. Album / Library (相簿/遊戲庫)
            val isAlbumSelected = currentRoute == "library" || activeDockIndex == 4
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(40.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (isAlbumSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3).copy(alpha = 0.25f) else Color(0xFF2A2D36))
                    .border(
                        width = if (isAlbumSelected) 2.5.dp else 1.dp,
                        color = if (isAlbumSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3) else Color(0xFF424754),
                        shape = CircleShape
                    )
                    .clickable {
                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                        onNavigate("library")
                    },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(
                    Icons.Filled.PhotoLibrary,
                    contentDescription = "相簿",
                    tint = if (isAlbumSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3) else Color(0xFF4FC3F7),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
                )
            }

            // 3. AI Curator (AI 館長)
            val isAiSelected = currentRoute == "ai" || activeDockIndex == 5
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(40.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (isAiSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3).copy(alpha = 0.25f) else Color(0xFF2A2D36))
                    .border(
                        width = if (isAiSelected) 2.5.dp else 1.dp,
                        color = if (isAiSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3) else Color(0xFF424754),
                        shape = CircleShape
                    )
                    .clickable {
                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                        onNavigate("ai")
                    },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(
                    Icons.Filled.SmartToy,
                    contentDescription = "AI 館長",
                    tint = if (isAiSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3) else Color(0xFFCCCCCC),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
                )
            }

            // 4. Research (考據)
            val isResearchSelected = currentRoute == "research" || activeDockIndex == 6
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(40.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (isResearchSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3).copy(alpha = 0.25f) else Color(0xFF2A2D36))
                    .border(
                        width = if (isResearchSelected) 2.5.dp else 1.dp,
                        color = if (isResearchSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3) else Color(0xFF424754),
                        shape = CircleShape
                    )
                    .clickable {
                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                        onNavigate("research")
                    },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(
                    Icons.Filled.TravelExplore,
                    contentDescription = "考據",
                    tint = if (isResearchSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3) else Color(0xFFCCCCCC),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
                )
            }

            // 5. Settings (設定)
            val isSettingsSelected = currentRoute == "tools" || activeDockIndex == 7
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(40.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (isSettingsSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3).copy(alpha = 0.25f) else Color(0xFF2A2D36))
                    .border(
                        width = if (isSettingsSelected) 3.dp else 1.dp,
                        brush = if (isSettingsSelected) Brush.sweepGradient(
                            listOf(Color(0xFF00C3E3), Color(0xFF9C27B0), Color(0xFFFF4081), Color(0xFF00C3E3))
                        ) else SolidColor(Color(0xFF424754)),
                        shape = CircleShape
                    )
                    .clickable {
                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                        onNavigate("tools")
                    },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(
                    Icons.Filled.Settings,
                    contentDescription = "設定",
                    tint = if (isSettingsSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3) else Color(0xFFCCCCCC),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
                )
            }

            // 6. Power Button (電源)
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(40.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(Color(0xFF2A2D36))
                    .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF424754), CircleShape)
                    .clickable {
                        SoundManager.playSelectSound(context)
                    },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(
                    Icons.Filled.PowerSettingsNew,
                    contentDescription = "電源",
                    tint = Color(0xFFE57373),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
                )
            }
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(5.dp))

        // Label underneath selected icon
        val selectedLabel = when {
            currentRoute == "tools" || activeDockIndex == 7 -> "設定"
            currentRoute == "research" || activeDockIndex == 6 -> "考據"
            currentRoute == "library" || activeDockIndex == 4 -> "相簿"
            currentRoute == "ai" || activeDockIndex == 5 -> "AI 館長"
            currentRoute == "home" || activeDockIndex == 0 -> "首頁"
            else -> ""
        }

        Text(
            text = selectedLabel.ifEmpty { " " },
            color = Color(0xFF00C3E3),
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun Switch2Home(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    games: List<GameEntity>,
    selectedIndex: Int,
    onGameSelected: (Int) -> Unit,
    onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit
) {
    val context = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
    val selected = games.getOrNull(selectedIndex.coerceIn(0, (games.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)))
    val listState = androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.rememberLazyListState()

    var currentTime by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        val sdf = java.text.SimpleDateFormat("H:mm", java.util.Locale.getDefault())
        while (true) {
            currentTime = sdf.format(java.util.Date())
            kotlinx.coroutines.delay(1000L)
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(selectedIndex) {
        if (games.isNotEmpty()) {
            listState.animateScrollToItem(selectedIndex.coerceIn(0, games.size - 1))
        }
    }

    BoxWithConstraints(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(if (theme.isDark) Color(0xFF222222) else Color(0xFFEBEBEB))
    ) {
        val totalHeight = maxHeight
        val cardSize = (totalHeight * 0.46f).coerceIn(130.dp, 220.dp)

        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(vertical = 10.dp, horizontal = 16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
        ) {
            // Top Bar: Mii Profile Avatar Left, Clock & Icons Right
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                // Top Left: Mii Avatar Circle
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(38.dp)
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(Color(0xFFFF5252))
                        .border(2.dp, Color.White, CircleShape),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Filled.Person,
                        contentDescription = "User Avatar",
                        tint = Color.White,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
                    )
                }

                // Top Right: Clock, WiFi, Battery
                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = currentTime,
                        color = if (theme.isDark) Color.White else Color(0xFF222222),
                        fontSize = 16.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Filled.Wifi,
                        contentDescription = "Wi-Fi",
                        tint = if (theme.isDark) Color.White else Color(0xFF222222),
                        modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                    )
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Filled.BatteryFull,
                        contentDescription = "Battery",
                        tint = if (theme.isDark) Color.White else Color(0xFF222222),
                        modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                    )
                }
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))

            // Middle Carousel: Square 1:1 Rounded Game Poster Cards
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .weight(1f),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                LazyRow(
                    state = listState,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 20.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    itemsIndexed(games, key = { _, game -> "${game.id}_${game.romPath}" }) { index, game ->
                        val isSelected = index == selectedIndex
                        val tileScale by animateFloatAsState(
                            targetValue = if (isSelected) 1.05f else 0.95f,
                            animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 200, easing = FastOutLinearInEasing),
                            label = "switch-card-scale"
                        )

                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(cardSize)
                                .scale(tileScale)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                                .background(if (theme.isDark) Color(0xFF2C2C2E) else Color.White)
                                .border(
                                    width = if (isSelected) 3.5.dp else 1.dp,
                                    color = if (isSelected) Color(0xFF00C3E3) else Color(0xFFE0E0E0),
                                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp)
                                )
                                .clickable {
                                    if (isSelected) {
                                        onLaunch(game)
                                    } else {
                                        onGameSelected(index)
                                    }
                                }
                        ) {
                            UniversalGameArt(
                                game = game,
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                            )
                        }
                    }

                    // Pad empty square cards if list is small to resemble Switch Home
                    if (games.size < 5) {
                        items(5 - games.size, key = { "empty_pad_$it" }) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .size(cardSize * 0.95f)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                                    .background(if (theme.isDark) Color(0xFF282828) else Color(0xFFFAFAFA))
                                    .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFE0E0E0), RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ThemeEmptyState(
    theme: PegasusTheme,
    themeIndex: Int,
    onImport: () -> Unit
) {
    val mono = FontFamily.Monospace
    val title = when (themeIndex) {
        1 -> "YOUR COLLECTION IS WAITING"
        2 -> "ARCHIVE / EMPTY"
        3 -> "NO MEDIA FOUND"
        4 -> "LIBRARY OFFLINE"
        5 -> "SYS://NO_ENTRIES"
        6 -> "LET'S PLAY"
        7 -> "INSERT COLLECTION"
        9 -> "NO SAVED DATA"
        10 -> "NO SOFTWARE FOUND"
        else -> "開始建立遊戲庫"
    }
    val body = when (themeIndex) {
        1 -> "Import a ROM folder and iiSU will turn it into a visual collection."
        2 -> "No objects have been catalogued yet."
        3 -> "Add a ROM source to populate the media wall."
        4 -> "Choose a ROM directory to bring the library online."
        5 -> "INDEX EMPTY // SOURCE REQUIRED"
        6 -> "Choose a ROM folder and start your collection."
        7 -> "NO GAMES // LOAD ROMS TO CONTINUE"
        9 -> "Insert disc or import games from a folder to begin."
        10 -> "Please insert a game card or select a game folder."
        else -> "選擇 ROM 根目錄開始建立索引"
    }
    val shape = when (themeIndex) {
        5, 7 -> RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)
        6, 1 -> RoundedCornerShape(28.dp)
        else -> RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
    }
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        Column(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(shape).background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = .88f))
                .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = .45f), shape).padding(34.dp),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
        ) {
            Icon(
                when (themeIndex) {
                    5 -> Icons.Default.Terminal
                    7 -> Icons.Default.Gamepad
                    2 -> Icons.Default.Museum
                    3 -> Icons.Default.Tv
                    4 -> Icons.Default.SportsEsports
                    else -> Icons.Default.Collections
                }, null, tint = theme.accent, modifier = Modifier.size(48.dp)
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
            Text(title, color = theme.textMain, fontFamily = if (themeIndex == 5 || themeIndex == 7) mono else FontFamily.Default, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontSize = 22.sp)
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            Text(body, color = theme.textSecondary, fontFamily = if (themeIndex == 5 || themeIndex == 7) mono else FontFamily.Default, fontSize = 13.sp)
            Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
            Button(onClick = onImport, shape = shape, colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent)) {
                Text(if (themeIndex == 5) "EXECUTE IMPORT" else "IMPORT ROMS", color = theme.background, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            }
        }
    }
}

}

@Composable
fun ThemeExperienceSettings(viewModel: GameViewModel, theme: PegasusTheme, themeIndex: Int, onClose: () -> Unit = {}) {
    val mono = FontFamily.Monospace
    val title = when (themeIndex) {
        1 -> "PERSONALIZE YOUR FLOW"
        2 -> "ARCHIVE CONFIGURATION"
        3 -> "SYSTEM SETTINGS"
        4 -> "STEAM DECK / SETTINGS"
        5 -> "SYS://CONFIG"
        6 -> "PLAY SETTINGS"
        7 -> "POCKET / OPTIONS"
        9 -> "SETTINGS"
        10 -> "SYSTEM SETTINGS"
        else -> "設定"
    }
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 8.dp)) {
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Text(title, color = theme.textMain, fontFamily = if (themeIndex == 5 || themeIndex == 7) mono else FontFamily.Default, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontSize = 22.sp)
            Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
            IconButton(onClick = onClose) {
                Icon(Icons.Default.Home, contentDescription = "返回首頁", tint = theme.accent, modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp))
            }
        }
        Box(
            Modifier.fillMaxSize().clip(when (themeIndex) { 5, 7 -> RoundedCornerShape(2.dp); 6 -> RoundedCornerShape(28.dp); else -> RoundedCornerShape(14.dp) })
                .background(theme.surface.copy(alpha = .72f))
                .border(1.dp, theme.accent.copy(alpha = .24f), when (themeIndex) { 5, 7 -> RoundedCornerShape(2.dp); 6 -> RoundedCornerShape(28.dp); else -> RoundedCornerShape(14.dp) })
        ) {
            SettingsScreen(viewModel, onClose = onClose)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun IisuHome(theme: PegasusTheme, games: List<GameEntity>, selectedIndex: Int, onGameSelected: (Int) -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    val selected = games.getOrNull(selectedIndex.coerceIn(0, (games.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)))
    val listState = rememberLazyListState(initialFirstVisibleItemIndex = maxOf(0, selectedIndex - 2))
    
    LaunchedEffect(selectedIndex) {
        listState.animateScrollToItem(maxOf(0, selectedIndex - 2))
    }

    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(theme.background)) {
        val totalHeight = maxHeight
        val totalWidth = maxWidth
        val rowHeight = (totalHeight * 0.40f).coerceIn(160.dp, 290.dp)
        val cardWidth = (rowHeight * 0.62f).coerceIn(100.dp, 180.dp)
        val titleSize = (totalHeight * 0.052f).value.coerceIn(22f, 38f).sp

        selected?.let { game ->
            val hero = game.backgroundPath ?: game.coverPath
            if (!hero.isNullOrBlank()) {
                AsyncImage(model = hero, contentDescription = null, contentScale = ContentScale.Crop, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().alpha(if (theme.isDark) 0.3f else 0.15f))
            }
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color.Transparent, theme.background.copy(alpha = 0.8f), theme.background))))
            
            Column(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .padding(horizontal = (totalWidth * 0.04f).coerceIn(16.dp, 36.dp), vertical = (totalHeight * 0.04f).coerceIn(12.dp, 28.dp)),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Bottom
            ) {
                Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = titleSize, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                Text(game.platform, color = theme.accent, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 12.dp))
                
                LazyRow(
                    state = listState,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(rowHeight),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    itemsIndexed(games, key = { _, g -> "${g.id}_${g.romPath}" }) { index, g ->
                        val active = index == selectedIndex
                        val scale by animateFloatAsState(
                            targetValue = if (active) 1.12f else 0.92f,
                            animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 200, easing = FastOutLinearInEasing)
                        )
                        val alpha by animateFloatAsState(
                            targetValue = if (active) 1f else 0.65f,
                            animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 200, easing = FastOutLinearInEasing)
                        )
                        
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .width(cardWidth)
                                .fillMaxHeight()
                                .scale(scale)
                                .alpha(alpha)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                                .border(if (active) 3.dp else 0.dp, theme.accent, RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                                .clickable { onGameSelected(index); if(active) onLaunch(g) }
                        ) {
                            UniversalGameArt(game = g, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentScale = ContentScale.Crop)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun PegasusHome(theme: PegasusTheme, games: List<GameEntity>, selectedIndex: Int, onGameSelected: (Int) -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    val selected = games.getOrNull(selectedIndex.coerceIn(0, (games.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)))
    
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(theme.background)) {
        val totalWidth = maxWidth
        val isWide = totalWidth > 640.dp
        val detailWidth = (totalWidth * 0.35f).coerceIn(220.dp, 340.dp)

        Row(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(16.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight()) {
                Text("PEGASUS GRID", color = theme.accent, fontSize = 11.sp, letterSpacing = 2.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Text("All Games (${games.size})", color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                
                LazyVerticalGrid(
                    columns = GridCells.Adaptive(minSize = 95.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                ) {
                    items(games.size, key = { games[it].id }) { index ->
                        val g = games[index]
                        val active = index == selectedIndex
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .aspectRatio(0.72f)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                .border(if (active) 3.dp else 0.dp, theme.accent, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                .clickable { onGameSelected(index); if(active) onLaunch(g) }
                        ) {
                            UniversalGameArt(game = g, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentScale = ContentScale.Crop)
                            if (active) Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(theme.accent.copy(alpha = 0.2f)))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (isWide) {
                selected?.let { game ->
                    Column(
                        Modifier
                            .width(detailWidth)
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                            .background(theme.surface)
                            .padding(16.dp)
                    ) {
                        AsyncImage(
                            model = game.logoPath ?: game.coverPath,
                            contentDescription = null,
                            contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(max = 100.dp)
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                        Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 2, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                        Text(game.platform, color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp)
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                        Text(game.description ?: "No description available.", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 12.sp, maxLines = 6, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                        Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                        Button(
                            onClick = { onLaunch(game) },
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 48.dp),
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                            shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text("PLAY", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

internal fun EsdeHome(theme: PegasusTheme, games: List<GameEntity>, selectedIndex: Int, onGameSelected: (Int) -> Unit, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {

                }
                Spacer(Modifier.width(24.dp))

                    Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 32.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, maxLines = 2, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                    Text(game.platform, color = theme.accent, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                    Text(game.description ?: "", color = theme.textSecondary, fontSize = 13.sp, maxLines = 4, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                    Button(
                        onClick = { onLaunch(game) },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text("PLAY NOW", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

        selected?.let { game ->
            AsyncImage(model = game.backgroundPath, contentDescription = null, contentScale = ContentScale.Crop, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().alpha(0.5f))
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(20.dp)) {
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Bottom) {
                    AsyncImage(model = game.logoPath, contentDescription = null, contentScale = ContentScale.Fit, modifier = Modifier.heightIn(max = 100.dp).padding(bottom = 12.dp))
                    Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 34.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, maxLines = 2, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                    Button(
                        onClick = { onLaunch(game) },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = theme.accent),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 16.dp).heightIn(min = 48.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text("PLAY", fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }
                LazyColumn(
                    state = listState,
                    modifier = Modifier.width(listWidth).fillMaxHeight(),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
                ) {
                    itemsIndexed(games, key = { _, g -> "${g.id}_${g.romPath}" }) { index, g ->
                        val active = index == selectedIndex
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .height(110.dp)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                .border(if (active) 3.dp else 0.dp, theme.accent, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                .clickable { onGameSelected(index); if(active) onLaunch(g) }
                        ) {
                            UniversalGameArt(game = g, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentScale = ContentScale.Crop)
                            if (active) Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(theme.accent.copy(alpha=0.3f)))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun LegacyThemeHome(theme: PegasusTheme, selected: GameEntity?, onLaunch: (GameEntity) -> Unit) {
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(theme.background), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        val totalHeight = maxHeight
        val artSize = (totalHeight * 0.35f).coerceIn(130.dp, 240.dp)

        selected?.let { game ->
            Column(
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(24.dp)
            ) {
                UniversalGameArt(game = game, modifier = Modifier.size(artSize).clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)), contentScale = ContentScale.Crop)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                Text(game.title, color = theme.textMain, fontSize = 22.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                Button(
                    onClick = { onLaunch(game) },
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 16.dp).heightIn(min = 48.dp),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("Play", fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        } ?: Text("No games found.", color = theme.textMain)
    }
}

fun PegasusTheme.toMaterialColorScheme(): androidx.compose.material3.ColorScheme {
    return if (isDark) {
        androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme(
            primary = accent,
            onPrimary = if (accent == RetroMuseumDarkPrimary) RetroMuseumDarkOnPrimary else Color.White,
            primaryContainer = cardStart,
            onPrimaryContainer = textMain,
            secondary = accent,
            onSecondary = Color.White,
            secondaryContainer = cardEnd,
            onSecondaryContainer = textSecondary,
            tertiary = tertiary,
            onTertiary = RetroMuseumDarkOnTertiary,
            tertiaryContainer = RetroMuseumDarkTertiaryContainer,
            onTertiaryContainer = RetroMuseumDarkOnTertiaryContainer,
            background = background,
            onBackground = textMain,
            surface = surface,
            onSurface = textMain,
            surfaceVariant = cardStart,
            onSurfaceVariant = textSecondary,
            outline = outline,
            outlineVariant = RetroMuseumDarkOutlineVariant
        )
    } else {
        androidx.compose.material3.lightColorScheme(
            primary = accent,
            onPrimary = Color.White,
            primaryContainer = cardStart,
            onPrimaryContainer = textMain,
            secondary = accent,
            onSecondary = Color.White,
            secondaryContainer = cardEnd,
            onSecondaryContainer = textSecondary,
            tertiary = tertiary,
            onTertiary = RetroMuseumLightOnTertiary,
            tertiaryContainer = RetroMuseumLightTertiaryContainer,
            onTertiaryContainer = RetroMuseumLightOnTertiaryContainer,
            background = background,
            onBackground = textMain,
            surface = surface,
            onSurface = textMain,
            surfaceVariant = cardStart,
            onSurfaceVariant = textSecondary,
            outline = outline,
            outlineVariant = RetroMuseumLightOutlineVariant
        )
    }
}

package com.example

import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.createComposeRule
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
import com.example.database.GameEntity

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
@Config(instrumentedPackages = ["androidx.loader.content"])
class CrashTest {

    @get:Rule
    val composeTestRule = createComposeRule()

    @Test
    fun testAppLaunchWithGames() {
        composeTestRule.setContent {
            com.example.ui.theme.ThemeExperienceHome(
                theme = com.example.ui.theme.ThemeFamilies.first().dark,
                themeIndex = 0, // Sylphora
                games = listOf(
                    GameEntity(id = 1, title = "Super Mario", platform = "SNES", romPath = "a", coverPath = "b")
                ),
                selectedIndex = 0,
                onGameSelected = {},
                onLaunch = {}
            )
        }
    }
}

package com.example

import android.content.Context
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
class ExampleRobolectricTest {

  @Test
  fun `read string from context`() {
    val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
    val appName = context.getString(R.string.app_name)
    assertEquals("Sylphora", appName)
  }
}
